# 2011: current events archive

**Source-preservation edition.**

This chronological reference preserves 7,597 Wikipedia event assertions across 365 dates, including topic hierarchy, original citations and pinned revisions. SQLite is authoritative; this UTF-8 Markdown is its readable companion.

Source selection and wording are Wikipedia’s, and are not certified exhaustive, impartial or factually correct. Publication does not imply independent checking of every assertion. Original wording, errors and dated reporting figures remain visible. Editorial accounts are separately labeled and cited.

Database: [2011.sqlite](2011.sqlite). Edition SHA-256: `a8738d96e92875c6e99942159788d451d4fa01d6eff412478f0562904422c5a1`. Publication: `preservation-release-1.1`. Extraction/Markdown profile: `annual-series-1.4`. Date: 2026-10-22.

Original entries without attached citations: 57. Separate editorial evidence: 0; explicitly unverified: 57. Unverified means no full-event verification is established; research may be incomplete or not attempted. An unsuccessful search does not establish that a claim is false. Full-event reviews complete: 0; partial: 0; without a full-event review: 7,597. Partial reviews leave unsupported details explicit.

Exact original daily files, Wikipedia payloads/metadata and prior extraction candidates are embedded losslessly, with hashes, an exact retirement manifest and Git checkpoint. Wikipedia attribution and CC BY-SA obligations remain applicable. Publisher URLs identify evidence; full publisher articles and images are not reproduced.

Template display uses explicit original arguments without calculated conversions, live expansion or inferred links. Unsupported template markup and source reliability tags remain visible. Orphan topics and malformed/unbulleted material are preserved with the handling notes below; no missing child or event is invented.

Commented-out source assertions remain labeled non-event material in the database and handling notes; they are excluded from ordinary event totals.

## January

### 2011-01-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1175334228](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20January%201&oldid=1175334228>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-01-01-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bomb explodes outside a Coptic church in Alexandria, Egypt, killing at least 21 people and wounding 97 more; street disturbances between Christians and Muslims ensue.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-12101748>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/01/20111114553109742.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2011-01-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Bonaire, Saba and Sint Eustatius adopt the United States dollar as the sole legal currency, reducing the use of the Netherlands Antillean guilder to Curaçao and Sint Maarten.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2011-01-04-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Salmaan Taseer, the Governor of the Pakistani province of Punjab, is assassinated by Malik Mumtaz Hussain Qadri, one of his security guards at Koshar Market, Islamabad.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/asiapcf/01/04/pakistan.governor.killed/index.html?hpt=T2>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-south-asia-12111831>).

<a id="event-2011-01-04-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** 51-year-old Texan Cornelius Dupree, freed on parole in July 2010 after serving 30 of a 75 year sentence for aggravated robbery, has his conviction quashed after he was found to be innocent of the crime through DNA evidence.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-12115208>).

#### Politics

<a id="event-2011-01-04-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Economic Community of West African States says the situation in Côte d'Ivoire is still in a "stalemate", amid the threat of force to remove Laurent Gbagbo.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/ivoryCoastNews/idAFLDE7030WA20110104?sp=true>).

<a id="event-2011-01-04-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sudanese President Omar al-Bashir goes to Juba to meet with Southern Sudanese President of the Government Salva Kiir Mayardit ahead of Southern Sudan's independence referendum.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-12109582>).

<a id="event-2011-01-04-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** 2010–2011 Tunisian protests: Reports continue to leak out of the country regarding civil unrest with claims that protests have spread to the city of Thala, where the ruling Constitutional Democratic Rally's offices have been attacked.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera English](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2011/01/201114101752467578.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2011-01-04-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** 10-year-old Canadian Kathryn Aurora Gray becomes the youngest person ever to discover a supernova.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-12110747>).

### 2011-01-05

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076438034](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20January%205&oldid=1076438034>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2011-01-05-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Clarence House confirms that Prince William and Catherine Middleton will be married by the Archbishop of Canterbury, Dr Rowan Williams.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/skynews/Home/UK-News/Royal-Wedding-Prince-William-And-Kate-Middleton-Reveal-Further-Details-Of-Their-Marriage-Ceremony/Article/201101115880470?lpos=UK_News_First_UK_News_Article_Teaser_Region_0&amp;lid=ARTICLE_15880470_Royal_Wedding%3A_Prince_William_And_Kate_Middleton_Reveal_Further_Details_Of_Their_Marriage_Ceremony>).

<a id="event-2011-01-05-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Swedish actor Per Oscarsson and his wife Kia Östling are confirmed dead by dental records after a fire destroyed the couple's house in Skara and the couple perished on December 30, 2010.

Source citations (as archived): [The Local](<http://www.thelocal.se/31272/20110105/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2011-01-05-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iran and India develop a stop-gap plan to continue the flow of oil from the former to the latter, and payments in the opposite direction, days after India withdrew from the Asian Clearing Union. The new plan involves payments through the EIH Bank, in Hamburg, Germany.

Source citations (as archived): [Domain-b](<http://www.domain-b.com/industry/oil_gas/20110105_payments_channels.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2011-01-05-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 17-year-old student at Millard South High School, in Omaha, Nebraska, shoots an assistant principal to death and wounds the school principal before turning the gun onto himself.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://news.blogs.cnn.com/2011/01/05/two-shot-at-nebraska-high-school-suspect-dead/?hpt=T2>).

<a id="event-2011-01-05-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Malaysian coroner records an open verdict in the death of opposition aide Teoh Beng Hock, who fell from the roof of the anti-corruption commission building in July 2009.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-12117835>); [Malaysia Star](<http://thestar.com.my/news/story.asp?file=/2011/1/5/nation/20110105153818&amp;sec=nation>).

<a id="event-2011-01-05-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police investigating the murder of Joanna Yeates make a fresh appeal for information, saying that when discovered, her fully clothed body was missing a sock which may hold important clues.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-bristol-12117460>).

<a id="event-2011-01-05-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the UK 33 people are convicted for their part in an £80m drugs and money laundering operation. They include Simon Ford, a firefighter commended for his actions during the 7 July London bombings.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-12118069>).

#### Politics

<a id="event-2011-01-05-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The 112th United States Congress is convened. Republican Representative John Boehner of Ohio is elected Speaker of the House of Representatives, succeeding Democrat Nancy Pelosi of California.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE70445T20110105>).

<a id="event-2011-01-05-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The funeral for murdered Punjab Governor Salmaan Taseer takes place in Lahore, Pakistan.

<a id="event-2011-01-05-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Kuwaiti Prime Minister Nasser Mohammed Al-Ahmed Al-Sabah narrowly survives a no confidence vote, following a crackdown at an opposition demonstration in December.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5jQo7h-0bsCNBgdqQwSHpCC1u2DJw?docId=CNG.850d68793570b46d02fb10bce04d9b6d.81>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/01/20111581427365727.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2011-01-05-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The 2011 World Junior Ice Hockey Championships in Buffalo, U.S.A. ends with Russia defeating Canada 5-3, marking the first time Russia has won a gold medal since 2003. The host American team defeats Sweden in the bronze medal game.

Source citations (as archived): [NHL](<http://www.nhl.com/ice/news.htm?id=548539>).

#### Bird Deaths

<a id="event-2011-01-05-5-0"></a>

### 2011-01-06

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1283173204](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20January%206&oldid=1283173204>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-01-06-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Médecins Sans Frontières accuses the Democratic Republic of the Congo of not doing enough to prevent war rape after 33 women are raped in Fizi, South Kivu, on New Year's Day.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/africa/01/06/congo.rapes/index.html?hpt=T2>).

<a id="event-2011-01-06-0-2"></a>

Context: 2010–2011 Ivorian crisis:.

**Archived source account.** At least 14 people in Duékoué, Ivory Coast are killed in clashes between opposing sides in the Presidential election crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/stories/2011/01/07/3107954.htm>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-12129875>).

<a id="event-2011-01-06-0-3"></a>

Context: 2010–2011 Ivorian crisis:.

**Archived source account.** Ivory Coast's President-elect Alassane Ouattara expresses confidence that military action by other West African nations will remove President Laurent Gbagbo, who refuses to leave office after his defeat in recent presidential elections.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/africa/01/06/ivory.coast.crisis/>).

<a id="event-2011-01-06-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Egyptian police increases security around Coptic churches on the eve of Coptic Christmas, following a bombing in Alexandria on New Year's Day that killed 23 people and sparked protests and riots across the country.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-12125143>); [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5iKCKJTCxRvpD06Q_qf022JiDLtlg?docId=CNG.5ef495a04e9f24705338c4bd6be74062.1f1>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/meast/01/06/egypt.coptic.church.attack/index.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-06-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** An abducted Hungarian civilian, who worked for the UN-African Union peacekeeping mission in Sudan's Darfur region, is released.

Source citations (as archived): [All Africa](<http://allafrica.com/stories/201101060074.html>); [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5i3ozM8Z68BPckoisWhTGyhqIVNhQ?docId=CNG.05a6e85bfb37cddd7fe037aaf5164bc0.691>); [Radio Dabanga](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110305162338/http://195.190.28.213/node/8029>).

<a id="event-2011-01-06-0-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israeli troops kill two Palestinians as they attempted to cross a border fence from the Gaza Strip.

<a id="event-2011-01-06-0-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. plans to send another 1,400 marines to Afghanistan, where approximately 100,000 U.S. troops are already engaged in the War in Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE70518320110106>).

<a id="event-2011-01-06-0-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** A U.S. soldier receives 90 days hard labour and must testify in the FOB Ramrod kill team case for keeping war souvenir photos, beating a platoon member and smoking hashish while involved with the FOB Ramrod kill team during the War in Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE7050X520110106>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2011-01-06-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A French market regulator approves a takeover defense adopted by the Hermès family, who own the manufacturer of Birkin and Kelly handbags. This improves the odds that Hermès will preserve its independence in the face of a bid by LVMH.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE70547U20110106>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2011-01-06-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** 22 people are killed after a bus falls into a gorge in Uttarakhand, northern India.

Source citations (as archived): [NDTV](<http://www.ndtv.com/article/cities/dehra-dun-22-killed-as-bus-falls-into-gorge-77364?pfrom=home-Cities>); [Straits Times](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110110034534/http://www.straitstimes.com/BreakingNews/Asia/Story/STIStory_621181.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2011-01-06-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States protests strongly to Vietnam after a U.S. diplomat is attacked and injured by Vietnamese police when he went to visit a detained religious dissident.

Source citations (as archived): [RFA](<http://www.rfa.org/english/news/vietnam/attack-01062011173934.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-06-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** South Korea dismisses an offer of unconditional talks by North Korea, saying the offer was part of a propaganda campaign.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/worldNews/idAFTRE7040T420110106?sp=true>).

<a id="event-2011-01-06-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A U.S. plan to force gun dealers in states which border Mexico to report cases where individuals bought multiple high-powered rifles in under 5 days, is stalled due to opposition from gun lobbies. Approximately 90% of crime guns seized in Mexico originate in the U.S., and over 30,000 people have died in Mexico due to drug cartel violence since 2006.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE7055XA20110106>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2011-01-06-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A French court orders the transfer of Rwandan Hutu leader, Callixte Mbarushimana, arrested in France for his involvement in the Rwandan Genocide, to the International Criminal Court in The Hague.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2011/01/05/Rwandan-Hutu-leader-ordered-to-Hague-court/UPI-17721294254854/>); [AllAfrica](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110110094705/http://allafrica.com/stories/201101060140.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-06-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Indonesia's National Human Rights Commission submits a report to President Susilo Bambang Yudhoyono on its investigations into reports of torture of Papuans by soldiers, and urges him to take action against human rights violations by security forces in the eastern Papua region.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5j3kPBfCEWbZaxtQP7iFi_VGYWRwQ?docId=CNG.de7188d6046cd1bfcd0dfd9fb5062a9e.771>).

<a id="event-2011-01-06-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Moroccan authorities arrest 27 people in an Al Qaeda-linked cell in Western Sahara for planning car bombings and suicide attacks on security forces, and bank robberies to finance their activities. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2011/01/06/world/africa/06morocco.html?_r=1&amp;src=mv>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2011/01/05/132681227/morocco-says-it-dismantled-terrorist-cell>).

<a id="event-2011-01-06-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Chinese authorities implement new controls on the content of text messages sent to mobile phones according to service providers, including references to democracy, human rights, and corruption.

Source citations (as archived): [RFA](<http://www.rfa.org/english/news/china/controls-01062011123855.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-06-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Aaron Swartz is arrested by MIT police on state breaking-and-entering charges, after systematically downloading academic journal articles from JSTOR.

Source citations (as archived): [Archive.org](<https://archive.org/details/CambridgePoliceDeptArrestReportReAaronSwartz>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2011-01-06-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Observers prepare to use geostationary satellites to prevent harassment in the run-up to the referendum on independence for South Sudan, by monitoring for voter intimidation, damage to property and other violence.

Source citations (as archived): [Financial Mail](<http://www.fm.co.za/Article.aspx?id=130928>).

<a id="event-2011-01-06-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister of Pakistan Yousaf Raza Gillani cancels recent fuel price increases in an apparent concession to the opposition in an attempt to save his government from collapse after losing its majority in parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSSGE7050A320110106>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/2011-01-06/pakistan-prime-minister-cancels-fuel-price-increase-to-save-his-government.html>); [Houston Chronicle](<http://www.chron.com/disp/story.mpl/ap/top/all/7368446.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-06-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Laurence Mackenzie resigns as chief executive of Northern Ireland Water in response to the organisation's handling of the recent water shortage in Northern Ireland.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-northern-ireland-12126247>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2011-01-06-6-1"></a>

Context: Asian Football Confederation Executive Committee elections in Doha, Qatar:.

**Archived source account.** Mohamed bin Hammam announce that Australia will host the 2015 AFC Asian Cup; this will be the first time Australia has hosted the competition.

Source citations (as archived): [the-AFC](<http://www.the-afc.com>).

<a id="event-2011-01-06-6-2"></a>

Context: Asian Football Confederation Executive Committee elections in Doha, Qatar:.

**Archived source account.** Ali bin Al Hussein of Jordan is elected as a Vice President of FIFA.

Source citations (as archived): [the-AFC](<http://www.the-afc.com>).

<a id="event-2011-01-06-6-3"></a>

Context: Asian Football Confederation Executive Committee elections in Doha, Qatar:.

Source citations (as archived): [the-AFC](<http://www.the-afc.com>).

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2011-01-08-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israel responds to the shooting dead of a 65-year-old Palestinian civilian in his bed during a pre-dawn raid by ordering an investigation. Troops were attempting to re-arrest five Hamas members who had been released from prison the previous day when they made the fatal error.

<a id="event-2011-01-08-2-0"></a>

<a id="event-2011-01-08-4-2"></a>

<a id="event-2011-01-08-4-3"></a>

<a id="event-2011-01-08-4-4"></a>

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-01-09-0-0"></a>

<a id="event-2011-01-09-0-2"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/CRIME/01/09/arizona.shooting/index.html?hpt=T1>).

<a id="event-2011-01-09-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Cuban revolutionary leader Fidel Castro, known for frequently disagreeing with the United States, condemns the shooting as "atrocious", "absurd" and "unjustifiable".

**Archived source account.** 2010–2011 Tunisian protests: Unrest in Tunisia over youth unemployment continues, with several deaths reported.

<a id="event-2011-01-09-4-1"></a>

Context: Israeli demolition of the historic Shepherd Hotel:.

**Archived source account.** Israeli bulldozers begin demolishing a 1930s East Jerusalem hotel to build 20 new settler homes, "destroying all the US efforts and ending any possibility of a return to negotiations" according to a spokesperson for Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-12146277>); [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2011/01/08/military-palestinian-shot-dead-charged-troops/>).

<a id="event-2011-01-09-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hillary Clinton calls Israel's demolition of the hotel a "disturbing development" which undermines peace efforts.

<a id="event-2011-01-09-4-3"></a>

<a id="event-2011-01-09-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** United States Secretary of Defense Robert Gates flies to China for a four-day trip after expressing American worries that the Chinese "clearly have potential to put some of our \[military\] capabilities at risk", adding that America has "to pay attention to them" and "respond appropriately with our own programmes".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-12146922>).

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/uk/2011/jan/09/undercover-office-green-activists>).

<a id="event-2011-01-09-5-1"></a>

<a id="event-2011-01-14-4-0"></a>

Higgins demands that the British government explain why one of Britain's undercover policemen was operating on Republic of Ireland territory on May Day 2004, as the European Union expanded to the east. Higgins compares it to illegal activities carried out by British state agents in the same country during the 1970s.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/environment/2011/jan/14/mark-kennedy-eu-summit-protest>).

<a id="event-2011-01-14-4-3"></a>

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-01-15-0-1"></a>

Context: 2010–2011 Tunisian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Former President of Tunisia Zine El Abidine Ben Ali flees with his family to Saudi Arabia, after being rejected by France.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-12198106>).

<a id="event-2011-01-15-0-2"></a>

Context: 2010–2011 Tunisian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabia confirms it is welcoming ousted Zine El Abidine Ben Ali and his family into the kingdom due to "exceptional circumstances" in Tunisia; people in Saudi Arabia and people elsewhere criticise the decision to offer sanctuary to "the dictator" on the Internet.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/01/201111515275580964.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-15-0-3"></a>

Context: 2010–2011 Tunisian protests:.

**Archived source account.** At least 42 people are killed during one fire in the city of Monastir in the central east of the country, the current deadliest single incident of the month-long protests.

Source citations (as archived): [Ennahar](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110726023650/http://www.ennaharonline.com/en/international/5555.html>); [Ynetnews](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4013877,00.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE70E18B20110115>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2011/01/201111521341179388.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-15-0-4"></a>

Context: 2010–2011 Tunisian protests:.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2011-01-15-4-1"></a>

Context: British police undercover spy ring operating across Europe:.

**Archived source account.** Veteran Labour Party TD Michael D. Higgins writes to the Irish Department of Justice regarding the activities of undercover British police officer Mark Kennedy, who infiltrated protest movements across Europe, including several on Republic of Ireland territory. He describes it as "of grave concern" and that "this type of activity undermines respect for the law and it is very sinister in that it can damage good causes."

Source citations (as archived): [The Irish Times](<http://www.irishtimes.com/newspaper/ireland/2011/0115/1224287577245.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-15-4-2"></a>

Context: British police undercover spy ring operating across Europe:.

**Archived source account.** A third British police spy is identified as the revelations continue. This one, a 44-year-old male officer, infiltrated a group in Cardiff, Wales.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/uk/2011/jan/14/third-undercover-police-spy-cardiff?intcmp=239>).

<a id="event-2011-01-15-4-4"></a>

Context: Iranian diplomatic tour and medical discovery:.

**Archived source account.** A group of international diplomats begins a two-day tour given by Iran as a gesture of goodwill and transparency in response to foreign concerns over its nuclear program. The European Union, Russia, and the People's Republic of China refuses its invitation.

<a id="event-2011-01-15-4-5"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2011-01/15/c_13692486.htm>).

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2011/01/201111513594958973.html>).

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabia tells a UN Security Council meeting that Israel's practices and illegal measures against the Palestinian people undermine international efforts for peace.

Source citations (as archived): [Arab News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110127042729/http://arabnews.com/saudiarabia/article239503.ece>).

<a id="event-2011-01-21-3-4"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** French foreign minister Michèle Alliot-Marie is met by hostile Palestinian protesters throwing stones, eggs and shoes, including mothers of prisoners held in Israeli jails, on her arrival in Gaza.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-12249297>); [KUNA](<http://www.kuna.net.kw/NewsAgenciesPublicSite/ArticleDetails.aspx?id=2139547&amp;Language=en>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/meast/01/21/gaza.french.minister/>).

<a id="event-2011-01-21-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six world powers and Iran meet in Istanbul to talk about Iran's nuclear programme; Iran denies allegations it is developing nuclear weapons.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/01/20111218501267212.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-21-3-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Almost 99% of South Sudanese voted for independence from the north in a referendum according to official figures.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE70K2DV20110121>); [Africasia](<https://web.archive.org/web/20111001035652/http://www.africasia.com/services/news_africa/article.php?ID=CNG.4fd4d6d1ccd3ca5560228308bbcfdcc2.711>).

<a id="event-2011-01-21-3-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** United Nations human rights chief Navi Pillay requests an investigation into possible involvement of officials in the abduction of around 40 Central American migrants, including women and children, from a cargo train in Oaxaca.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-12248508>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2011-01-21-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** South Korea sentences a pastor to five years imprisonment for an unauthorised trip to North Korea and praising its regime.

Source citations (as archived): [Joongang Daily](<http://joongangdaily.joins.com/article/view.asp?aid=2931333>); [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2011/01/21/Pastor-sentenced-to-jail-for-N-Korea-trip/UPI-11841295612965/>).

<a id="event-2011-01-21-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo arrest an army officer over a mass rape of civilians in the east of the country on 1 January.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-12254178>); [United Nations](<http://www.un.org/apps/news/story.asp?NewsID=37343&amp;Cr=democratic&amp;Cr1=congo>).

<a id="event-2011-01-21-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Guatemalan president Alfonso Portillo goes on trial in Guatemala City over allegations he stole $15 million from the defence ministry. Former defence minister Eduardo Arevalo and former finance minister Manuel Maza are also on trial.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-12257038>).

<a id="event-2011-01-21-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Amnesty International announces that authorities are investigating alleged crimes against humanity committed during Jean-Claude Duvalier's 1971-86 rule over Haiti. Duvalier sneaks out of his upmarket hotel via a rear exit, avoiding journalists.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/jan/21/baby-doc-duvalier-haiti-charges>).

<a id="event-2011-01-21-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** An army court in India finds a senior officer guilty of involvement in an illegal land deal.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/Sukna-land-scam-Lt-Gen-P-K-Rath-found-guilty/articleshow/7333698.cms>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-south-asia-12247922>).

<a id="event-2011-01-21-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A private note, due to remain secret despite calls for it to be published by the chairman of the Iraq Inquiry, shows former British prime minister Tony Blair privately assured former American president George W. Bush "you can count on us" before they jointly invaded Iraq prior to the Iraq War.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-12246410>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2011/01/2011121132710269378.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-21-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Warner Music Group CEO Edgar Bronfman Jr. is found guilty of misleading investors, and fined $6.7 million.

Source citations (as archived): [The Seattle Times](<http://seattletimes.nwsource.com/html/entertainment/2013993425_apeufrancevivenditrial.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2011-01-21-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people in Tunisia take part in a demonstration calling on the interim government to step down.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2011/01/2011121104023232257.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-21-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people in Jordan stage a protests against the government's economic policies, calling on some members to step down.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/01/2011121125524911325.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-21-5-3"></a>

Context: Situation in Ireland:.

**Archived source account.** Ireland's Labour Party announces it is to hold a motion of no confidence in the country's government on Tuesday following the events of this week.

Source citations (as archived): [The Irish Times](<http://www.irishtimes.com/newspaper/breaking/2011/0121/breaking6.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-21-5-4"></a>

Context: Situation in Ireland:.

**Archived source account.** Taoiseach Brian Cowen and five of his remaining eight government ministers spend the day in County Armagh in Northern Ireland attending a meeting of the North/South Ministerial Council.

Source citations (as archived): [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2011/0121/north_south.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-northern-ireland-12251413>).

<a id="event-2011-01-21-5-5"></a>

Context: Situation in Ireland:.

**Archived source account.** Senior governing Fianna Fáil TDs, including former ministers Micheál Martin and Willie O'Dea and Minister of State Conor Lenihan renew their pressure on their party leader and Taoiseach, Brian Cowen, following his botched cabinet reshuffle attempt yesterday.

Source citations (as archived): [The Irish Times](<http://www.irishtimes.com/newspaper/breaking/2011/0121/breaking14.html>); [Evening Herald](<http://www.herald.ie/national-news/was-brian-having-a-morning-ireland-moment-with-reshuffle-2505760.html>); [Press Association](<http://www.independent.ie/national-news/cowen-facing-fresh-challenge-from-within-ff-2506101.html>); [Reuters Canada](<http://ca.reuters.com/article/topNews/idCATRE70K3X720110121>).

<a id="event-2011-01-21-5-6"></a>

Context: Situation in Ireland:.

**Archived source account.** The Irish government publishes its Finance Bill legalising harsh austerity measures announced in the December 2010 budget as attempts to overthrow Taoiseach Brian Cowen continue from within his own party.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-12253510>).

<a id="event-2011-01-21-5-7"></a>

Context: Situation in Ireland:.

**Archived source account.** Brian Cowen declares that he is to continue as leader of party and country, against the wishes of some of his own colleagues, saying "that issue is over". He vows to establish his own front bench to fight the election.

Source citations (as archived): [Irish Examiner](<http://www.irishexaminer.com/breakingnews/ireland/cowen-vows-to-continue-as-fianna-fail-leader-490289.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-21-5-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** Belarus president Alexander Lukashenko is sworn in for a fourth time following the disputed presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/worldNews/idAFTRE70K3LX20110121?sp=true>); [RIA Novosti](<http://en.rian.ru/world/20110121/162238593.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-21-5-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** British prime minister David Cameron's communications chief Andy Coulson resigns after feeling pressure over coverage of the News of the World phone hacking scandal.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-12251456>).

<a id="event-2011-01-21-5-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Aung San Suu Kyi of Burma obtains Internet access at her home in Rangoon; it is believed she has never been online.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-12252158>).

<a id="event-2011-01-21-5-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** United States Representative Gabby Giffords leaves hospital in Tucson, Arizona for rehabilitation in Houston, Texas less than two weeks after the 2011 Tucson shooting.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2011/01/21/AR2011012101899.html?wpisrc=nl_natlalert>).

### 2011-01-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076437129](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20January%2022&oldid=1076437129>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-01-22-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Malaysian navy commandos foil a ship hijack attempt by Somali pirates, rescuing 23 crew and capturing 7 pirates in the Gulf of Aden.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-12258442>).

<a id="event-2011-01-22-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** One person is killed and two others are injured in alleged Israeli tank shelling in the Gaza Strip, though the Israel Defense Forces denied they attacked and estimated that the blast was a failed rocket launch.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/01/2011122112647456348.html>); [Ynet](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4017194,00.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-22-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Several people are injured and others are arrested as police break up a pro-democracy march in Algiers.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-12258449>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2011/01/2011122105819527114.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-22-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mexico says 10 suspected drug gang members were killed in shootout with soldiers in Valle Hermoso, Tamaulipas.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.chron.com/disp/story.mpl/ap/top/all/7393525.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2011-01-22-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least two people are killed in a blaze at a shopping centre in the southwest Russian city of Ufa.

Source citations (as archived): [RIA Novosti](<http://en.rian.ru/russia/20110122/162253816.html>); [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2011/01/22/2-dead-in-Russian-shopping-mall-fire/UPI-56611295720311/>).

<a id="event-2011-01-22-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The death toll from flooding in South Africa rises to 70 and more than 8,000 families are homeless. Five other nearby countries - Botswana, Mozambique, Namibia, Zambia and Zimbabwe - are threatened by killer heavy rains.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-12258638>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2011-01-22-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Moqtada al-Sadr, an Iraqi Shia leader, returns to Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/01/201112222343680162.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2011-01-22-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Dutch national Vincent Tabak is charged with the murder of Joanna Yeates, and will make his first court appearance on 24 January.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/skynews/Home/UK-News/Joanna-Yeates-Murder-Detectives-Charge-32-Year-Old-Vincent-Tabak-With-Her-Murder/Article/201101415907665?lpos=UK_News_Carousel_Region_0&amp;lid=ARTICLE_15907665_Joanna_Yeates_Murder%3A_Detectives_Charge_32-Year-Old_Vincent_Tabak_With_Her_Murder>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-12257299>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2011-01-22-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Opposition supporters are arrested in Belarus after the swearing-in of President Alexander Lukashenko.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2011/01/2011122215316266586.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-22-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A civil society report reveals that more than a quarter of Zimbabweans on the voters' roll are deceased.

Source citations (as archived): [Times Live South Africa](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110125111518/http://www.timeslive.co.za/sundaytimes/article865749.ece/Voters-roll-in-shambles>).

<a id="event-2011-01-22-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Albania's prime minister Sali Berisha vows there will be no Tunisia-style uprising in his country after three people are killed for protesting against the government's rule.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-12258266>).

<a id="event-2011-01-22-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tunisia's prime minister Mohamed Ghannouchi promises in a TV interview to leave politics "in the shortest possible timeframe" after elections to be held following President Zine El Abidine Ben Ali's recent fall.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-12257631>).

<a id="event-2011-01-22-4-5"></a>

Context: Situation in Ireland:.

**Archived source account.** Taoiseach Brian Cowen announces he is to make a "significant" statement on his leadership of the ruling Fianna Fáil party in Dublin at 14:00, to be broadcast on television and radio.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSLDE70L06H20110122>); [RTÉ News](<https://twitter.com/rtenews/status/28805459964067840>).

<a id="event-2011-01-22-4-6"></a>

Context: Situation in Ireland:.

**Archived source account.** Brian Cowen resigns as leader of Fianna Fáil on what he describes as being "on my own counsel".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE70K3X720110122?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/jan/22/brian-cowen-full-speech-resignation>); [The Irish Times](<http://www.irishtimes.com/newspaper/breaking/2011/0122/breaking5.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-12250473>); [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2011/0122/politics.html>); [Brisbane Times](<http://news.brisbanetimes.com.au/breaking-news-world/irish-pm-cowen-quits-as-party-leader-20110123-1a0uj.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-22-4-7"></a>

Context: Situation in Ireland:.

**Archived source account.** Enda Kenny, leader of the opposition party Fine Gael, announces the party's intention to put forward a motion of no confidence in Brian Cowen on Tuesday if Cowen does not seek the immediate dissolution of Dáil Éireann. Labour also has a motion of no confidence in the Government scheduled for Wednesday, while Sinn Féin president Gerry Adams requests an immediate election.

Source citations (as archived): [The Irish Times](<http://www.irishtimes.com/newspaper/breaking/2011/0122/breaking19.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-22-4-8"></a>

Context: Situation in Ireland:.

**Archived source account.** Shadow finance spokesperson Michael Noonan promises that, if the Irish government resigns, the opposition Fine Gael party will give quicker support for the Finance Bill intended to impose harsh austerity measures upon the country. He offers to facilitate the Green Party in getting out of the Irish government coalition.

Source citations (as archived): [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2011/0122/politics1.html>).

#### Science

<a id="event-2011-01-22-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An unmanned Japanese H-II Transfer Vehicle HTV-2 Resupply Craft was launched atop the H-IIB rocket Saturday on a mission to deliver cargo to the International Space Station.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/asiapcf/01/22/japan.rocket/index.html>).

### 2011-01-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076437083](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20January%2023&oldid=1076437083>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-01-23-0-1"></a>

Context: U.S. drone attacks on Pakistan:.

**Archived source account.** A suspected U.S. drone fires two missiles at a vehicle and a house in a militant stronghold in northwestern Pakistan, killing four alleged insurgents.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5h5JSuFo9izz-ARVCS_hNUdMKNzTA?docId=9cedbd887c4e4a30a92e995ebf606590>).

<a id="event-2011-01-23-0-2"></a>

Context: U.S. drone attacks on Pakistan:.

**Archived source account.** The attacks are the first carried out by the United States on the region since Friday's protest rally highlighting civilian deaths.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia/2011/01/201112335951391718.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-23-0-3"></a>

Context: U.S. drone attacks on Pakistan:.

**Archived source account.** Tribesmen march in their numbers in Mir Ali, North Waziristan to demand an end to U.S. drone strikes in the area, the second such march inside three days.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2011-01/23/c_13703670.htm>).

<a id="event-2011-01-23-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Egyptian authorities blame the Gaza-based Army of Islam group for an attack on a Coptic Christian church in Alexandria on 1 January.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/01/201112311414915283.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-23-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Australian SAS Corporal Ben Roberts-Smith is awarded the Victoria Cross for gallantry in action in the offensive in the Shah Wali Kot region in Afghanistan in June 2010.

Source citations (as archived): [The Sydney Morning Herald](<http://news.smh.com.au/breaking-news-national/sas-corporal-extremely-humbled-to-get-vc-20110123-1a11m.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-12261427>).

<a id="event-2011-01-23-0-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Somali pirates threaten to kill all hostage South Korean seamen in revenge for the killing of pirates by South Koreans.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSLDE70M01O20110123>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2011-01-23-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Actress Zsa Zsa Gabor is permitted to leave hospital and return home, eight days after undergoing the amputation of her right leg.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/entertainment-arts-12261798>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2011-01-23-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Philippe Henri Dacoury-Tabley, head of the West African Economic and Monetary Union, announces his resignation.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2011/01/201112305931795650.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-23-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Google is to give $100million to Eric Schmidt, an outgoing CEO.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE70M1V120110123>); [The Wall Street Journal](<http://online.wsj.com/article/SB10001424052748704624504576098070086282958.html>).

#### Disasters

<a id="event-2011-01-23-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The death toll in Brazil's worst flood disaster tops 800 people.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-12263166>).

<a id="event-2011-01-23-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Dominican Republic officially registers its first cholera death since the launch of the 2010 Haiti cholera outbreak.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-12263115>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2011-01-23-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Talks between Iran and the five permanent members of the UN Security Council plus Germany break down without an agreement to end the eight-year-old impasse over Iran's nuclear program, after Iranian officials refused to negotiate unless preconditions including an immediate halt to UN sanctions on Iran were met.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2011/01/22/AR2011012203405.html>); [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/middleeast/iran/8275969/Iran-nuclear-talks-break-down-sparking-fears-of-showdown-over-regimes-pursuit-of-atomic-weapons.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-23-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The BBC apologises after offending the sensibilities of Japanese viewers by broadcasting jokes targeting Tsutomu Yamaguchi, who survived both atomic bomb attacks carried out by the United States on Hiroshima and Nagasaki in 1945.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/entertainment-arts-12260577>).

<a id="event-2011-01-23-4-3"></a>

Context: WikiLeaks revelations:.

**Archived source account.** A "spy" computer is found in an office next to Icelandic MP Birgitta Jonsdottir who has been the target in the United States Department of Justice/Twitter case concerning the WikiLeaks website.

Source citations (as archived): [Iceland Review](<http://www.icelandreview.com/icelandreview/daily_news/?cat_id=29314&amp;ew_0_a_id=372760>).

<a id="event-2011-01-23-4-4"></a>

Context: WikiLeaks revelations:.

**Archived source account.** Nearly two months after the WikiLeaks website launched the release of U.S. diplomatic cables, the total amount released stands at just over 1 per cent of its trove.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5ggpxibR0mh2R2vgOXoffZdzr3oVw?docId=24f4f03080a14793ab890fa87baa1f66>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2011/01/23/AR2011012301084.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-23-4-5"></a>

Context: WikiLeaks revelations:.

**Archived source account.** Speaking in Der Sonntag, WikiLeaks spokesperson Julian Assange criticises the arrest of a Swiss bank employee who passed on details of tax evasion to the website and suggests that the Swiss authorities ought to instead investigate the tax evasion that has been uncovered. Rudolf Elmer has been detained for the weekend.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE70K4GT20110123>).

<a id="event-2011-01-23-4-7"></a>

Context: The Palestine Papers.

**Archived source account.** The largest ever release of confidential files in the history of the Israeli–Palestinian conflict, are released.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/palestinepapers/2011/01/201112214310263628.html>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/jan/23/palestine-papers-expose-peace-concession>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/MiddleEast/Article.aspx?id=204914>).

<a id="event-2011-01-23-4-8"></a>

Context: The Palestine Papers.

**Archived source account.** The Palestinian Authority condemns Al- Jazeera for releasing the documents and denies that the Palestinian Authority had agreed to make far-reaching concessions on Jerusalem as the documents purportedly reveal.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/MiddleEast/Article.aspx?id=204916>).

<a id="event-2011-01-23-4-10"></a>

Context: Israeli inquiry into the Gaza flotilla raid:.

**Archived source account.** An Israeli inquiry finds its own army acts "legal pursuant to the rules of international law" during May's fatal Gaza flotilla raid in which 9 Turkish activists were killed; a separate United Nations inquiry said there had been an "unacceptable level of brutality". The inquiry also declares Israel's naval blockade of Gaza to be legal.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/DiplomacyAndPolitics/Article.aspx?id=204858>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-12260983>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/01/20111238232857676.html>); [The Irish Times](<http://www.irishtimes.com/newspaper/breaking/2011/0123/breaking10.html>); [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5ggJP6H7igMkfEEjpW97JXHjN6ykA?docId=CNG.0974f2ca1c91adea909b6017dc4d554e.7d1>).

<a id="event-2011-01-23-4-11"></a>

Context: Israeli inquiry into the Gaza flotilla raid:.

**Archived source account.** The Prime Minister of Turkey says that the results of the Israeli inquiry into the raid have no value or credibility.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/news/diplomacy-defense/palestinian-killed-after-settlers-open-fire-in-west-bank-village-1.339749?localLinksEnabled=false>).

<a id="event-2011-01-27-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A small explosion occurs in the basement of a hotel in Davos, Switzerland, close to where the World Economic Forum is taking place. No one is injured and a boiler is blamed.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE70Q2Q920110127>); [Channel News Asia](<http://www.channelnewsasia.com/stories/afp_world/view/1107304/1/.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2011-01-27-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iran's state-run news channel Press TV's account is frozen by National Westminster Bank in the UK; no reason was given. (

Source citations (as archived): [AFP)](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5g24PklvrgnE7HmfPis3uomNU_PYg?docId=CNG.32ed027d9136847068e1420850fb9209.fe1>); [Zee News](<http://www.zeenews.com/news683454.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-27-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Internet retailer Overstock.com has amended its complaint in a long-standing lawsuit against Goldman Sachs and Merrill Lynch to demand treble damages under New Jersey's racketeering statute. Merrill Lynch is a subsidiary of Bank of America.

Source citations (as archived): [Press Release](<https://web.archive.org/web/20160204225939/http://investors.overstock.com/phoenix.zhtml?c=131091&amp;p=irol-newsArticle&amp;ID=1521175&amp;highlight=>).

<a id="event-2011-01-27-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Giant media conglomerate News Corp. says it will launch a digital newspaper as content of Apple's iPad, on 2 February. This is a later launch date than many had expected.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE70Q6M820110127>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2011-01-27-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ten construction workers die after falling from the 28th floor of a skyscraper being built in Manila, the Philippine capital.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5iNsipQcwjDPVQW2XIXUVMOh2pphg?docId=CNG.4bf876aedad10423b2ba2a9c7e0cdc33.671>); [AFP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110310162106/http://en.www.info.vn/world-and-region/asia-and-asian/18650-10-die-in-fall-from-philippine-skyscraper-.html>); [The Straits Times](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110129002023/http://www.straitstimes.com/BreakingNews/SEAsia/Story/STIStory_628891.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-27-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Australian government proposes a new "flood tax" to raise funds for reconstruction work following severe flooding in the east of the country.

Source citations (as archived): [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/in-depth/queensland-floods/flood-victims-and-low-paid-to-be-exempt-from-flood-levy/story-fn7iwx3v-1225995437524>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia-pacific/2011/01/20111277522459971.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2011-01-27-3-1"></a>

Context: Murder of David Kato:.

**Archived source account.** Ugandan gay rights activist David Kato, who was named in tabloid paper Rolling Stone last year, is found murdered.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/africa/01/27/uganda.gay.activist.killed/>); [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5jtWRJ29m6GwDbZeTjxUWui0iaSUQ?docId=CNG.4bf876aedad10423b2ba2a9c7e0cdc33.5f1>); [The Irish Times](<http://www.irishtimes.com/newspaper/world/2011/0128/1224288457254.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-27-3-2"></a>

Context: Murder of David Kato:.

**Archived source account.** Rolling Stone says it has "no regrets about the story" and claims to be "just exposing people who were doing wrong".

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/jan/27/uganda-paper-david-kato-death>).

<a id="event-2011-01-27-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of thousands of government workers protest against the killing of Yashwant Sonawane, an official in Maharashtra, a murder which is said to have shocked people across India.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-south-asia-12295509>).

<a id="event-2011-01-27-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Macau tycoon Stanley Ho is to sue relatives accused of trying to steal his vast casino empire.

Source citations (as archived): [Macau News](<http://www.macaunews.com.mo/index.php?option=com_content&amp;task=view&amp;id=1181&amp;Itemid=45>); [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5gO5xiMEXysr22hNqrZPIlOGTt_5g?docId=CNG.4bf876aedad10423b2ba2a9c7e0cdc33.711>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE70Q3ED20110127>).

<a id="event-2011-01-27-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court in Botswana rules that indigenous Bushmen can drill wells for water in the Kalahari Desert.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-12300285>); [Gabz FM Botswana](<http://www.gabzfm.com/index.php?option=com_content&amp;view=article&amp;id=4004:basarwa-news&amp;catid=39:news&amp;Itemid=57>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2011-01-27-4-1"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Unrest in Egypt enters its third day.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-12294804>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/01/201112734210243448.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-27-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** More than 1,000 people are arrested.

<a id="event-2011-01-27-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tens of thousands of people protest in the Yemeni capital Sana'a calling for an end to the government of President Ali Abdullah Saleh.

Source citations (as archived): [Press TV](<http://www.presstv.ir/detail/162218.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-27-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Lebanese prime minister Najib Mikati begins consultations on forming a new government.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5jwEVpFZ-NXj3jEScB1BAuJ8Jlhww?docId=CNG.54f8a5486ee9404d5a4fa50d7aa2cd57.a1>).

<a id="event-2011-01-27-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A fifth outbreak of bird flu occurs in Japan, with a cull of 150,000 chickens underway.
