### 2011-01-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1209462416](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20January%2028&oldid=1209462416>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-01-28-0-1"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** After the Egyptian government censorship of social media websites (such as Twitter, Facebook and Google), internet access and SMS networks are cut off in response to anti-government protests.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian (about censoring)](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/jan/26/egypt-blocks-social-media-websites>); [The Guardian (about cutting off internet)](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/technology/2011/jan/28/egypt-cuts-off-internet-access>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/01/2011128796164380.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-0-2"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Fresh protests take place across the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/01/201112810059478272.html>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/news/blog/2011/jan/28/egypt-protests-live-updates>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-12303564>); [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/africaandindianocean/egypt/8288167/Egypt-protests-live.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-0-3"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Police target protesters in Cairo with tear gas and water cannon, while tear gas is used on protesters in Alexandria.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/news/blog/2011/jan/28/egypt-protests-live-updates#block-22>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-0-4"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** A protester is killed in Suez, while dozens of protesters are injured in Cairo. One protester happens to video-tape a man being shot by police.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/skynews/Home/World-News/Egypt-Thousands-Protest-As-Communication-Lines-Disrupted/Article/201101415914646?lpos=World_News_Top_Stories_Header_0&amp;lid=ARTICLE_15914646_Egypt%3A_Thousands_Protest_As_Communication_Lines_Disrupted>); [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110129022051/http://video.ap.org/?f=None&amp;pid=oT7qj_wiVHTbYae3scwok4_irYjJ2R8Z>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-0-5"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** The Egyptian government announces a curfew for cities nationwide starting at 6 pm local time and running through to 7 am on Saturday.

Source citations (as archived): [Bikya Masr](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110131025832/http://bikyamasr.com/wordpress/?p=24874>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-0-6"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Mubarak orders the army into the streets as buildings and police vehicles burn.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/africaandindianocean/egypt/8289616/Egypt-protests-President-Mubarak-sends-in-the-army-to-Egypts-burning-streets.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-0-7"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** The army is reported to be out on the streets of Cairo; protesters call for the support of the army in their battle against the Mubarak regime.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/01/2011128151048463975.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-0-8"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Mohamed ElBaradei, is held among the protesters, while journalists are beaten and arrested, including one BBC journalist and four French reporters.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/africaandindianocean/egypt/8288167/Egypt-protests-live.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-0-9"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Reuters reports at least 870 injuries in Cairo alone during the day, according to medical sources.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110202000302/http://www.forexpros.com/news/general-news/total-wounded-in-cairo-protests-during-day-870---medical-sources-190644>); [Al-Masry Al-Youm](<http://www.almasryalyoum.com/en/news/egypt-hospitals-report-860-injured-egyptair-cancels-flights>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-0-10"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** At least eight deaths are reported.

Source citations (as archived): [DAWN](<http://www.dawn.com/2011/01/29/at-least-five-dead-in-cairo-protests-sources.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-0-11"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** EgyptAir suspends its departures from Cairo for 12 hours, beginning at 9 pm, as a government-imposed curfew on the people of Egypt comes into effect.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5j_HtoUpZESmxi29XQuPSArRleeAg?docId=16db91b173054d869328330f9803a85b>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-0-12"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** NDP headquarters are set on fire in Cairo, with Al Jazeera footage showing the building ablaze.

Source citations (as archived): [iloubnan.info](<http://www.iloubnan.info/politics/actualite/id/55191/titre/Egypt:-NDP-ruling-party-headquarters-set-on-fire-in-Cairo>); [The Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/middle-east/Egypt-ruling-party-HQ-ablaze-after-protests/articleshow/7380969.cms>); [USA Today](<http://content.usatoday.com/communities/ondeadline/post/2011/01/watch-aljazeera-live-coverage-of-egyptian-protests-in-english/1>); [Irish Examiner](<http://www.examiner.ie/breakingnews/world/protestors-set-fire-to-ruling-party-headquarters-in-egypt-491226.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-0-13"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** The same fire threatens the nearby world-famous Egyptian Museum, with concerns expressed for the safety of its contents. A powerful explosion is heard in the area. There are reports that protesters are trying to protect the museum.

Source citations (as archived): [RIA Novosti](<http://en.rian.ru/world/20110128/162357405.html>); [Milwaukee Journal Sentinel](<http://www.jsonline.com/blogs/entertainment/114812174.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-0-14"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** President Mubarak calls on the government to resign, but gives no indication that he will stand down.,

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://news.blogs.cnn.com/2011/01/28/clashes-erupt-in-cairo-elbaradei-told-to-stay-put-cnn-camera-confiscated/?hpt=T1&amp;iref=BN1>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-11777943>); [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2011/01/25/AR2011012500866.html?hpid=topnews>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-0-16"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests: / International response to the 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** International politicians, including William Hague and Hillary Clinton, speak out in support of the aims of the protesters and ask the Mubarak regime to listen to the people.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-12310266>); [The Wall Street Journal](<http://blogs.wsj.com/dispatch/2011/01/28/clinton-says-egypt-must-listen-to-people/>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-0-17"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests: / International response to the 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Vice President of the United States Joe Biden attracts criticism for his refusal to refer to Mubarak as a "dictator", instead describing him as "an ally of ours in a number of things and he's been very responsible on, relative to geopolitical interests in the region: Middle East peace efforts, the actions Egypt has taken relative to normalizing the relationship with Israel".

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<http://opinionator.blogs.nytimes.com/2011/01/28/how-do-you-solve-a-problem-like-mubarak/>); [The Washington Post](<http://voices.washingtonpost.com/right-turn/2011/01/obama_blowing_it_again_in_the.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-0-18"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests: / International response to the 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** The protests leave Western governments which have supported the regime in an awkward position, both diplomatically and democratically.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/topNews/idAFJOE70R0OZ20110128>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-0-19"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests: / International response to the 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** The latest U.S. diplomatic cables released by WikiLeaks indicate that police brutality in Egypt is "routine and pervasive" and the use of torture so widespread that the Egyptian government has stopped denying it exists.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/jan/28/egypt-police-brutality-torture-wikileaks>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-0-20"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests: / International response to the 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Further cables reveal the Obama administration wished to maintain its close political and military relationship with Egyptian leader Hosni Mubarak and its belief that Mubarak would "inevitably win" yet another presidential election in 2011.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/jan/28/wikileaks-cairo-cables-egypt-president>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-0-21"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests: / International response to the 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Demonstrations occur worldwide, with people expressing solidarity with the people of Egypt in international cities such as Istanbul, Tunis, Doha and London.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2011/01/201112815843772129.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-0-22"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests: / International response to the 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** The government-imposed curfew on the people of Egypt causes European airlines, including British Airways, Lufthansa and Air France, to alter their schedules, with some cancellations and some passengers being redirected to different countries.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/2011/01/28/uk-egypt-airlines-idUKTRE70R75X20110128>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-0-23"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people take to the streets of Jordan for the third consecutive Friday of protests over inflation, unemployment and rising prices, amid demands for the resignation of Prime Minister Samir Rifai.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/01/2011128125157509196.html>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/MiddleEast/Article.aspx?id=205641>); [The Financial Times](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110130004859/http://www.ft.com/cms/s/0/01325d1a-2ae4-11e0-a2f3-00144feab49a.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-0-24"></a>

**Archived source account.** Key ministers from the heavily criticised ousted government of Zine El Abidine Ben Ali are replaced but interim Tunisian prime minister Mohammed Ghannouchi refuses to back down in the face of public anger.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/01/201112720356405308.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-0-25"></a>

**Archived source account.** Around 100,000 supporters of Albania's opposition Socialist Party pay silent tribute to three men shot dead at an anti-government protest a week ago. The Socialist supporters disperse calmly after a two-hour procession.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/01/28/us-albania-idUSTRE70R62A20110128>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-0-26"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police fire tear gas at anti-government protesters in Gabon two days after opposition leader André Mba Obame declares himself president.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/topNews/idAFJOE70R01I20110128?sp=true>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-0-27"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least four people, including Modu Fannami Gubio, a former opposition All Nigeria Peoples Party (ANPP) candidate for governor in Borno, Nigeria, are shot dead in Maiduguri.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-12310536>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-0-28"></a>

**Archived source account.** During a clash between Palestinians and Israeli settlers in the West Bank, an Israeli settler shoots and kills an 18-year-old Palestinian.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/news/diplomacy-defense/palestinian-killed-after-settlers-open-fire-in-west-bank-village-1.339749?localLinksEnabled=false>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-12300086>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/meast/01/27/west.bank.death/index.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-0-29"></a>

**Archived source account.** 8 people are killed in a suicide attack at a Finest supermarket near the British embassy in the wealthy Wazir Akbar Khan suburb of Kabul.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-south-asia-12307463>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia/2011/01/2011128131933750123.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2011-01-28-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The German film agency FSK (Voluntary Self-Regulation of the Movie Industry) permits the showing of the reportedly anti-Israel and anti-Semitic Turkish film, Valley of the Wolves: Palestine, with an over 18 age restriction, saying it contains “propaganda tendencies” and “repetitive violence.” The film, based on events surrounding last May's Gaza flotilla raid, has opened in cinemas in Turkey and Austria.

Source citations (as archived): [The Canadian Press](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/canadianpress/article/ALeqM5h644s36e4-43BQDqfuYA1a22YbPg?docId=5785576>); [Hürriyet](<http://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/n.php?n=8216valley-of-the-wolves-palestine8217-released-2011-01-28>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/film/2011/jan/28/turkish-flotilla-film-holocaust-day-germany>); [Press TV](<http://www.presstv.ir/detail/162391.html>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/International/Article.aspx?id=205596>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 450-year-old Madonna and Child work sells for $16.9 million at Sotheby's in New York, a new auction record for Titian.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/entertainment-arts-12305296>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2011-01-28-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Japan's national credit rating is dropped to AA- by Standard &amp; Poor's.

Source citations (as archived): [BusinessWeek](<http://www.businessweek.com/news/2011-01-27/japan-s-credit-rating-cut-to-aa-by-s-p-on-debt-load.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** China introduces its first property tax in Shanghai and Chongqing.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5inXlzpzg6CWT0X_86DE0H-0R7o-A?docId=CNG.d181f701d74575a4927d78a53b5b7ce3.651>); [Global Times](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110205162259/http://business.globaltimes.cn/industries/2011-01/617867.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-12304990>).

#### Disasters

<a id="event-2011-01-28-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 17 people are killed and scores are injured during a fire on a ferry and a collision between two passenger trains on the island of Java in Indonesia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-12304419>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia/2011/01/201112841226405549.html>); [AP](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/jan/28/indonesian-ferry-fire-java-island-sumatra>); [AFP](<http://www.asianage.com/international/13-dead-after-indonesian-ferry-blaze-520>); [News24](<http://www.news24.com/World/News/Indonesia-Deadly-ferry-fire-train-crash-20110128>); [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2011-01/28/c_13710642.htm>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** President of Brazil Dilma Rousseff, speaking at a joint press conference with Rio de Janeiro state governor Sérgio Cabral, vows to build 8,000 houses to be given free to people made homeless by the recent floods and landslides in Rio de Janeiro state.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-12303930>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of people attend an event at Kennedy Space Center in the U.S. state of Florida to mark the 25th anniversary of the Space Shuttle Challenger disaster.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-12302960>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 11 passengers of the Lautan Teduh ferry, which caught fire in the Sunda Strait, have been confirmed dead. The remains of nine of the passengers who died in the fire were taken to Krakatau Medika in Cilegon, while the other two were taken to Kalianda Hospital in Lampung.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jakarta Post](<http://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2011/01/28/death-toll-sunda-strait-ferry-fire-soars-11.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Flooding in Jeddah since the 26th kills 11 people, leaves three missing and destroys over 10,000 buildings, leading to protests in the city over poor infrastructure.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5i4_-39fbqAlBiVS5zTYCoFj8oG_A?docId=CNG.1b324d261b1d70e46050b731e6c7d0f3.fc1>); [Montreal Gazette](<https://montrealgazette.com/news/Flood+sparks+rare+action/4189873/story.html>); [GMA News](<http://www.gmanews.tv/story/211788/filipino-among-fatalities-in-jeddah-floods>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2011-01-28-4-1"></a>

Context: Murder of David Kato:.

**Archived source account.** The funeral is held in a village near Kampala for David Kato, a gay rights activist in Uganda. He was recently murdered after successfully suing Rolling Stone for naming him as gay on its front cover, and had been receiving death threats. A pastor causes controversy by preaching for homosexuals to repent but is swiftly taken away.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-12306077>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/africa/01/28/uganda.gay.activist/>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-4-2"></a>

Context: Murder of David Kato:.

**Archived source account.** OSISA and SALC condemn the murder of David Kato.

Source citations (as archived): [Zambian Watchdog](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110202080159/http://www.zambianwatchdog.com/2011/01/28/osisa-salc-condemn-murder-of-uganda-gay-activist/>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-4-3"></a>

Context: Murder of David Kato:.

**Archived source account.** A lesbian from Uganda, whom the UK wishes to deport to Kampala, speaks of her concerns that she will be persecuted upon her arrival there.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-12306975>); [audio](<http://www.bbc.co.uk/worldservice/africa/2011/01/110128_ugandaasylum.shtml>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Daily Telegraph reports that the American government secretly backed leading figures behind the unfolding Egyptian uprising.

Source citations (as archived): [The Vancouver Sun](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110303162256/http://www.vancouversun.com/technology/America+secret+backing+behind+Egyptian+uprising/4183120/story.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Turkey's foreign minister Ahmet Davutoğlu expresses concerns that Israel's report into its own commando operation resulting in the Gaza flotilla raid is "neither credible nor unbiased", he tells a news conference before departing for Montenegro.

Source citations (as archived): [Hürriyet](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110908083318/http://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/n.php?n=israeli-report-not-independent-it-is-netanyahu-report-says-fm-2011-01-28>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Enda Kenny and Michael Noonan of Ireland's (opposition) Fine Gael party meet the President of the European Commission José Manuel Barroso in Brussels. The pair are believed to be protesting against the terms of the country's recent financial bailout from the EU/IMF.

Source citations (as archived): [Irish Independent](<http://www.independent.ie/national-news/kenny-urges-eu-to-cut-interest-rate-on-bailout-2514708.html>); [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2011/0128/economy.html>); [The Wall Street Journal](<http://online.wsj.com/article/BT-CO-20110128-712248.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2011-01-28-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Chinese authorities offer no response to requests by jailed dissident and Nobel peace laureate Liu Xiaobo for family visits.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Asia](<http://www.rfa.org/english/news/china/visit-01282011110529.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A U.S. official appears in court charged with the murder of two motorcyclists shot dead in Lahore, Pakistan. He may be executed if found guilty.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-south-asia-12305049>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Rwandan rebel leader Callixte Mbarushimana appears before war crimes judges in The Hague. He denies any involvement in the charges laid against him.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-12307593>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Colombia asks Israel to extradite former Israeli army Lt. Col. Yair Klein, who was convicted by a Colombian court in absentia for training drug lords' assassins in the 1980s.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5h75FQrj8dya-QlyS0G9FE3fWnuVg?docId=ed08824f0d334eff96d2167f381ec6b8>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/ArtsAndCulture/Entertainment/Article.aspx?id=205572>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Guillermo Fariñas, known for his hunger strike campaigns, is detained by authorities for the second time in as many days. He is being held in the Cuban city of Santa Clara.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-12310100>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2011-01-28-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former President of South Africa Nelson Mandela is discharged from hospital following two days of tests.

Source citations (as archived): [IOL](<http://www.iol.co.za/news/south-africa/gauteng/mandela-back-home-1.1018332>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-12306753>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2011/01/201112874410168278.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Taoiseach Brian Cowen promises to dissolve Dáil Éireann next Tuesday and to announce the date of the Irish general election, 2011.

Source citations (as archived): [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2011/0128/politics.html>); [The Wall Street Journal](<http://online.wsj.com/article/BT-CO-20110128-711012.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** North Korean leader Kim Jong-il's eldest son Kim Jong-nam says his father opposed the hereditary transfer of power, but did so to ensure stability.

Source citations (as archived): [Yonhap](<http://english.yonhapnews.co.kr/northkorea/2011/01/28/94/0401000000AEN20110128003800315F.HTML>); [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5jLq0EGmURcax3pCvyrKWjp2Vofew?docId=CNG.d181f701d74575a4927d78a53b5b7ce3.61>).

<a id="event-2011-01-28-6-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Burma's highest court upholds the dissolution of Aung San Suu Kyi's National League for Democracy party.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-12307838>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia-pacific/2011/01/201112810011211387.html>).

### 2011-01-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1229618829](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20January%2029&oldid=1229618829>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-01-29-0-1"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** The protests continue as Egyptian Army tanks surround Cairo's Tahrir Square.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://news.blogs.cnn.com/2011/01/29/protests-continue-as-tanks-roll-into-cairos-tahrir-square/>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/01/201112974149942894.html>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/jan/29/egypt-protests-government-live-blog>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-0-2"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of demonstrators converge on Egypt's Interior Ministry, one of the most visible signs of state authority in Egypt. Police shoot the demonstrators. Medical aid is given at the doors of mosques.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/africa/01/29/egypt.interior.ministry.scene/>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-0-3"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Five protesters are reported to have been wounded at the Interior Ministry.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/01/29/uk-egypt-ministry-idUKTRE70S1VI20110129>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-0-4"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** At least 100 people are killed and 1,000 injured in clashes so far.,

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/topNews/idAFJOE70S00320110129?sp=true>); [NineMSN](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110131230120/http://news.ninemsn.com.au/world/8203657/at-least-62-dead-in-egypt-protests>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-0-5"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Omar Suleiman is sworn in as Vice President of Egypt, the first person to hold the office under President Hosni Mubarak, who has reigned for 30 years.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/news/international/egypt-swears-in-new-pm-intel-chief-appointed-vice-president-1.339974>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-0-6"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Mubarak selects Ahmed Shafiq, a former air force commander and aviation minister, as his new prime minister, preserving the top three political jobs for men with military links.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/01/29/egypt-government-idUSLDE70S0GI20110129>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-0-7"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** The parliament speaker says Egypt has no plans for early elections despite the mass popular demonstrations against the government.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/01/29/egypt-speaker-election-idUSLDE70S0H620110129>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-0-8"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Wealthy Egyptian businessman Ahmed Ezz, a close confidante of Mubarak's son, resigns from the ruling NDP party. At least one of his steel company's offices has been targeted by protesters.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/01/29/egypt-politician-idUSLDE70S0C720110129>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-0-9"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** A curfew is extended from 16:00 until 8:00 Egyptian time according to state television.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/middle-east/Egypt-curfew-hours-extended-State-TV/articleshow/7385124.cms>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-0-10"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Suzanne Mubarak, the wife of President Hosni Mubarak and First Lady of Egypt, is reported to have fled to London.

Source citations (as archived): [Ynetnews](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4020764,00.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-0-11"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** The police disappear from the streets of Cairo but civilians fill the void by quickly forming groups to defend homes and important buildings.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/egyptNews/idAFLDE70S0LN20110129>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-0-12"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** 19 private jets carrying families of wealthy businessmen leave Cairo for Dubai.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/jan/29/egypt-protests-government-live-blog#block-67>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-0-14"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests: / Egyptian Museum during the riots:.

**Archived source account.** Head of antiquities Zahi Hawass says ancient artifacts at the famous Egyptian Museum in Cairo are safe from looters but could still be damaged by the potential collapse of NDP headquarters which was gutted by fire yesterday.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5gGiADb4YzqsC_nlgj5gkFPvXl7RA?docId=3944f4eda7c64f4c9449a7c017d6e281>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-0-15"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests: / Egyptian Museum during the riots:.

**Archived source account.** Two mummies housed at the Egyptian Museum are destroyed and statues are broken into pieces, though ordinary citizens unite to prevent further destruction. The vandals are reported to have been convicts who escaped amid the protests.

Source citations (as archived): [Al-Masry Al-Youm](<http://www.almasryalyoum.com/en/news/vandals-ravage-egyptian-museum-break-mummies>); [Gadling](<http://www.gadling.com/2011/01/29/rioters-destroy-two-mummies-in-egyptian-museum-in-cairo/>); [Press TV](<http://www.presstv.ir/detail/162597.html>); [The Voice of Russia](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110131092817/http://english.ruvr.ru/2011/01/29/41894351.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-0-16"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests: / Egyptian Museum during the riots:.

**Archived source account.** Young people in Egypt form a human chain to protect the Egyptian Museum from further attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [Herald Sun](<http://www.heraldsun.com.au/ipad/egyptians-form-chain-around-museum-to-protect-king-tut/story-fn6s850w-1225996801338>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-0-18"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests: / International response to the 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Viewers across the region and worldwide watch events unfold on Al Jazeera, which maintains an almost continuous live feed despite the Egyptian government's repeated censorship efforts. CNN claims its reporters have been attacked and cameras smashed.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2011/01/29/world/middleeast/29jazeera.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-0-19"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests: / International response to the 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** The BBC condemns the treatment given to one of its reporters, who has been deliberately assaulted by police while doing his work in Cairo. He was beaten up with steel bars, "the ones used here for slaughtering animals".

Source citations (as archived): [Ynetnews](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4020838,00.html>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/media/greenslade/2011/jan/28/journalist-safety-egypt>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-0-20"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests: / International response to the 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** China blocks searches for "Egypt" on its internet and restricts media coverage.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia-pacific/2011/01/201112991712140318.html>); [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5jouZpFFMjFynq1IYbEUDeba-qCqQ?docId=CNG.67623850a684b3db3f7388147dd9cea7.1b1>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-0-21"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests: / International response to the 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Protesters gather outside the Egyptian embassy in London calling for Mubarak to resign.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/egyptNews/idAFLDE70S0DH20110129>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-0-22"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests: / International response to the 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Protesters gather outside the Egyptian embassy in Amman in support of "the people of Egypt" and calling on the United States: "do not interfere".

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5gvQYtAaLnP2tn1zP-PmAF14GDF-g?docId=CNG.e879b80d1011df0465e895c1c65e4e6d.6c1>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-0-23"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests: / International response to the 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Protesters gather outside the Egyptian embassy in Washington, D.C., with the organisers saying they want the people of Egypt to know that Americans are watching and aware of events in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<http://voices.washingtonpost.com/local-breaking-news/dc/protest-planned-at-egyptian-em.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-0-24"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests: / International response to the 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** People gather in historic Harvard Square in Cambridge, Massachusetts in the United States to peacefully protest against the Mubarak regime. They wave Egyptian flags, hold up signs, chant for Mubarak's resignation and call for an end to cell phone and Internet censorship perpetrated by the Egyptian government.

Source citations (as archived): [Boston Herald](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110201014326/http://news.bostonherald.com/news/regional/view/20110129around_200_gather_in_harvard_square_for_egypt_protest/>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-0-25"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests: / International response to the 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people gather in front of the United Nations in New York City to support the anti-government protests.

Source citations (as archived): [The Star-Ledger](<http://www.nj.com/news/index.ssf/2011/01/thousands_gather_in_new_york_c.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-0-26"></a>

**Archived source account.** 2011 Yemeni protests: Clashes take place outside the Egyptian embassy between supporters of President Ali Abdullah Saleh's government and opposition supporters expressing sympathy with the situation in Egypt.

Source citations (as archived): [One India](<https://web.archive.org/web/20121008170520/http://news.oneindia.in/2011/01/29/protestorsand-government-supporters-clash-inyemen-aid0126.html>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/meast/01/29/yemen.protests/>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/01/2011129112626339573.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-0-27"></a>

**Archived source account.** 2011 English protests: Thousands of protesters demonstrate against cuts and increases in tuition fees in England; police escort student leader Aaron Porter away in Manchester amid calls from protesters for his resignation.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/education/2011/jan/29/student-protesters-nus-president>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-0-28"></a>

**Archived source account.** Investigators in Russia say they have discovered the identities of those responsible for the bombing at Domodedovo International Airport in Moscow.

Source citations (as archived): [RIA Novosti](<http://en.rian.ru/russia/20110129/162365499.html>); [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5gRaQqXkY2-MD72Z_w4tLcqRJ3HgQ?docId=CNG.e879b80d1011df0465e895c1c65e4e6d.2c1>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-0-30"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–present):.

**Archived source account.** Abdul Latif Ashna, the deputy governor of Afghanistan's Kandahar Province, is killed in a suicide attack.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-south-asia-12314646>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-0-31"></a>

**Archived source account.** Clashes between rebels and government forces in Somalia leave several civilians dead in the capital Mogadishu.

Source citations (as archived): [CP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/canadianpress/article/ALeqM5gIxTG5XSSc-ER6y-Mt6Kgor3jfWQ?docId=5796649>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2011-01-29-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** China begins the first test flights of private helicopters in its airspace.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5g4NJlZPhVsfshWbNkfNA9eQgP7YA?docId=CNG.e879b80d1011df0465e895c1c65e4e6d.f1>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Wall Street firm Goldman Sachs triples the base salary of its chief executive Lloyd Blankfein to $2 million, up from $600,000, after the bank's profit falls by 38 per cent.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-12316309>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Close to 8,000 protesters rally in Hamilton, Ontario to support workers locked out from Stelco after disagreeing against pension changes made by U.S. Steel. Analysts predict that similar protests may spread across the country.

Source citations (as archived): [CTV](<http://www.ctv.ca/CTVNews/Canada/20110129/hamilton-labour-rally-110229/>); [Niagara Falls Review](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110724085218/http://www.niagarafallsreview.ca/ArticleDisplay.aspx?e=2953771>).

#### Disasters

<a id="event-2011-01-29-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least ten people die after a passenger train collides with a goods train in the German state of Saxony-Anhalt near the city of Magdeburg.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-12082035>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2011/01/201113051516217123.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2011-01-29-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The African Union sets up a panel of heads of state to help solve the political crisis in Côte d'Ivoire.

Source citations (as archived): [PANA](<http://www.panapress.com/African-leaders-selected-for-panel-on-Cote-d-ivoire-crisis--15-755649-30-lang2-index.html>); [RFI](<http://www.english.rfi.fr/africa/20110129-african-union-set-cote-divoire-panel>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The UK gives a lesbian from Uganda an injunction to temporarily prevent her deportation to the country where gay activist David Kato was murdered earlier this week.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-12311319>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-3-2"></a>

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2011-01-29-4-0"></a>

<a id="event-2011-01-29-5-0"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-northern-ireland-12316883>); [The Irish Times](<http://www.irishtimes.com/newspaper/breaking/2011/0129/breaking5.html>); [Irish Examiner](<http://www.irishexaminer.com/breakingnews/ireland/finance-bill-passes-final-hurdle-491369.html>); [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2011/0129/financebill.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-12312559>); [One India](<https://web.archive.org/web/20121008170853/http://news.oneindia.in/2011/01/29/suukyi-appeals-for-democracy-growth-in-myanmar-atdavos-aid0126.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-29-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Students and union members stage protest marches in London and Manchester against increases in tuition fees and public spending cuts in the United Kingdom.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/education-12315841>).

### 2011-01-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1229618843](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20January%2030&oldid=1229618843>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-01-30-0-1"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Demonstrations against the government, in which more than 150 people have been killed and over 4,000 injured, continue.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://blogs.aljazeera.net/middle-east/2011/01/29/live-blog-301-egypt-protests>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/news/blog/2011/jan/30/egypt-protests-live-updates>); [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/middle_east/9381309.stm>); [RIA Novosti](<http://en.rian.ru/world/20110130/162378764.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-30-0-2"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Egypt's information minister cancels licenses and accreditation of staff working for the Al Jazeera international news network. The network's Cairo bureau office is to be shut down by the Egyptian government. An Al Jazeera spokesman describes the move as "an act designed to stifle and repress the freedom of reporting by the network and its journalists".

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5id8rChuZ08bB6QYD5wIytvv8Jypg?docId=CNG.fae0da60412a671e262f1f5567c43dbb.d1>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/jan/30/egypt-shuts-down-al-jazeera-operations>); [RIA Novosti](<http://en.rian.ru/world/20110130/162376880.html>); [Times LIVE](<http://www.timeslive.co.za/africa/article882834.ece/Egypt-switches-off-Al-Jazeera>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/01/201113085252994161.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-30-0-3"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Al Jazeera English is unavailable by cable television across most of the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [The Huffington Post](<http://www.huffingtonpost.com/2011/01/30/al-jazeera-english-us_n_816030.html>); [Al Jazeera coverage](<http://english.aljazeera.net/watchaje/20091022172112636517.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-30-0-4"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** More than 10 people are killed in fresh clashes.

Source citations (as archived): [Sify](<http://www.sify.com/news/unrest-swells-in-egypt-as-cornered-government-bans-al-jazeera-news-international-lb4skhidgdb.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-30-0-5"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** President Hosni Mubarak meets the military, holding talks with Vice President Omar Suleiman, Defence Minister Mohamed Hussein Tantawi, Chief of Staff Sami al-Anan and other senior commanders.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.irishtimes.com/newspaper/breaking/2011/0130/breaking2.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-30-0-6"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Several prison breaks occur, including the escape of 5,000 from a jail in Faiyum Governorate, many including 34 members of the Muslim Brotherhood from Wadi El Natrun, where eight people were killed in riots, and at least eight Hamas militants from Abu Zaabal Prison in Cairo, two of them escaping to Gaza, and two policemen and twelve escaped inmates were killed there; many more escaped from Tora Prison in Cairo, close to where 'dozens' of people were killed. Soldiers have been deployed outside of many prisons.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5g2iBEen-viF5qaFwrf-E1ay8JByA>); [Hindustan Times](<http://www.hindustantimes.com/Dozens-dead-as-thousands-escape-Egypt-prisons/Article1-656494.aspx>); [Reuters Africa](<http://af.reuters.com/article/egyptMarketNews/idAFLDE70T06S20110130>); [Bangkok Post](<http://www.bangkokpost.com/breakingnews/219000/egypt-army-cracks-down-jailbreaks>); [Press TV](<http://www.presstv.ir/detail/162645.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-30-0-7"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Egyptian air force fighter planes fly low over Cairo and helicopters hover above the city as protestors defy the government-ordered curfew.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/01/30/us-egypt-warplanes-idUSTRE70T1IA20110130>); [CBC News](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/egypt-cannot-go-back-elbaradei-1.997171>); [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/news/nationworld/world/la-fg-egypt-unrest-20110131,0,3864461.story>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-12320644>).

<a id="event-2011-01-30-0-8"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Egyptian authorities extend the curfew hours they are imposing on the people of Egypt. The government threatens to open fire on any person who disobeys its rule.

Source citations (as archived): [RIA Novosti](<http://en.rian.ru/world/20110130/162383449.html>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/jan/30/egypt-saturday-events-timeline>).

<a id="event-2011-01-30-0-9"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Mohamed ElBaradei urges the United States to call for the resignation of President Mubarak.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/01/30/us-egypt-usa-elbaradei-idUSTRE70T30920110130?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews>); [The Wall Street Journal](<http://online.wsj.com/article/SB10001424052748704832704576114132934597622.html?mod=googlenews_wsj>).

<a id="event-2011-01-30-0-10"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Former interior minister Habib al-Adli is urgently evacuated from the ministry building in central Cairo amid gunfire. He was one of the cabinet members dismissed by Mubarak yesterday and is accused of ordering troops to open fire on those protesting against Mubarak.

Source citations (as archived): [RIA Novosti](<http://en.rian.ru/world/20110130/162378159.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-30-0-11"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of anti-government protesters in Cairo defy a curfew and intimidation from the Egyptian military as fighter jets swoop low over the crowds gathered in Tahrir Square.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/skynews/Home/World-News/Egypt-Protesters-Gather-In-Cairo-After-Mass-Jailbreaks---President-Hosni-Mubarak-Refusing-To-Quit/Article/201003415918759?lpos=World_News_Top_Stories_Header_0&amp;lid=ARTICLE_15918759_Egypt%3A_Protesters_Gather_In_Cairo_After_Mass_Jailbreaks_-_President_Hosni_Mubarak_Refusing_To_Quit>); [TODAYonline](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110202145038/http://www.todayonline.com/World/EDC110131-0000146/Egyptian-military-flexes-muscle-amid-continued-chaos,-unrest>).

<a id="event-2011-01-30-0-13"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests: / International response to the 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** King Abdullah of Saudi Arabia expresses his disapproval of current events in Egypt, to which President of the United States Barack Obama responds that he "understands" Abdullah's concerns. \{\{Dead link\|date=April 2020 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Arab News](<http://arabnews.com/middleeast/article246710.ece>).

<a id="event-2011-01-30-0-14"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests: / International response to the 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Protesters gather peacefully outside the Egyptian Embassy in Lebanon in support of the current uprising against the Mubarak regime, chanting, "Down with Mubarak\!" and "Egypt is an Arab, not a U.S. state\!"

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Star](<http://www.dailystar.com.lb/article.asp?edition_id=1&amp;categ_id=1&amp;article_id=124329>).

<a id="event-2011-01-30-0-15"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests: / International response to the 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Israel privately worries and is "anxiously monitoring" events in Egypt according to the country's prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/meast/01/30/israel.egypt.reax/>); [The Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/middle-east/Israel-anxiously-monitoring-Egypt-other-regional-states/articleshow/7391744.cms>).

<a id="event-2011-01-30-0-16"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests: / International response to the 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Hamas officials shut the Rafah Border Crossing "for several days" as guards on the Egyptian side of the border with Gaza flee. This prevents hundreds of Palestinians from crossing into Egypt.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/middle-east/Gaza-shuts-border-with-Egypt-as-unrest-spirals/articleshow/7392989.cms>); [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2011-01/31/c_13714065.htm>).

<a id="event-2011-01-30-0-17"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests: / International response to the 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Several countries, including Greece, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, Turkey and the United States, announce plans to evacuate citizens from Egypt. Cairo's U.S. embassy schedules flights to so-called safe haven locations in Europe.

Source citations (as archived): [Arabian Business](<http://www.arabianbusiness.com/foreign-countries-evacuate-citizens-as-cairo-unrest-grows-377303.html>); [Reuters](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120329132718/http://arabnews.com/middleeast/article246590.ece>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/africa/01/30/egypt.evacuations/>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/jan/30/us-israel-turkey-evacuate-egypt>).

<a id="event-2011-01-30-0-18"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests: / International response to the 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) in the Philippines sets aside a P25-million standby fund for Filipinos in Egypt, though the official line is that Filipinos there are safe. Non-government labor organization Migrante-Middle East calls for the immediate evacuation of Filipino workers in Egypt.

Source citations (as archived): [ABS-CBN News](<http://www.abs-cbnnews.com/global-filipino/01/30/11/travel-advisory-out-dfa-allocates-funds-pinoys-egypt>); [The Philippine Star](<http://www.philstar.com/Article.aspx?articleId=653013&amp;publicationSubCategoryId=63>).

<a id="event-2011-01-30-0-19"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests: / International response to the 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** The Indian government airlifts 300 Indians, mostly women and children, from Egypt as the crisis worsens.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/Govt-airlifts-300-Indians-as-Egypt-crisis-worsens/articleshow/7393868.cms>).

<a id="event-2011-01-30-0-20"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests: / International response to the 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Bulgarian Foreign Minister Nikolai Mladenov speaks out on the crisis in Egypt.

Source citations (as archived): [Sofia Echo](<http://www.sofiaecho.com/2011/01/30/1034006_bulgarian-foreign-minister-speaks-on-egypt-crisis>).

<a id="event-2011-01-30-0-21"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests: / International response to the 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Protests from the Egyptian diaspora and supporters occur worldwide.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-12317347>); [Euronews](<http://www.euronews.net/2011/01/30/egyptians-aboard-join-anti-mubarak-protests/>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2011/01/201112815843772129.html>); [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/canada/edmonton/story/2011/01/29/ont-egypt-rallies291.html>); [Ynetnews](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4020878,00.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-30-0-22"></a>

**Archived source account.** 2011 Sudan protests: Anti-government demonstrators face off against riot police who fire tear gas and beat up students in Khartoum during protests inspired by those in Egypt and Tunisia.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2011/01/2011130131451294670.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-30-0-23"></a>

**Archived source account.** 2010–2011 Tunisian uprising: Rachid Ghannounchi, leader of the once banned Ennahda party, flies back to the country from London after 22 years in exile following the ousting of President Zine El Abidine Ben Ali.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2011/01/2011130111220856971.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-12318824>).

<a id="event-2011-01-30-0-24"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people march in Derry, Northern Ireland, in memory of those killed by British troops in the 1972 Bloody Sunday massacre of civil rights protesters and local bystanders. It is intended to be the final such march after the British government admitted last year that its troops had been responsible for carrying out the Bogside massacre.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/europe/01/30/northern.ireland.bloody.sunday/>); [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2011/0130/bloodysunday.html>); [Irish Examiner](<http://www.irishexaminer.com/breakingnews/ireland/final-bloody-sunday-commemoration-march-to-take-place-491395.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-northern-ireland-12319055>).

<a id="event-2011-01-30-0-25"></a>

**Archived source account.** A fire in an arms depot of the Anonymous Venezuelan Campaign of Military Industries (CAVIM) in Maracy city of Aragua state killed at least one person and forced authorities to evacuate about 10,000 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2011-01/30/c_13713952.htm>).

### 2011-01-31

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-01-31-0-1"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** The overnight atmosphere among the crowds gathered in Cairo's Tahrir Square is tense with gunfire reported.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://blogs.aljazeera.net/middle-east/2011/01/30/live-blog-311-egypt-protests>).

<a id="event-2011-01-31-0-2"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** President Hosni Mubarak orders his new prime minister Ahmed Shafiq to preserve subsidies, control inflation and provide more jobs as he battles an intense popular revolt against his 30-year rule. The announcement is read out on state television but has little effect as protesters vow to continue demonstrating until the Mubarak regime falls.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/01/201113101237787481.html>); [AFP](<http://news.smh.com.au/breaking-news-world/protests-continue-as-egypt-pm-tasked-with-reforms-20110131-1aajh.html>).

<a id="event-2011-01-31-0-3"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/01/201113023414787871.html>).

## February

### 2011-02-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1293474088](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20February%201&oldid=1293474088>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-02-01-0-1"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests.

**Archived source account.** Protesters plan a "million-man march" on President Hosni Mubarak's presidential palace in Cairo starting at Tahrir Square.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110201232315/http://blogs.voanews.com/breaking-news/2011/01/31/egypt-braces-for-million-man-march-as-army-pledges-restraint/>); [Al Jazeera](<http://blogs.aljazeera.net/middle-east/2011/01/31/live-blog-feb-1-egypt-protests>).

<a id="event-2011-02-01-0-2"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests.

**Archived source account.** At least two million people gather in Tahrir Square in the biggest demonstration since the popular revolution against the Mubarak regime began.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hindu](<http://www.hindu.com/2011/02/02/stories/2011020263100100.htm>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/02/20112113115442982.html>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2011/02/02/world/middleeast/02egypt.html>); [AFP](<http://news.smh.com.au/breaking-news-world/egyptians-amass-for-biggest-day-of-anger-yet-20110201-1acjj.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-01-0-3"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests.

**Archived source account.** The government closes down Egyptian National Railways as well as Internet and mobile phone services.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/africa/01/31/egypt.protests/?hpt=T1>).

<a id="event-2011-02-01-0-4"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests.

**Archived source account.** Mubarak addresses the nation to tell the people of his refusal to leave Egypt, though promises to resign at the end of his term. He tells the people of Egypt that he is "proud of his achievements over the years in serving Egypt and its people".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/02/01/us-egypt-mubarak-reform-idUSTRE7108HR20110201>); [AFP](<http://news.smh.com.au/breaking-news-world/mubarak-says-he-will-not-seek-reelection-20110202-1aco7.html>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/02/201121191413252982.html>); [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/egypt-uprising-jordan-king-abdullah-sacks-cabinet-cairo/story?id=12809623>).

<a id="event-2011-02-01-0-5"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests.

**Archived source account.** Protesters vow to stay in Tahrir Square until Mubarak goes.

Source citations (as archived): [Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/MiddleEast/Article.aspx?ID=206293&amp;R=R1>).

<a id="event-2011-02-01-0-7"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests / International response to the 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** President of the United States Barack Obama urges Hosni Mubarak not to run for the presidency again, though stops short of telling him to resign immediately. He also called for the transition to democracy "to begin now".,

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-12340885>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2011/02/02/world/middleeast/02transition.html?_r=1>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/feb/01/obama-pressures-mubarak-to-step-down>); [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2011/02/01/AR2011020105291.html?hpid=topnews>).

<a id="event-2011-02-01-0-8"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests / International response to the 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister of Turkey Recep Tayyip Erdoğan completely backs the people of Egypt in their battle against the Mubarak regime. Newspapers had previously criticised him for his lack of a response to the revolution there.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/02/201121115128839350.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-01-2-5"></a>

Context: January 31 – February 2, 2011 North American winter storm.

**Archived source account.** The storm is expected to affect as much as a third of the U.S. population, and has already created dangerous travel conditions and forced the cancellation of thousands of flights and the closure of major interstate highways.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/02/01/idINIndia-54572920110201>); [VOA](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110202055614/http://www.voanews.com/english/news/usa/US-Winter-Weather-Forces-6400-Flight-Cancelations-115033949.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-01-2-6"></a>

Context: January 31 – February 2, 2011 North American winter storm.

**Archived source account.** Chicago's Midway International Airport closes due to the snow with 1,300 flights cancelled at O'Hare Airport.

Source citations (as archived): [Chicago Sun Times](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110201230443/http://www.suntimes.com/3605053-417/flights-cta-midway-rail-tuesday.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-01-2-7"></a>

Context: January 31 – February 2, 2011 North American winter storm.

**Archived source account.** The Governor of Wisconsin Scott Walker declares a state of emergency in southern Wisconsin as a result of the blizzard.

Source citations (as archived): [Channel 3000](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110202045945/http://www.channel3000.com/weather/26692720/detail.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-01-3-1"></a>

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2011-02-01-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. soldier Bradley Manning, the alleged whistleblower who is thought to have revealed secret U.S. government documents to the international public, is reported to be held in solitary confinement awaiting trial by the United States for seven months now, treatment which the United Nations deems a form of torture when used for such prolonged periods.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/video/americas/2011/02/20112154519935748.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-01-4-1"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Asia Times Online](<http://www.atimes.com/atimes/China/MB02Ad01.html>).

#### Politics and elections

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/02/01/us-ireland-idUKTRE71057C20110201>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-12339623>); [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2011/0201/politics.html>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/europe/02/01/ireland.politics/>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/feb/01/irish-brian-cowen-election-campaign>).

<a id="event-2011-02-01-5-3"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Press TV](<http://www.presstv.ir/detail/163028.html>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2011/02/01/AR2011020101232.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-01-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defense Minister Ehud Barak cancel the appointment of Yoav Galant to the post of Israel Defense Forces chief. The announcement came after months of scandal surrounding his appointment due to allegations that he had illegally seized public lands near his home in Moshav Amikam, and after the State Comptroller Micha Lindenstrauss stated that Galant lied to in a sworn affidavit about exceeding his building rights.

Source citations (as archived): [Source](<http://af.reuters.com/article/egyptNews/idAFLDE7102DM20110201>); [Source](<http://www.jpost.com/NationalNews/Article.aspx?id=205525>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-02-02-0-1"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Egyptian protesters continue nationwide demonstrations against President Hosni Mubarak for a ninth day.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://blogs.aljazeera.net/middle-east/2011/02/01/live-blog-feb-2-egypt-protests>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/news/blog/2011/feb/02/egypt-protests-live-updates>).

<a id="event-2011-02-02-0-2"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Mohamed ElBaradei, an emerging leader of anti-regime protests, and other protesters say that Mubarak must leave Egypt by Friday at the latest to avoid further bloodshed and turmoil.

Source citations (as archived): [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/world/hosni-mubarak-must-go-by-friday-says-mohamed-elbaradei/story-e6frg6so-1225998404724>).

<a id="event-2011-02-02-0-3"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** The protestors increase their demands for the end of the Mubarak regime and are not impressed by Hosni Mubarak's promise to resign at the end of his current term.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/02/20112272918301323.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-02-0-4"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Clashes occur in Cairo and Alexandria between supporters and opponents of President of Egypt Hosni Mubarak with one person dead and 700 injured.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-12345656>); [Euronews](<http://www.euronews.net/2011/02/02/clashes-erupt-in-a-tense-egypt/>); [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2011/02/02/egyptian-military-calls-end-demonstrations-1705880116/>); [Al Jazeera](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110203045110/http://english.aljazeera.net/photo_galleries/middleeast/201122163520566506.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-02-0-5"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Mubarak supporters, rumored to be directed by the Mubarak regime, protest in central Cairo, Alexandria and other cities, attacking anti-government protestors with stones, knives and Molotov cocktails.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<http://voices.washingtonpost.com/postpartisan/2011/02/mubarak_unleashes_chaos.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-02-0-6"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Some supporters of the Mubarak regime ride horses and camels and attack anti-government protesters with whips.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/news/blog/2011/feb/02/egypt-protests-live-updates#block-31>).

<a id="event-2011-02-02-0-7"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Two Molotov cocktails are thrown into the grounds of the Egyptian Museum.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/news/blog/2011/feb/02/egypt-protests-live-updates#block-66>).

<a id="event-2011-02-02-0-8"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations (Navi Pillay) believes as many as 300 people have been killed in Egypt over the last nine days.

Source citations (as archived): [Almasry Alyoum](<http://www.almasryalyoum.com/en/news/un-300-killed-nationwide-protests>).

<a id="event-2011-02-02-0-9"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Amr Moussa, Arab League Secretary General and a former Egyptian foreign minister, says he would "seriously" consider whether to seek the Egyptian presidency.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Headlines/Article.aspx?id=206306>).

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Mohamed ElBaradei, of the Egyptian opposition, raises concerns that clashes in Cairo could escalate into a "bloodbath".

Source citations (as archived): [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/world/new-zealand-calls-election-for-november-26/story-e6frg6so-1225998644017>).

<a id="event-2011-02-02-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The President of Russia, Dmitry Medvedev, expands the Kremlin's human rights council and authorises it to investigate the cases of Sergei Magnitsky and Mikhail Khodorkovsky.

Source citations (as archived): [The Moscow Times](<http://www.themoscowtimes.com/news/article/for-yeltsin-kremlin-seeks-yukos-review/430200.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-02-5-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** BBC executive Craig Oliver is chosen to replace Andy Coulson as British Prime Minister David Cameron's Director of Communications.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-12348159>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/politics/2011/feb/02/craig-oliver-andy-coulson-no-10-communications-chief>).

<a id="event-2011-02-02-5-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Senate votes down a repeal of healthcare reforms 47-51.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/blogs/healthwatch/health-reform-implementation/141829-senate-rejects-healthcare-repeal>).

#### Science

<a id="event-2011-02-02-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Part of New Zealand's Pink and White Terraces, a natural wonder apparently destroyed in an eruption 125 years ago, has been rediscovered by scientists.

Source citations (as archived): [New Zealand Herald](<http://www.nzherald.co.nz/travel/news/article.cfm?c_id=7&amp;objectid=10703655>).

<a id="event-2011-02-02-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** South Korea orders the culling of three million animals to control foot and mouth disease.

Source citations (as archived): [Yonhap](<http://english.yonhapnews.co.kr/news/2011/02/02/0200000000AEN20110202002400320.HTML>).

<a id="event-2011-02-02-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** NASA's Kepler Mission announces the discovery of a planetary system of six planets circulating the star Kepler-11.

Source citations (as archived): [Tha Indian](<http://www.thaindian.com/newsportal/sci-tech/nasa-scientists-discover-planetary-system-with-six-planets_100497437.html>).

#### Sports

**Archived source account.** Australian swimmer Ian Thorpe announces that he will come out of retirement to compete in the London Olympics in 2012.

Source citations (as archived): [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/sport/ian-thorpe-back-on-the-olympic-wagon/story-e6frg7mf-1225998613255>).

<a id="event-2011-02-02-7-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Japanese police investigate allegations of match fixing in professional sumo wrestling.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110207040927/http://www.sacbee.com/2011/02/01/3370192/sumo-faces-reports-of-bout-fixing.html>).
