### 2011-02-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1233064895](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20February%203&oldid=1233064895>).

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2011-02-03-0-1"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Anti-government protestors continue to protest against the Mubarak regime for a tenth day.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://blogs.aljazeera.net/middle-east/2011/02/02/live-blog-feb-3-egypt-protests>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/news/blog/2011/feb/03/egypt-protests-live-updates>).

<a id="event-2011-02-03-0-2"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Protesters detain 120 people with IDs linking them to the police or ruling party; most were attacking protesters at the time.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/news/blog/2011/feb/03/egypt-protests-live-updates#block-3#block-11>); [Ynetnews](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4023474,00.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-03-0-3"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** A tense standoff between supporters and opponents of President Hosni Mubarak continues in Cairo, with at least three people killed and 1,500 injured in fighting on Wednesday. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://news.blogs.cnn.com/2011/02/02/egypt-crisis-prepping-for-another-day-of-protests/?hpt=T1>); [AP](<http://www.philstar.com/Article.aspx?articleId=654046&amp;publicationSubCategoryId=200>); [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/skynews/Article/201102115920969>).

<a id="event-2011-02-03-0-4"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** At least three people are killed as a result of gunfire in Cairo's Tahrir Square.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://news.brisbanetimes.com.au/breaking-news-world/two-people-killed-in-cairo-witnesses-20110203-1aewn.html>); [Al Jazeera](<http://blogs.aljazeera.net/middle-east/2011/02/02/live-blog-feb-3-egypt-protests#>).

<a id="event-2011-02-03-0-5"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Egyptian prime minister Ahmad Shafiq says "sorry" for all the violence that has occurred in Tahrir Square and promises there will be no more.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/02/201123133551858568.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-03-0-6"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Journalists from Al Jazeera and the BBC are among those targeted in fresh attacks from Mubarak regime "thugs". The UK's Channel 4 News reports that Mubarak's "secret police" are threatening journalists to keep off the streets of Cairo.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/media/2011/feb/03/journalists-attacked-in-egypt-protests>).

<a id="event-2011-02-03-0-7"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Prominent Egyptian blogger and anti-Mubarak activist sandmonkey is arrested and is taken offline by authorities in Egypt.

Source citations (as archived): [his blog](<http://www.sandmonkey.org/cgi-sys/suspendedpage.cgi>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/news/blog/2011/feb/03/egypt-protests-live-updates#block-40>); [Hot Air](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110204130326/http://hotair.com/greenroom/archives/2011/02/03/egypt-blogger-sandmonkey-arrested-by-state-security/>).

<a id="event-2011-02-03-0-8"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Egyptian state television forments the unrest by reporting that "Israeli spies" have infiltrated Cairo, leading to an increase in antisemitic sentiment among the pro-Mubarak forces attacking people and journalists on the streets.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/02/201123131258705359.html>); [Jewish Telegraphic Agency](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110205071448/http://www.jta.org/news/article/2011/02/03/2742846/pro-mubarak-supporters-target-journos-as-jews>); [Channel 4 News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110204124450/http://blogs.channel4.com/world-news-blog/egypt-the-man-staring-at-me-made-a-throat-slitting-gesture/14990>).

<a id="event-2011-02-03-0-9"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Two Al Jazeera journalists are attacked on their way from the airport to central Cairo.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/news/blog/2011/feb/03/egypt-protests-live-updates#block-48>).

<a id="event-2011-02-03-0-10"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Nile TV (state television) journalist Shahira Amin, deputy head of the station, resigns after being threatened and intimidated; she tells Al Jazeera "I can't be part of the propaganda machine and I refuse to be a hypocrite", adding that she feels "liberated".

Source citations (as archived): [iloubnan](<http://iloubnan.info/politics/actualite/id/55656/titre/Nile-Sat-journalist-resigns-after-being-intimidated-by-the-state>); [Gulf News](<http://gulfnews.com/news/region/egypt/new-clashes-as-egypt-protesters-push-back-rivals-1.756374>).

<a id="event-2011-02-03-0-11"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Journalists from Al Jazeera and The Washington Post are arrested by Egyptian authorities; Swedish television loses contact with correspondent Bert Sundström.

Source citations (as archived): [M&amp;C](<http://www.monstersandcritics.com/news/middleeast/news/article_1616897.php/Swedish-television-reporter-missing-in-Egypt>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/news/blog/2011/feb/03/egypt-protests-live-updates#block-67>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2011/02/03/AR2011020302747.html?hpid=topnews>).

<a id="event-2011-02-03-0-12"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Representatives of Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch are arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [Amnesty International](<https://www.amnesty.org/en/news-and-updates/amnesty-international-representative-detained-cairo-2011-02-03>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-12307698>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/news/blog/2011/feb/03/egypt-protests-live-updates#block-74>).

<a id="event-2011-02-03-0-13"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Mobile phone firm Vodafone says the Egyptian authorities have hijacked its network to send unattributed text messages supporting the government.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-12357694>).

<a id="event-2011-02-03-0-14"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Egypt's attorney-general bans several former ministers and Ahmed Ezz, a prominent member of the ruling party who resigned last week, from travelling abroad; their bank accounts are also frozen.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/02/201123142759661467.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-03-0-15"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Video footage emerges on YouTube of a police van being driven at high speed into peacefully marching anti-regime protesters.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/news/blog/2011/feb/03/egypt-protests-live-updates#block-3#block-69>); [Direct link](<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3wi3K8T3pPQ>).

<a id="event-2011-02-03-0-16"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Four members of the April 6 Youth Movement, an opposition group known for organising events on Facebook, are arrested by Egyptian authorities.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/news/blog/2011/feb/03/egypt-protests-live-updates#block-3#block-92>); [Wired](<https://www.wired.com/dangerroom/2011/02/egypt-arrests-four-facebook-activists/>).

<a id="event-2011-02-03-0-17"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Hosni Mubarak breaks his silence to grant an interview to Christiane Amanpour of America's ABC News inside his palace.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/news/blog/2011/feb/03/egypt-protests-live-updates#block-3#block-99>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/02/03/us-egypt-mubarak-idUSTRE7127RQ20110203>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-12361948>).

<a id="event-2011-02-03-0-18"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** An ABC News crew are carjacked and threatened with decapitations by pro-Mubarak supporters.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/news/blog/2011/feb/03/egypt-protests-live-updates#block-3#block-103>); [The Hollywood Reporter](<http://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/abc-news-crew-hijacked-threatened-96373>); [The Huffington Post](<http://www.huffingtonpost.com/2011/02/03/abc-news-beheading-egypt-brian-hartman_n_818303.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-03-0-19"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Senate passes a motion supporting democracy in Egypt and calling on President Hosni Mubarak to begin transferring power.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<http://voices.washingtonpost.com/44/2011/02/senate-expected-to-pass-resolu.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-03-0-20"></a>

**Archived source account.** 2011 Yemeni protests: Thousands of pro- and anti-government supporters demonstrate in Yemen over the rule of President Ali Abdullah Saleh in a planned "day of rage".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/02/201123105140512715.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-03-0-21"></a>

**Archived source account.** 2010–2011 Algerian protests: President Abdelaziz Bouteflika vows to lift the country's state of emergency, in force since 1992, in the "very near future".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-12359750>).

<a id="event-2011-02-03-0-22"></a>

**Archived source account.** 2011 Syrian protests: Social media mobilises the people of Syria for rallies demanding freedom, human rights and the end to emergency law, scheduled for Friday and Saturday in front of the parliament in Damascus and at Syrian embassies internationally.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/02/201122171649677912.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-03-0-23"></a>

**Archived source account.** Gunmen open fire in Thailand's majority Muslim Pattani Province killing five people and injuring three people.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/stories/2011/02/03/3129269.htm?section=justin>); [Thai News Agency](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110205083245/http://www.mcot.net/cfcustom/cache_page/164550.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-03-0-24"></a>

**Archived source account.** Awal Gul, an Afghan accused of being a Taliban base commander, who has been imprisoned without charge since 2002, dies while exercising at the Guantanamo Bay detention center.

Source citations (as archived): [Miami Herald](<http://www.miamiherald.com/2011/02/03/2048865/suspected-taliban-commander-dead.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-12361834>).

<a id="event-2011-02-03-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Food and Agriculture Organisation announces that world food prices have risen to a record high.

Source citations (as archived): [FAO](<http://www.fao.org/news/story/en/item/50519/icode/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/02/03/food-fao-index-idUSLDE7111TR20110203>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-12354402>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2011-02-03-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Italy's parliament rejects a search request by prosecutors investigating Silvio Berlusconi for having sexual intercourse with an under-age prostitute.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-12361443>).

<a id="event-2011-02-03-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A former policeman questions the suicide verdict recorded in the 1979 death of French cabinet minister Robert Boulin, claiming he could not have drowned. His family believe he was murdered.

### 2011-02-04

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1185383475](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20February%204&oldid=1185383475>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-02-04-0-1"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Anti-government protesters demonstrate against the Mubarak regime for an eleventh day - the "Day of Departure".

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/blog/2011/feb/04/egypt-protests-day-departure-live>); [Al Jazeera](<http://blogs.aljazeera.net/node/3164>).

<a id="event-2011-02-04-0-2"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Organisers of the 2011 Egyptian protests call on supporters to fill every square in Cairo after two days of clashes between supporters and opponents of President of Egypt Hosni Mubarak.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2011/02/05/AR2011020500696.html?hpid=topnews>).

<a id="event-2011-02-04-0-3"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Protesters in Cairo's Tahrir Square chant "Leave\! Leave\! Leave\!", "Allahu akbar\!" and "Today is the last day".

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/blog/2011/feb/04/egypt-protests-day-departure-live#block-49>).

<a id="event-2011-02-04-0-4"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Al Jazeera investigates the hacking of its, allegedly carried out "apparently by opponents of the pro-democracy movement in Egypt".

Source citations (as archived): [news website](<http://english.aljazeera.net/watch_now/>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/blog/2011/feb/04/egypt-protests-day-departure-live#block-53>).

<a id="event-2011-02-04-0-5"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Nederlandse Omroep Stichting cameraman Eric Feijten is arrested again after being released from his previous arrest.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/blog/2011/feb/04/egypt-protests-day-departure-live#block-45#block-22>).

<a id="event-2011-02-04-0-6"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Al Jazeera's Cairo office is stormed by "gangs of thugs" who ransack it and set it on fire as attacks on foreign journalists continue.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/media/2011/feb/04/al-jazeera-office-attacked-egypt-protests>).

<a id="event-2011-02-04-0-7"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Reporter Bert Sundström of Swedish public broadcaster SVT, reported missing yesterday, is hospitalised and undergoing surgery for serious "knife injuries" in Cairo after being kidnapped and stabbed.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110208033249/http://www.swedishwire.com/component/content/article/2:politics/8388:swedish-reporter-seriously-injured-in-cairo-riots>).

<a id="event-2011-02-04-0-8"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Mohammed al-Beltagi, a leading member of the Muslim Brotherhood, tells Al Jazeera that the movement has no ambitions to run for the Egyptian presidency.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://blogs.aljazeera.net/node/3164>).

<a id="event-2011-02-04-0-9"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Fighting shifts from Tahrir Square to Cairo's side streets.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/africa/02/04/egypt.protests.scene/index.html?hpt=T1>).

<a id="event-2011-02-04-0-10"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Ahmad Mohamed Mahmoud of Al-Ta'awun becomes the first journalist to die covering the protests as attacks on journalists continue.

<a id="event-2011-02-10-5-1"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-12409426>).

<a id="event-2011-02-10-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former British Labour MP Eric Illsley is jailed for 12 months for dishonestly claiming parliamentary expenses. The sentence comes on the same day that Jim Devine, another former Labour MP, is convicted of dishonestly claiming £8,385 of expenses by using false invoices for cleaning and printing work.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-12418223>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2011-02-10-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Utah Jazz head coach Jerry Sloan, the longest-tenured coach in any of North America's four major leagues, announces his resignation effective immediately. Sloan, inducted in the Basketball Hall of Fame in 2009, had been with the Jazz since 1988.

<a id="event-2011-02-10-6-1"></a>

No attached source citation. This assertion is unverified; see its disclosure and research status above.

### 2011-02-11

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1341809398](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20February%2011&oldid=1341809398>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-02-11-0-1"></a>

Context: Egyptian Revolution of 2011 / Downfall of Hosni Mubarak:.

**Archived source account.** Protests continue following last night's non-resignation speech of President of Egypt Hosni Mubarak.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://blogs.aljazeera.net/middle-east/2011/02/10/live-blog-feb-11-egypt-protests>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/blog/2011/feb/11/egypt-protests-mubarak>).

<a id="event-2011-02-11-0-2"></a>

Context: Egyptian Revolution of 2011 / Downfall of Hosni Mubarak:.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of pro-democracy demonstrators march on state television and presidential palaces as "Farewell Friday", the eighteenth day of protests against the Mubarak regime, gets underway.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/02/201121125158705862.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-11-0-3"></a>

Context: Egyptian Revolution of 2011 / Downfall of Hosni Mubarak:.

**Archived source account.** Opposition leader Mohamed ElBaradei warns "Egypt will explode" in response to Mubarak's non-resignation speech last night.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/africa/02/10/egypt.protests.reax/index.html?iref=NS1>).

<a id="event-2011-02-11-0-4"></a>

Context: Egyptian Revolution of 2011 / Downfall of Hosni Mubarak:.

**Archived source account.** Military leaders pledge to end the 30-year state of emergency law when the protests end.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/02/201121161511674298.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-11-0-5"></a>

Context: Egyptian Revolution of 2011 / Downfall of Hosni Mubarak:.

**Archived source account.** The Mubaraks flee Cairo and head for the Red Sea resort of Sharm el-Sheikh.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2011-02/11/c_13728121.htm>); [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/stories/2011/02/11/501364/main20031477.shtml>); [Ynetnews](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4027193,00.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-11-0-6"></a>

Context: Egyptian Revolution of 2011 / Downfall of Hosni Mubarak:.

**Archived source account.** At least 5 people are killed by police in Arish in the North Sinai Governorate.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/blog/2011/feb/11/egypt-hosni-mubarak-left-cairo#block-5>).

<a id="event-2011-02-11-0-7"></a>

Context: Egyptian Revolution of 2011 / Downfall of Hosni Mubarak:.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister of Denmark Lars Løkke Rasmussen, speaking in Copenhagen, becomes the first European Union leader to tell Mubarak to resign, saying Mubarak is "history" and that he "made a huge blunder yesterday" by giving his non-resignation speech.

Source citations (as archived): [CP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/canadianpress/article/ALeqM5jfxszj9wlBGrS1-dCx83NF6El6Bw?docId=5917466>).

<a id="event-2011-02-11-0-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** Vice President Omar Suleiman announces on state television the resignation of Hosni Mubarak as President of Egypt after 30 years in power.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-12307698>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/02/201121125158705862.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-11-0-9"></a>

Context: Egyptian Revolution of 2011 / Downfall of Hosni Mubarak:.

**Archived source account.** Hosni Mubarak resigns as President of Egypt and hands power to Mohamed Hussein Tantawi, head of the Supreme Council of the Armed Forces. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2011/02/11/AR2011021102386.html>); [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/egyptNews/idAFLDE7192I62011021>).

<a id="event-2011-02-11-0-10"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-12430115>).

<a id="event-2011-02-11-0-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** Bolivian President Evo Morales abandons an event in the south of the country after crowds booed him and threw dynamite in a protest over rising food prices.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-12427057>); [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5hKQxQLMRfW7GXBWbjCny9tN73FXQ?docId=b5764ed4c5df40f9a335b37f54808d01>); [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2011/02/11/Dynamite-causes-Morales-to-cancel-speech/UPI-91971297432460/>).

### 2011-02-12

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076433161](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20February%2012&oldid=1076433161>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-02-12-0-1"></a>

Context: 2010–2011 Algerian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people, inspired by the Egyptian Revolution of 2011, take to the streets of Algiers to protest against their own regime and to call for the removal of President Abdelaziz Bouteflika.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://blogs.aljazeera.net/africa/2011/02/12/live-blog-feb-13-eye-algeria>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-12438015>); [France24](<http://www.france24.com/en/20110212-algeria-protest-defy-ban-demonstration-clash-police-algiers-bouteflika-egypt>); [Herald Sun](<http://www.heraldsun.com.au/ipad/thousands-demonstrate-in-algeria/story-fn6s850w-1226005122586>).

<a id="event-2011-02-12-0-2"></a>

Context: 2010–2011 Algerian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Algerian police and security forces attempt to prevent the people from participating in the illegal march for democracy and change in Algiers.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2011-02/12/c_13729299.htm>).

<a id="event-2011-02-12-0-3"></a>

Context: 2010–2011 Algerian protests:.

**Archived source account.** The Algerian government shuts down the internet as tear gas and plastic bullets are deployed and journalists, especially those seen with cameras, targeted by state-sponsored thugs.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/africaandindianocean/algeria/8320772/Algeria-shuts-down-internet-and-Facebook-as-protest-mounts.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-12-0-4"></a>

Context: 2010–2011 Algerian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of riot police crack down on those protesting against the ruling Bouteflika regime. Protesters chant "Bouteflika out\!"

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/feb/12/algerian-riot-police-protest-algiers>); [Gulf Times](<http://www.gulf-times.com/site/topics/article.asp?cu_no=2&amp;item_no=415815&amp;version=1&amp;template_id=57&amp;parent_id=56>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2011/02/13/world/africa/13algeria.html>); [euronews](<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HltzgRQYjgM>); [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/africaandindianocean/algeria/8320273/Algerian-protesters-clash-with-police.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-12-0-5"></a>

Context: 2010–2011 Algerian protests:.

**Archived source account.** The opposition says approximately 5,000 people took part in today's attempt to bring down the Bouteflika regime.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2011-02/13/c_13729471.htm>).

<a id="event-2011-02-12-0-7"></a>

Context: 2010–2011 Algerian protests: / International response to the 2010–2011 Algerian protests:.

**Archived source account.** A demonstration occurs from the streets of Montreal in Canada to the front of the Algerian consulate as people, including many Tunisians and Egyptians, join international calls for Abdelaziz Bouteflika's resignation.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5igNMLCmsK4D_8o41M1TOo7kcTjdw?docId=CNG.4e201b9124c065f698a3b89b09e38576.1151>); [Montreal Gazette](<https://montrealgazette.com/news/Algerian+Montrealers+call+democracy/4272630/story.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-12-0-8"></a>

Context: 2010–2011 Algerian protests: / International response to the 2010–2011 Algerian protests:.

**Archived source account.** A peaceful protest occurs at the initiative of the National Coordination for Change and Democracy in Algeria in Paris against Algerian police brutality, forced disappearances and the state of emergency that the regime has imposed upon the country.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110708171437/http://ireport.cnn.com/docs/DOC-554533?ref=feeds%2Foncnn>).

<a id="event-2011-02-12-0-10"></a>

Context: 2011 Yemeni protests:.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of anti-government protesters gather in Sana'a calling for the resignation of President Ali Abdullah Saleh, who has ruled the country since 1978.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/02/201121211858966496.html>); [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5jaoZWnvhll-OqIlQLyOlJK1WQCBw?docId=CNG.34b0a7cfb441605b61894f84b5a9eda2.f1>).

<a id="event-2011-02-12-0-11"></a>

Context: 2011 Yemeni protests:.

**Archived source account.** Anti-government protesters march towards Sana'a University, chanting slogans such as "Get out, Get out Ali" and "The people want the regime to fall."

Source citations (as archived): [Times LIVE](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110215011637/http://www.timeslive.co.za/world/article909790.ece/Yemen-revolt-begins-in-central-Sanaa>); [Press TV](<http://www.presstv.ir/detail/164919.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-12-0-12"></a>

Context: 2011 Yemeni protests:.

**Archived source account.** Demonstrators also attempt to celebrate yesterday's resignation of President of Egypt Hosni Mubarak, brought down by an 18-day popular revolution, but police clamp down on the celebrations.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-12441246>).

<a id="event-2011-02-12-0-13"></a>

Context: 2011 Yemeni protests:.

**Archived source account.** Yemeni police use clubs to beat those protesting against the Saleh regime, leaving Yemen's ally, the United States, in a "delicate position".

Source citations (as archived): [Taipei Times](<http://www.taipeitimes.com/News/front/archives/2011/02/13/2003495758>); [Radio New Zealand](<http://www.radionz.co.nz/news/world/68386/march-broken-up-in-yemen>).

<a id="event-2011-02-12-0-14"></a>

Context: 2011 Yemeni protests:.

**Archived source account.** The United States lifts its ban on freight flights from the country after finding Yemen to have sufficiently developed its airport security measures and that there would be "no problems with resuming cargo flights from Yemen anymore".

Source citations (as archived): [Yemen Post](<http://yemenpost.net/Detail123456789.aspx?ID=3&amp;SubID=3129&amp;MainCat=3>).

<a id="event-2011-02-12-0-15"></a>

Context: 2011 Yemeni protests:.

**Archived source account.** Yemen's government offers its "respect" for the choice of the Egyptian people to protest and force the resignation of Hosni Mubarak.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/egyptNews/idAFLDE71B01C20110212>).

**Archived source account.** A thousand or more non-citizen residents of Kuwait demonstrated yesterday demanding rights given to Kuwaiti citizen.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/energyOilNews/idAFLDE71H22B20110218>); [Al Jazeera English](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/02/2011218183819888842.html>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/meast/02/18/kuwait.protests/index.html?iref=allsearch>).

<a id="event-2011-02-18-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police and indigenous protesters clash in Panama during a protest against changes to the country's mining law.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5gi17WcBb7cR99qQ77ApSKDiEwNbA?docId=CNG.caf89b431a9c66f3e75cf5c8f5b2c68e.ed1>).

<a id="event-2011-02-18-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 37 people are killed and others are wounded in a U.S.-led airstrike in Kunar Province, Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Press TV](<http://www.presstv.ir/detail/165845.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-18-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Retired CIA officer-turned-political activist Ray McGovern is thrown out, bloodied and arrested while protesting a speech given by Hillary Clinton on internet freedom\{\{dn\|date=August 2017\}\} at George Washington University in Washington, D.C. Veterans for Peace requests that Clinton apologise.

Source citations (as archived): [Press TV](<http://www.presstv.ir/detail/165779.html>); [American Independent](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110221000518/http://www.americanindependent.com/170062/anti-war-protester-seized-claims-he-was-bloodied-by-guards-at-clinton-address-about-free-speech>).

<a id="event-2011-02-18-0-5"></a>

Context: 2011 Bahraini protests:.

**Archived source account.** Troops and tanks patrol Manama as the Bahraini military sets up checkpoints; a ban on public gatherings is announced.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/02/20112184122210251.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-18-0-6"></a>

Context: 2011 Bahraini protests:.

**Archived source account.** King of Bahrain Hamad ibn Isa Al Khalifa visits and praises the military for its nighttime crackdown on pro-democracy demonstrators in Manama, lauding their "bravery and readiness to assume their national duties".

Source citations (as archived): [Press TV](<http://www.presstv.ir/detail/165781.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-18-0-7"></a>

Context: 2011 Bahraini protests:.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people attend the first funerals of those killed by security forces in yesterday's massacre at Pearl Square, many making known their anger at the Bahraini regime.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-12502820>).

<a id="event-2011-02-18-0-8"></a>

Context: 2011 Bahraini protests:.

**Archived source account.** Bahrain's military fires at hundreds of mourners advancing towards Pearl Square with reports of live ammunition being used.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2011/02/19/world/middleeast/19bahrain.html?hp>).

<a id="event-2011-02-18-0-10"></a>

Context: 2011 Djibouti protests:.

**Archived source account.** Police shoot tear gas at thousands of people demonstrating against the Ismail Omar Guelleh regime in Djibouti.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2011/02/201121816513686216.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-18-0-12"></a>

Context: 2011 Jordanian protests:.

**Archived source account.** At least 8 people are injured during an attack on a pro-democracy protest rally in Amman.

Source citations (as archived): [Press TV](<http://www.presstv.ir/detail/165886.html>); [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/photo/2011-02/19/c_13739653.htm>).

<a id="event-2011-02-18-0-14"></a>

Context: 2011 Libyan civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Anti-regime protests continue overnight after yesterday's "Day of Rage". Funerals of those killed due today. Human Rights Watch lists 24 killed and many wounded.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-12502657>); [Human Rights Watch](<https://www.hrw.org/en/news/2011/02/17/libya-security-forces-fire-day-anger-demonstrations>).

<a id="event-2011-02-18-0-15"></a>

Context: 2011 Libyan civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Libyans in Benghazi take over; it broadcasts its message to the world - calling on the international media to cover what "the criminal Gaddafi" is doing - while posts videos in English.

Source citations (as archived): [a radio station](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110425071736/http://libya.blog-video.tv/>); [libya17.com](<http://www.libyafeb17.com/>); [Foreign Policy](<http://blog.foreignpolicy.com/posts/2011/02/18/radio_free_benghazi>).

<a id="event-2011-02-18-0-16"></a>

Context: 2011 Libyan civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Libya shuts off access to the Internet.

Source citations (as archived): [TechCrunch](<https://techcrunch.com/2011/02/18/reports-libya-follows-egypts-lead-starts-shutting-off-internet-services/>).

<a id="event-2011-02-18-0-17"></a>

Context: 2011 Libyan civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Al Jazeera reports that its signal to Libya is being blocked.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/libyaNews/idAFLDE71H2A120110218>).

<a id="event-2011-02-18-0-19"></a>

Context: 2011 Iraqi protests:.

**Archived source account.** Anti-regime protests occur in Baghdad, with demonstrators calling for a larger demonstration next Friday as part of an "Iraqi revolution".

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/meast/02/18/iraq.protests/>); [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/video/2011-02/18/c_13738367.htm>).

<a id="event-2011-02-18-0-20"></a>

Context: 2011 Iraqi protests:.

**Archived source account.** Deaths and injuries occur during anti-regime demonstrations in Sulaymaniyah.

Source citations (as archived): [euronews](<http://www.euronews.net/2011/02/17/deaths-reported-in-fresh-protests-in-iraq/>).

Context: 2011 Iraqi protests:.

**Archived source account.** Anti-regime protests occur in the autonomous Kurdish region of northern Iraq.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/02/2011218104510878522.html>); [Press TV](<http://www.presstv.ir/detail/165817.html>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2011/02/17/AR2011021706418.html>).

Context: 2011 Yemeni protests:.

**Archived source account.** Anti-regime protesters gather for the largest of eight days of demonstrations.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/2011-02-18/largest-yemen-protests-to-date-turn-violent-as-security-forces-crack-down.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-18-0-24"></a>

Context: 2011 Yemeni protests:.

**Archived source account.** 4 people are killed during nationwide protests in Yemen.

Source citations (as archived): [MSNBC](<http://www.msnbc.msn.com/id/41644921>).

<a id="event-2011-02-18-0-25"></a>

Context: 2011 Yemeni protests:.

**Archived source account.** In the southern port city of Aden one anti-government protester is shot dead and 40 others are injured as police open fire on thousands of demonstrators; thousands of protesters later storm two council buildings setting them on fire.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2011-02/19/c_13739101.htm>).

<a id="event-2011-02-18-0-27"></a>

Context: Egyptian Revolution of 2011:.

**Archived source account.** Some Egyptians march through the streets of Cairo apologising for the way in which Hosni Mubarak was deposed after 30 years in the recent revolution. "Yes to Change, No to Humiliation".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/topNews/idAFJOE71H0QO20110218>).

<a id="event-2011-02-18-0-28"></a>

Context: Egyptian Revolution of 2011:.

**Archived source account.** Ayman al-Zawahri, Al-Qaeda's deputy leader, issues a video saying that Egypt had long "deviated from Islam" and warning that democracy "can only be non-religious."

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory?id=12953255>).

<a id="event-2011-02-18-0-29"></a>

Context: Egyptian Revolution of 2011:.

**Archived source account.** Yusuf al-Qaradawi, a leading Islamic preacher associated with the Egyptian Muslim Brotherhood, is to lead public prayers in Cairo's Tahrir Square for the first time in thirty years.

Source citations (as archived): [Al-Arabiya](<http://www.alarabiya.net/articles/2011/02/17/138093.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-18-0-31"></a>

Context: Other Arab Spring Events:.

**Archived source account.** Former President of Tunisia Zine El Abidine Ben Ali, ousted during the recent popular revolution, is reported to have slipped into a coma following his stroke in Saudi Arabia.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2011/02/201121814354399587.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-18-0-32"></a>

Context: Other Arab Spring Events:.

**Archived source account.** Prince Talal bin Abdul-Aziz Al Saud warns of the Arab Spring spreading to Saudi Arabia unless King Abdullah speeds up the reform process.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/world/saudi-prince-talal-warns-of-uprising-threat/story-e6frg6so-1226008023428>).

<a id="event-2011-02-18-0-33"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tens of thousands of people march peacefully through Tirana urging the Albanian government to resign due to corruption in the Sali Berisha regime. 4 people were killed in a similar demonstration nearly a month ago.

Source citations (as archived): [CP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/canadianpress/article/ALeqM5i_q8cjVNtmKGLZ4VTJJA6BNENaUg?docId=5993057>); [AP](<https://www.nytimes.com/2011/02/19/world/europe/19briefs-Albania.html>); [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2011-02/19/c_13739103.htm>).

**Archived source account.** The corpse of Mark Rybinski is found with multiple stab wounds and a slit throat outside a private school in Tunis.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110219051826/http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2011/02/20112191176279419.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-18-2-0"></a>

<a id="event-2011-02-18-5-3"></a>

<a id="event-2011-02-18-5-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. state of Wisconsin has demonstrations in the tens of thousands against a bill forcing public service workers to pay increased pension costs, increased healthcare coverage as well as stripping them of almost all union rights. Senators yesterday fled the state to Illinois.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2011/US/02/18/wisconsin.budget/?hpt=T1>); [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/news/nationworld/nation/la-na-wisconsin-unions-20110218,0,5074043.story>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/video/2011/02/17/VI2011021705857.html>).

### 2011-02-20

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1357550780](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20February%2020&oldid=1357550780>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-02-20-0-2"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Libyan civil war:.

**Archived source account.** More than 200 people are killed and 900 other are injured as military troops attack protestors in Libya.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-12517327>); [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/world/story/2011/02/20/libya-protests.html>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2011/02/20112206386812127.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-20-0-3"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Libyan civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Members of a Libyan Army unit defect and claim to have "liberated" Benghazi.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/skynews/Article/201102115937134>).

<a id="event-2011-02-20-0-4"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Libyan civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Shaikh Faraj al Zuway, the head of the Zuwayya tribe in eastern Libya threatens to cut off oil exports unless the Government of Libya stops the "suppression of protestors".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110224034138/http://www.lse.co.uk/FinanceNews.asp?ArticleCode=r2q88tjiooucut9&amp;ArticleHeadline=Libya_tribal_chief_threatens_to_block_oil_exports_Jazeera>); [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/2011/02/20/uk-libya-protests-idUKTRE71G0AW20110220?pageNumber=2>).

<a id="event-2011-02-20-0-5"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Libyan civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Al Jazeera reports that the protests have spread to the capital Tripoli.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://blogs.aljazeera.net/middle-east/2011/02/17/live-blog-libya#>).

<a id="event-2011-02-20-0-7"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Bahraini protests:.

**Archived source account.** Anti-regime demonstrators continue their overnight occupation of Pearl Roundabout junction in Manama, chanting "Get out Hamad" in reference to the country's ruler, having reclaimed the junction after earlier being forced out by authorities.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/02/20112206279487320.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-20-0-9"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Moroccan protests:.

**Archived source account.** A coalition of Moroccan youth groups called “The February 20 Movement” calls for peaceful protests in cities throughout the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<http://www.alarabiya.net/articles/2011/02/19/138343.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-20-0-10"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Moroccan protests:.

**Archived source account.** Protests spread to the city of Rabat as thousands march on the central Hassan II Avenue calling for health and educational reform, economic opportunity and assistance against increased cost of living.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2011/02/201122013428971616.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-20-0-11"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Moroccan protests:.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of Moroccans demonstrate in Rabat demanding that King Mohammed VI give up some of his powers.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-12518116>); [Afrol News](<http://www.afrol.com/articles/37370>).

<a id="event-2011-02-20-0-13"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Yemeni protests:.

**Archived source account.** Nationwide anti-regime protests continue for the 11th consecutive day as one leader is arrested in Aden and thousands of people stage sit-ins in Ibb and Ta'izz calling for the resignation of President Ali Abdullah Saleh.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/02/2011220132734826964.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-20-0-16"></a>

Context: Protests in other parts of the world: / 2011 Chinese protests:.

**Archived source account.** Police in China show up in force in several cities after a call for a "Jasmine Revolution", and disperse protesters in Beijing and Shanghai.

Source citations (as archived): [Sify India](<http://www.sify.com/news/protesters-gather-in-beijing-shanghai-news-international-lcurOdjfcii.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-12517909>).

<a id="event-2011-02-20-0-18"></a>

Context: Protests in other parts of the world: / 2011 Iranian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Iranians are invited to attend a protest rally in Tehran and other cities in commememoration of the two people killed while attempting to demonstrate for better freedoms last week.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/02/20112197512326286.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-20-0-19"></a>

Context: Protests in other parts of the world: / 2011 Iranian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Mehdi Karroubi, the opposition leader under house arrest, calls for his trial to take place in public so that people can "get to know the truth". He posts the request on his website since he cannot leave his house to personally deliver it.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/02/201122053957526278.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-20-0-20"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-south-asia-12518798>).

Context: War in Pakistan:.

**Archived source account.** The Pakistan Army kills up to 15 insurgents in operations in the Mohmand Agency near the Afghan border.

<a id="event-2011-02-20-0-24"></a>

### 2011-02-21

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Libyan Civil War:.

**Archived source account.** Fine Gael leader Enda Kenny receives international congratulations from Angela Merkel, David Cameron and José Manuel Barroso, with Cameron inviting him to 10 Downing Street.

<a id="event-2011-02-27-6-3"></a>

<a id="event-2011-02-27-6-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Wisconsin AFL–CIO warns that hundreds of unionists will risk arrest in trying to prevent police clearing the Wisconsin State Capitol in the US city of Madison.,

Source citations (as archived): [Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel](<http://www.jsonline.com/news/statepolitics/117011928.html>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2011/POLITICS/02/27/wisconsin.budget/index.html#>).

<a id="event-2011-02-27-6-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Anonymous targets Koch Brothers-backed Americans for Prosperity to demonstrate against its support of anti-union legislation in Wisconsin and the influence of money in US politics.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<http://content.usatoday.com/communities/technologylive/post/2011/03/anonymous-actively-probing-koch-brothers-corporate-networks-/1>); [MSNBC](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120712042814/http://firstread.msnbc.msn.com/_news/2011/02/28/6154621-anonymous-attack>).

<a id="event-2011-02-27-6-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** The head of the Arab League Amr Moussa announces that he will run as a candidate in the Egyptian presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.chron.com/disp/story.mpl/ap/top/all/7448341.html>).

### 2011-02-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1185673560](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20February%2028&oldid=1185673560>).

#### Armed conflicts and incidents

<a id="event-2011-02-28-0-2"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / Libya:.

**Archived source account.** Al Jazeera reports that many African migrant workers in Libya have been victims of violence due to suspicions that they are mercenaries for Muammar Gaddafi's regime.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2011/02/201122865814378541.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-28-0-3"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / Libya:.

**Archived source account.** France sends two planeloads of aid to opponents of the Libyan regime in Benghazi.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/libyaNews/idAFLDE71R0FN20110228>).

<a id="event-2011-02-28-0-4"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / Libya:.

**Archived source account.** Forces loyal to Colonel Gaddafi surround the town of Zawiya as part of a general counterattack.,

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/02/28/us-libya-protests-idUSTRE71G0A620110228?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews>); [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2011/03/01/world/africa/01unrest.html?hp>).

<a id="event-2011-02-28-0-5"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / Libya:.

**Archived source account.** David Cameron, the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom announces that he is working on a no-fly zone over Libya.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<http://content.usatoday.com/communities/ondeadline/post/2011/02/britain-working-on-plans-for-a-no-fly-zone-over-libya/1>).

<a id="event-2011-02-28-0-6"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / Libya:.

**Archived source account.** The United States Secretary of State Hillary Clinton announces that the United States will be sending assistance teams to Libya's borders with Algeria and Egypt.

No attached source citation. This assertion is unverified; see its disclosure and research status above.

<a id="event-2011-02-28-0-7"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / Libya:.

**Archived source account.** Muammar Gaddafi tells the BBC that all of his people love him and refuses to acknowledge that there are protests in Tripoli.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-12603259>).

<a id="event-2011-02-28-0-8"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / Libya:.

**Archived source account.** The United States freezes $30 billion in Libyan assets.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2011/02/28/AR2011022802797.html?hpid=topnews>).

<a id="event-2011-02-28-0-9"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / Libya:.

**Archived source account.** The Justice and Equality Movement in Darfur, western Sudan, asks the United Nations to rescue its leader in Libya, after accusations he was supporting mercenary activities in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/topNews/idAFJOE71R0K020110228?sp=true>).

<a id="event-2011-02-28-0-10"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / Libya:.

**Archived source account.** Opposition forces rescue seven rebels 'buried alive' under concrete in a government compound in Benghazi, while close to 100,000 migrant workers flee Libya.

Source citations (as archived): [Herald Sun](<http://www.heraldsun.com.au/news/world/colonel-muammar-gaddafis-prisoners-buried-alive-in-benghazi/story-e6frf7lf-1226013599522>); [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-1361555/Libya-protests-Rescuers-7-buried-alive-Gaddafis-compound-Benghazi.html?ito=feeds-newsxml>).

<a id="event-2011-02-28-0-12"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Omani protests:.

**Archived source account.** Demonstrations calling for economic and political change continue for a third day, amid reports of looting.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/02/201122814254293647.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-28-0-14"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Bahraini protests:.

**Archived source account.** Bahraini protesters block access to the Parliament of Bahrain.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/middle-east/Bahrain-protesters-block-Parliament/articleshow/7593904.cms>).

<a id="event-2011-02-28-0-15"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ethiopia and Kenya may attack the al-Shabaab Islamist militant group in Somalia, following its threat to target Kenya.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/topNews/idAFJOE71R0GV20110228?sp=true>).

<a id="event-2011-02-28-0-16"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bomb explodes in Yangon, Burma, injuring eight people.

Source citations (as archived): [Straits Times](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110304153920/http://www.straitstimes.com/BreakingNews/SEAsia/Story/STIStory_639672.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2011-02-28-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Frank Buckles, the last surviving veteran of World War I in the United States, passes away in Charles Town, West Virginia, aged 110.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/us/2011/02/28/veteran-wwi-dies-w-va-age-110/?test=faces>).

<a id="event-2011-02-28-1-2"></a>

Context: Television advertising in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** The ban on product placement in television programmes is lifted, allowing advertisers to pay for their goods to be seen on British TV. The first product to be displayed in this regard is a Nescafe coffee machine, which appeared on This Morning.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-12593061>); [Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/finance/newsbysector/mediatechnologyandtelecoms/media/8352449/TV-product-placement-makes-a-typically-English-debut.html#>).

<a id="event-2011-02-28-1-3"></a>

Context: Television advertising in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** A year-long trial also begins allowing commercial television channels to show up to 12 minutes of adverts per hour during films and dramas, bringing them into line with soap operas where this is already permitted.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/culture/tvandradio/8341764/TV-films-to-be-interrupted-by-12-minutes-of-adverts.html#>).

<a id="event-2011-02-28-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hollywood actress and former sex symbol Jane Russell dies at age 89 of respiratory failure in Santa Maria, California.,,

Source citations (as archived): [Fox Central Florida](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110301200403/http://www.kcoy.com/global/story.asp?s=14158234>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/03/01/us-janerussell-idUSTRE72001620110301?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews>); [Hollywood Reporter](<http://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/gentlemen-prefer-blondes-star-jane-russell-dies-162533>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2011-02-28-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Crude oil prices rise to their highest levels in two years as stock market indexes fall in Europe and the United States due to continued uncertainty in the Middle East.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/2011-02-28/asia-stocks-fall-as-oil-gains-china-cuts-outlook-euro-drops-on-ireland.html>).

<a id="event-2011-02-28-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom's largest bank HSBC doubles its profits to $19bn (£11.8bn) in 2010.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/business/2011/feb/28/hsbc-profits-double-almost-twelve-billion-pounds>).

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-12604560>).

<a id="event-2011-02-28-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 16 people in Bandeira do Sul are killed after a high-voltage electric powerline crashed onto a float participating in a parade ahead of Brazil's carnival celebrations.

Source citations (as archived): [Straits Times](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110304154245/http://www.straitstimes.com/BreakingNews/World/Story/STIStory_639808.html>).

**Archived source account.** New Zealand police evacuate 60 properties in Christchurch suburbs after cracks from the 2011 Canterbury earthquake appear in cliffs.

<a id="event-2011-02-28-3-3"></a>

Context: New Zealand earthquakes:.

Source citations (as archived): [News Talk ZB](<http://www.newstalkzb.co.nz/newsdetail1.asp?storyID=191514>).

<a id="event-2011-02-28-3-4"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [BNO](<http://wrbsyndicate.com/News/Eleven-Chinese-missing-after-fishing-boat-sinks-in-East-China-Sea>).

#### International relations

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-12595145>); [Times Live South Africa](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110302113049/http://www.timeslive.co.za/africa/article941084.ece/Arms-for-Gbagbo>).

Chau alleges the book makes "false and defamtory statements" in order to use Chau as a foil for his protagonist, Steve Eisman.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/02/28/us-books-defamation-lewis-idUSTRE71R4XX20110228>).

<a id="event-2011-02-28-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the United Kingdom, three senior fire officers from the Warwickshire Fire Service are to face manslaughter by gross negligence charges over the deaths of four firefighters in a warehouse blaze in 2007.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-12598130>).

**Archived source account.** British Airways IT expert Rajib Karim is convicted on charges related to plotting to blow up a plane.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2011/03/14/Dalai-Lama-formally-resigns/UPI-38011300126321/>).

### 2011-03-15

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1284007657](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20March%2015&oldid=1284007657>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-03-15-0-1"></a>

Context: Arab Spring:.

**Archived source account.** The King of Bahrain Hamad ibn Isa Al Khalifa declares a three month state of emergency following the 2011 Bahraini protests.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/03/20113151296156152.html>).

<a id="event-2011-03-15-0-2"></a>

Context: Arab Spring:.

**Archived source account.** G8 leaders fail to agree on military intervention in Libya following the 2011 Libyan civil war, and pass the issue onto the United Nations Security Council.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<http://www.alarabiya.net/articles/2011/03/15/141576.html>).

<a id="event-2011-03-15-0-3"></a>

Context: Arab Spring:.

**Archived source account.** The Libyan opposition arrests four men as suspects in the murder of an Al Jazeera journalist and claim that Muammar Gaddafi's regime is sending undercover squads to assassinate people.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa/libyan-rebels-arrest-gaddafi-death-squad-that-killed-journalist-2241876.html#>).

<a id="event-2011-03-15-0-4"></a>

Context: Arab Spring:.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of people stage a rare protest in the Syrian capital Damascus calling for greater freedoms and the release of political prisoners.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-12749674>); [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5hrQWVGuiq7ZMP9eK1wFoD2Vw02ZA?docId=CNG.16e67dbc9289e73ea18d9b4a850113e8.4b1>).

<a id="event-2011-03-15-0-5"></a>

Context: Arab Spring:.

**Archived source account.** Yemeni tribesmen hold an anti-government protest after an attack on an oil pipeline in the east of the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Sify India](<http://www.sify.com/news/protests-in-yemen-after-attack-on-oil-pipeline-news-international-ldpvkojgdci.html>).

<a id="event-2011-03-15-0-6"></a>

Context: Arab Spring:.

**Archived source account.** Jobless protestors riot in the headquarters of Morocco's Office Chérifien des Phosphates in the city of Khouribga. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.trust.org/alertnet/news/riot-in-moroccos-phosphates-city-over-jobs>).

<a id="event-2011-03-15-0-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** 2010–2011 Ivorian crisis: Gunmen shoot four people dead at a roadblock run by supporters of disputed Côte d'Ivoire President Laurent Gbagbo.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/topNews/idAFJOE72E0ID20110315?sp=true>).

<a id="event-2011-03-15-0-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** A small bomb explodes in the offices of a moderate Islamic group in the Indonesian capital Jakarta, injuring four people.

Source citations (as archived): [Straits Times](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110319091748/http://www.straitstimes.com/BreakingNews/SEAsia/Story/STIStory_645354.html>); [Jakarta Globe](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110319094042/http://www.thejakartaglobe.com/home/two-targeted-by-bombs-as-terror-returns-to-capital/429334>).

<a id="event-2011-03-15-0-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Israeli Navy intercepts the cargo ship Victoria which was carrying a long list of advanced weapons that were smuggled from Iran and were allegedly bound for the militant organizations operating in the Gaza Strip.

Source citations (as archived): [Ynetnews](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4042721,00.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2011-03-15-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nasdaq OMX Group is preparing a bid for NYSE Euronext. Such a bid would, at the least, complicate the planned merger between NYSE and Deutsche Boerse. Reuters reported the planned counter-bid citing "a source familiar with the situation."

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/03/15/us-nyse-nasdaq-idUSTRE72D77E20110315>).

#### Disasters

<a id="event-2011-03-15-2-1"></a>

Context: 2011 Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami:.

**Archived source account.** Dozens of workers at the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear power complex (also called Fukushima I) have stayed behind to end the radiation leaks, known as the Fukushima 50, risking fatal radiation exposure.

Source citations (as archived): [Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/mar/15/fukushima-50-workers-nuclear-plant>).

<a id="event-2011-03-15-2-2"></a>

Context: 2011 Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami:.

**Archived source account.** There is a third explosion in four days at the Fukushima I Nuclear Power Plant following the 2011 Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami causing damage to its steel containment structure, the withdrawal of emergency workers and expected increases in radiation.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/A/AS_JAPAN_EARTHQUAKE_NUCLEAR_CRISIS?SITE=KYB66&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT&amp;CTIME=2011-03-14-19-34-04>); [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2011/03/15/world/asia/15nuclear.html?_r=1&amp;emc=na>); [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2011/03/15/world/asia/15nuclear.html?src=tptw>); [Daily Telegraph](<http://www.dailytelegraph.com.au/news/breaking-news/fire-burning-at-japan-nuclear-reactor/story-e6freuyi-1226021782079>).

<a id="event-2011-03-15-2-3"></a>

Context: 2011 Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami:.

**Archived source account.** Chief Cabinet Secretary Yukio Edano reports that as of 10.22 a.m. local time, radiation levels of 30 millisieverts per hour were measured between the No. 2 and No. 3 reactors, while at the No. 3 reactor 400 millisieverts per hour were detected, a harmful level to humans.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/2011-03-14/japan-appeals-for-international-aid-in-fight-to-prevent-a-nuclear-meltdown.html>).

<a id="event-2011-03-15-2-4"></a>

Context: 2011 Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami:.

**Archived source account.** A senior adviser to the Prime Minister of Japan Naoto Kan says that a fire has broken out in a fourth reactor at the Fukushima I power plant but it is later extinguished, with the radiation reading at 0831 local time (2331 GMT) climbing to 8,217 microsieverts an hour.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://news.blogs.cnn.com/2011/03/14/japan-quake-live-blog-rescuers-from-all-over-pitch-in-to-help/>); [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/A/AS_JAPAN_EARTHQUAKE?SITE=WVEC&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>); [news.com.au](<http://www.news.com.au/breaking-news/radiation-shoots-up-after-nuke-plant-blast/story-e6frfku0-1226021707383>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-12740843>).

<a id="event-2011-03-15-2-5"></a>

Context: 2011 Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami:.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Kan warns people living within a 30 kilometre radius of the plant to stay indoors and a 30-km no-fly zone is established around the plant.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/mar/15/japan-radiation-leak-nuclear-crisis>); [IAEA](<http://www.iaea.org/newscenter/news/tsunamiupdate01.html>).

<a id="event-2011-03-15-2-6"></a>

Context: 2011 Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami:.

**Archived source account.** A rise in radiation levels in Tokyo leads to panic buying and some residents leaving the capital.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/03/15/us-japan-quake-tokyo-idUSTRE72E0ZR20110315?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=worldNews>).

<a id="event-2011-03-15-2-7"></a>

Context: 2011 Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami:.

**Archived source account.** The United States Geological Survey revises the strength of the earthquake to 9.0.

Source citations (as archived): [USGS](<https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/eqinthenews/2011/usc0001xgp/>).

<a id="event-2011-03-15-2-8"></a>

Context: 2011 Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami:.

**Archived source account.** The National Police Agency advises that the official death toll from the quake is 2,414 dead with 3,118 injured.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.news.com.au/breaking-news/japan-quake-death-toll-tops-2400/story-e6frfku0-1226021723068?from=public_rss>).

<a id="event-2011-03-15-2-9"></a>

Context: 2011 Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami:.

**Archived source account.** Share prices on the Tokyo Stock Exchange decline by 12 per cent with the TOPIX index recording its largest fall since 1987.

Source citations (as archived): [Market Watch](<http://www.marketwatch.com/story/japans-nikkei-plunges-again-over-radiation-fears-2011-03-14>); [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/2011/03/15/idINIndia-55585420110315?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=businessNews>).

<a id="event-2011-03-15-2-10"></a>

Context: 2011 Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami:.

**Archived source account.** A magnitude 6.2 aftershock hits Fujinomiya, Shizuoka Prefecture southwest of Tokyo.

Source citations (as archived): [USGS](<https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/recenteqsww/Quakes/usc00023fx.php>); [Kyodo](<http://english.kyodonews.jp/news/2011/03/78331.html>); [Sky News Australia](<http://www.skynews.com.au/world/article.aspx?id=589382&amp;vId=>); [Adelaide Now](<http://www.adelaidenow.com.au/ipad/huge-aftershock-rocks-tokyo/story-fn6bqphm-1226022175753>).

#### History

<a id="event-2011-03-15-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The passing of the United States generation that fought in World War I is marked by the funeral of Frank Buckles, who died on 27 February 2011, aged 110, and was buried with full military honors at Arlington National Cemetery.,,,

Source citations (as archived): [The Sydney Morning Herald](<http://www.smh.com.au/world/a-grand-goodbye-as-us-salutes-its-oldest-soldier-20110316-1bx85.html?from=smh_sb>); [The Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/news/nationworld/nation/la-na-wwi-veteran-20110316,0,5385570.story>); [(The Washington Post\}](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/local/frank-buckles-last-known-us-world-war-i-veteran-is-laid-to-rest-at-arlington/2011/03/10/ABHVLFZ_story.html>); [The Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-1366613/Last-American-World-War-I-veteran-receives-heros-burial-military-honours.html?ito=feeds-newsxml>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2011-03-15-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The European Union holds talks with Aung San Suu Kyi and other Burmese opposition figures over the lifting of international sanctions. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Bangkok Post](<http://www.bangkokpost.com/news/asia/226875/eu-diplomats-talk-sanctions-with-burma-suu-kyi>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2011-03-15-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Egypt dissolves State Security Investigations Service, its former internal security and spying agency.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/topNews/idAFJOE72E0K420110315>).

<a id="event-2011-03-15-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Metropolitan Police in London, England, launch an investigation into the death of reggae musician Smiley Culture in a police raid in Surrey.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/music/2011/mar/15/smiley-culture-dies-police-raid?CMP=twt_fd>).

<a id="event-2011-03-15-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former US mafia leader Joey Merlino of the Scarfo crime family is released from prison in Indiana and is sent to a halfway house in Florida.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC Philaedelphia](<http://www.nbcphiladelphia.com/news/politics/Skinny-Joey-Merlino-Halfway-House-118037164.html>).

<a id="event-2011-03-15-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** German national Christian Gerhartsreiter is charged with the murder of a San Marino, California, man in the 1980s.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://latimesblogs.latimes.com/lanow/2011/03/illusive-clark-rockefeller-figure-charged-in-27-year-old-slaying-of-san-marino-man.html>).

<a id="event-2011-03-15-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Drug Enforcement Administration seizes the state of Georgia's supply of a lethal injection drug due to questions over how it was imported to the US.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110707152056/http://m.apnews.com/ap/db_15980/contentdetail.htm?contentguid=hCTaerTf>).

<a id="event-2011-03-15-5-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** United States nurse William Francis Melchert-Dinkel is convicted of aiding the suicides of an English man and Canadian woman.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/mobile/world-us-canada-12754211>).

#### Politics

<a id="event-2011-03-15-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At a British Medical Association conference, delegates call for the coalition government to halt its plans to overhaul the National Health Service in England. However, they stop short of complete opposition to the proposals.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/health-12737206>).

<a id="event-2011-03-15-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Angela Merkel, the Chancellor of Germany, announces that Germany will shut down all of its pre-1980 nuclear reactors following the problems in Japan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://news.yahoo.com/s/nm/20110315/wl_nm/us_germany_nuclear_merkel>).

<a id="event-2011-03-15-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Mayor of Miami-Dade County in the U.S. state of Florida, Carlos Alvarez, and County commissioner Natacha Seijas are defeated in recall elections. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Miami Herald](<http://www.miamiherald.com/2011/03/15/v-fullstory/2115658/polls-open-for-recall-election.html>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2011-03-15-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tickets go on sale for the 2012 Summer Olympics to be held in London.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-12733676>).

### 2011-03-16

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076429408](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20March%2016&oldid=1076429408>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-03-16-0-1"></a>

Context: Arab Spring:.

**Archived source account.** Bahrain security forces drive out protestors from the Pearl Roundabout, resulting in several deaths.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/03/201131643831976772.html>); [Ynet](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4043057,00.html>).

<a id="event-2011-03-16-0-2"></a>

Context: Arab Spring:.

**Archived source account.** Forces loyal to Muammar Gaddafi shell Misrata as the civil war continues and start an assault on Ajdabiya the last town before the rebel stronghold of Benghazi.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2011/03/201131692353456943.html>); [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/topNews/idAFJOE72F08X20110316?sp=true>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-12756874>).

<a id="event-2011-03-16-0-3"></a>

Context: Arab Spring:.

**Archived source account.** Demonstrators defy a government ban in the Syrian capital Damascus and protest for a second day, demanding the release of political prisoners.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-12757394>); [Ahram Online](<http://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/2/8/7833/World/Region/Syrian-security-forces-disperse-demo-near-interior.aspx>).

<a id="event-2011-03-16-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Israeli Air Force attacks a training site of the Palestinian militant group Al Qassam brigades in the southern part of Gaza City in response to a rocket launched from the Gaza Strip at the Israeli southern communities in the Sdot Negev Regional Council in the southern district of Israel. Palestinians reported that three people were killed in the attack and three were wounded.

Source citations (as archived): [Palestine News Network](<http://english.pnn.ps/index.php?option=com_content&amp;task=view&amp;id=9716>); [idfspokesperson.com](<http://idfspokesperson.com/2011/03/16/in-response-to-rocket-fire-iaf-targets-terror-activity-site-in-the-gaza-strip/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2011-03-16-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Japan's Nikkei 225 improves by six per cent as concerns over the 2011 Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami on the economy are reduced.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-12755374>).

<a id="event-2011-03-16-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Japanese yen reaches a postwar high against the United States dollar on the basis that Japanese insurers will redeem overseas assets to pay for the cost of the Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Week](<http://www.businessweek.com/news/2011-03-16/yen-strengthens-to-record-against-dollar-on-radiation-concern.html>).

#### Disasters

<a id="event-2011-03-16-2-1"></a>

Context: Fukushima I nuclear accidents:.

**Archived source account.** Another fire breaks out at the Fukushima I Nuclear Power Plant in northern Honshu, Japan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110710171309/http://www.edmontonexaminer.com/ArticleDisplay.aspx?e=3026628>).

<a id="event-2011-03-16-2-2"></a>

Context: Fukushima I nuclear accidents:.

**Archived source account.** Radiation levels rise inside and outside the plant leading to the temporary evacuation of emergency workers.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<http://thelede.blogs.nytimes.com/2011/03/15/latest-updates-on-japans-nuclear-crisis-and-earthquake-aftermath-2/#chief-cabinet-secretarys-news-conference>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-12755739>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/03/16/us-japan-quake-idUSTRE72A0SS20110316?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews>).

<a id="event-2011-03-16-2-3"></a>

Context: Fukushima I nuclear accidents:.

**Archived source account.** Gregory Jaczko, the head of the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission tells a United States Congressional panel that his Commission is recommending a higher exclusion zone.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110317002815/http://www.voanews.com/english/news/US-Nuclear-Chief-Says-Japan-Should-Expand-Evacuation-Zone-Around-Damaged-Plant-118124794.html>).

<a id="event-2011-03-16-2-5"></a>

Context: Japanese earthquake and tsunami:.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the Japanese earthquake and tsunami rises to 4,277 with at least 8,194 missing.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://news.blogs.cnn.com/2011/03/15/japan-quake-live-blog-fire-erupts-in-fourth-reactor-radiation-warning-issued/>); [NineMSN](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110319084752/http://news.ninemsn.com.au/world/japanquake/8224937/over-12000-missing-or-dead-in-japan-quake>).

<a id="event-2011-03-16-2-6"></a>

Context: Japanese earthquake and tsunami:.

**Archived source account.** The Emperor of Japan Akihito expresses his condolences to the victims of the earthquake and tsunami.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.chron.com/disp/story.mpl/ap/top/all/7474165.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2011-03-16-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police in Cambodia ask prosecutors to charge recruitment firm T&amp;P with illegally detaining its staff.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-12756040>).

<a id="event-2011-03-16-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Raymond Davis, an official with the United States embassy in Pakistan, is acquitted of charges of two counts of murder and released from jail after compensation is paid to the victims' families, the result of intense diplomatic talks between the United States and Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/asiapcf/03/16/pakistan.cia.charges/index.html>); [Times of Pakistan](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120317105859/http://timesofpakistan.pk/pakistan/2011-03-16/raymond-davis-set-free/28121/>).

#### Politics

<a id="event-2011-03-16-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hillary Clinton, the United States Secretary of State, states that she will not serve a second term in President Obama's Cabinet if he is reelected in 2012 and will retire from public life.

Source citations (as archived): [Huffington Post](<http://www.huffingtonpost.com/2011/03/16/hillary-clinton-obama-cabinet_n_836635.html>).

<a id="event-2011-03-16-4-2"></a>

Context: Michigan protests:.

**Archived source account.** The Governor of Michigan Rick Snyder signs legislation giving enhanced powers to emergency managers appointed to manage cities and schools including the power to terminate union contracts. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}
