<a id="event-2011-03-16-4-3"></a>

Context: Michigan protests:.

**Archived source account.** Michigan State Police remove eleven protesters in the State Capitol following a rally attended by thousands of people. \{\{Dead link\|date=May 2020 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Detroit Free Press](<http://www.freep.com/article/20110316/NEWS15/110316047/1001/news>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2011-03-16-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The organisers of the 2011 Rugby World Cup in New Zealand decide to reschedule games originally due to be held in Christchurch due to damage caused to Lancaster Park by the 2011 Canterbury earthquake.

Source citations (as archived): [Rugby World Cup](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110319092549/http://www.rugbyworldcup.com/destinationnewzealand/news/newsid=2042074.html#christchurch+hosting+rwc+2011+games+decision>); [Sydney Morning Herald](<http://www.smh.com.au/rugby-union/union-news/christchurch-loses-world-cup-hosting-rights-20110316-1bwqh.html>).

#### Transport

<a id="event-2011-03-16-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Indian Railways driver Surekha Yadav loco pilot mail drives the Deccan Queen from Pune to Mumbai CST, for Central Railways division, and becomes the first woman from this country to do so.

### 2011-03-17

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1229278879](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20March%2017&oldid=1229278879>).

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2011-03-17-0-1"></a>

Context: United States bombing of civilians in Pakistan:.

**Archived source account.** At least 40 people, most believed to be civilians, are killed near Miranshah after United States drones bomb Pakistan in the deadliest such attack by the United States since 2006. Tribesmen describe a "massacre" as tribal people, elders, local traders and members of the tribal police are killed.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-south-asia-12769209>); [The Nation](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110319101404/http://nation.com.pk/pakistan-news-newspaper-daily-english-online/Regional/Islamabad/17-Mar-2011/US-drone-stike-kills-30-in-NWaziristan>).

<a id="event-2011-03-17-0-2"></a>

Context: United States bombing of civilians in Pakistan:.

**Archived source account.** The Chief of Army Staff (COAS) General Ashfaq Parvez Kayani condemns the U.S. drone attack on civilians in Pakistan, criticising events which saw elders "carelessly and callously targeted with complete disregard to human life \[...\] in complete violation of human rights".

Source citations (as archived): [The News International](<http://www.thenews.com.pk/NewsDetail.aspx?ID=12770>); [DAWN](<http://www.dawn.com/2011/03/17/gen-kayani-condemns-us-drone-strike-in-nw.html>); [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5jvs6G-rUFtaxZ-CYtFeIcu3RPftw?docId=f0b7ba1cc7c24e18abf14d05635a80b7>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-south-asia-12779232>).

### 2011-03-19

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2011-03-19-0-1"></a>

Context: 2011 Libyan civil war:.

**Archived source account.** The Libyan opposition stronghold of Benghazi is bombed by pro-Gaddafi forces despite the declaration of a no-fly zone by the United Nations.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.channelnewsasia.com/stories/afp_world/view/1117512/1/.html>).

<a id="event-2011-03-19-0-2"></a>

Context: 2011 Libyan civil war:.

**Archived source account.** The President of the United States Barack Obama warns Muammar Gaddafi of "consequences" if attacks on civilians continue.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.news.com.au/world/gaddafi-says-benghazi-attack-today/story-e6frfkyi-1226023693860?from=public_rss>).

<a id="event-2011-03-19-0-3"></a>

Context: 2011 Libyan civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Forces loyal to Muammar Gaddafi enter Benghazi. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/03/19/us-libya-idUSTRE7270JP20110319>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2011/03/201131934914112208.html>); [Tunis Afrique Press News Agency](<http://www.tap.info.tn/en/index.php?option=com_content&amp;task=view&amp;id=16175&amp;Itemid=56>).

<a id="event-2011-03-19-0-4"></a>

Context: 2011 Libyan civil war:.

**Archived source account.** The French Air Force starts flying missions over Libya as top officials from Europe, the United States and the Arab world vow to take action.,

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-12795971>); [MSNBC](<http://www.msnbc.msn.com/id/42164455/ns/world_news-mideastn_africa/>); [AP](<http://www.chron.com/disp/story.mpl/ap/top/all/7480381.html>).

Context: 2011 Libyan civil war:.

**Archived source account.** The United States Navy fires Tomahawk cruise missiles at Gaddafi's air defenses as Operation Odyssey Dawn gets underway.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2011/03/19/france-fires-libyan-military-vehicle/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/03/19/us-libya-usa-strike-idUSTRE72I3N120110319?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews>).

**Archived source account.** Syrian security forces fire tear gas at a funeral for two men killed in an earlier protest in the southern city of Daraa.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5imPTFixkG47Y44ZniAQVv4wC6UGw?docId=CNG.301dc17b5d60dc6790da1726987ffe7d.c71>).

Context: Arab Spring.

**Archived source account.** Protests continue in Yemen after the shooting of anti-government demonstrators yesterday, and two ruling party members resign.

<a id="event-2011-03-19-0-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** Algerian President Abdelaziz Bouteflika promises political reform, as security forces prevent protests in the capital Algiers.

<a id="event-2011-03-19-0-13"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** More than 50 mortar rounds are fired from the Gaza Strip at an area in the Western Negev, Israel, injuring two Israeli civilians in response to Israeli airstrikes earlier in the week, which was itself a response to a previous Palestinian mortar attack from Gaza. Israel counterresponds with artillery and airstrikes killing two Palestinian militants.

Source citations (as archived): [Ynetnews](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4044337,00.html>); [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/news/diplomacy-defense/idf-kills-two-palestinian-terrorists-near-gaza-border-1.350301>).

<a id="event-2011-03-19-0-14"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** Police in the Gaza Strip break up a student rally calling for unity between Fatah and Hamas and raid offices of foreign media covering the event.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2011/03/19/Hamas-breaks-up-rally-attacks-the-press/UPI-31221300554368/>).

<a id="event-2011-03-19-0-15"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** The office of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu office reportedly calls for the United States to thwart Palestinian attempts to create a unity government; however, Hamas opposes Abbas' visit to Gaza claiming he is using the visit as a "ploy," and demands the release of Hamas prisoners held by the Palestinian Authority in West Bank

Source citations (as archived): [Ma'an News Agency](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110323192952/http://www.maannews.net/eng/ViewDetails.aspx?ID=369897>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/MiddleEast/Article.aspx?id=213035>).

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2011-03-20-0-2"></a>

<a id="event-2011-03-20-0-4"></a>

<a id="event-2011-03-20-0-27"></a>

Context: Arab Spring / 2011 Moroccan protests:.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people rally across the country demanding more civil rights and an end to corruption.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/03/20/us-morocco-protests-idUSTRE72J2GT20110320?pageNumber=1>).

<a id="event-2011-03-20-0-29"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** Palestinian militants fire a Grad-type rocket from Gaza into southern Ashkelon, Israel; two residents are taken to a clinic for medical treatment.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Defense/Article.aspx?id=213034>); [Ynet](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4045126,00.html>).

<a id="event-2011-03-20-0-30"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** The bodies of two 17-year-old Palestinians, shot dead by the Israeli military near the Gaza-Israel border yesterday, are retrieved; the military says the army opened fire on two men who were spotted moving suspiciously toward a frontier "no-go" zone, after fierce cross-border exchanges in which militants fired dozens of shells into Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5gZwbaZ6aGLzfxezELs78jLw6d4Sg?docId=CNG.58e763c4f9e27c86cf73881d881278bb.8d1>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-12799772>).

<a id="event-2011-03-20-0-31"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** Israel shuts down every crossing with the Gaza Strip, citing "security reasons", ahead of the Purim Jewish holiday.

Source citations (as archived): [Press TV](<http://www.presstv.ir/detail/170852.html>).

<a id="event-2011-03-20-0-32"></a>

**Archived source account.** 12 people are killed in clashes between Transitional Federal Government troops and al-Shabaab rebels in southern Somalia.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5hXx65FzgHacHMkN9qkH9S5WaEGHQ?docId=CNG.30929bbed886ca3041584a88b0537905.bd1>); [Press TV](<http://www.presstv.ir/detail/170839.html>).

<a id="event-2011-03-20-0-34"></a>

Context: Demonstrations against the treatment of Bradley Manning:.

**Archived source account.** A protest against the alleged "appalling" treatment by the United States of Bradley Manning occurs in London, with supporters from Wales, where Manning attended school, attending.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-wales-12800705>); [Wales Online](<http://www.walesonline.co.uk/news/wales-news/2011/03/20/usa-treatment-of-wikileaks-suspect-bradley-manning-appalling-mp-ann-clwyd-91466-28368202/>).

<a id="event-2011-03-20-0-35"></a>

Context: Demonstrations against the treatment of Bradley Manning:.

**Archived source account.** A rally occurs in Quantico in the U.S. state of Virginia where Manning is currently imprisoned. \{\{Dead link\|date=May 2020 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.wtkr.com/news/sns-ap-dc--wikileaks-armyprivate-rally,0,1192790.story>); [Huffington Post](<http://www.huffingtonpost.com/2011/03/19/human-rights-activists-protest-abuse-bradley-manning_n_838006.html>).

<a id="event-2011-03-20-0-36"></a>

Context: Demonstrations against the treatment of Bradley Manning:.

**Archived source account.** American security forces arrest 35 people protesting against the "torture" of Manning at Quantico during an event addressed by, among others, Pentagon Papers whistleblower Daniel Ellsberg. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\} \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Inside NoVA](<http://www2.insidenova.com/news/2011/mar/20/2/hundreds-rally-quantico-suspected-wikileaks-whistl-ar-916404/>); [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5hSSr7plWJ9p7GhIwVQVs_GxM1BHQ?docId=270cbb484a194ad0b99bdcaab1840338>); [Newsday](<http://www.newsday.com/news/nation/about-30-arrested-at-rally-for-wikileaks-suspect-1.2772325>); [Washington Examiner](<http://washingtonexaminer.com/blogs/capital-land/2011/03/protestors-arrested-defending-alleged-wiki-leaker>).

<a id="event-2011-03-20-0-37"></a>

Context: Demonstrations against the treatment of Bradley Manning:.

**Archived source account.** Ellsberg, who leaked information about U.S. government lies during the Vietnam War, says he does not mind being arrested in Manning's name, claiming "I was that young man; I was Bradley Manning".

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110322003620/http://articles.cnn.com/2011-03-19/us/wikileaks.ellsberg.manning_1_daniel-ellsberg-pentagon-papers-young-man?_s=PM:US>).

<a id="event-2011-03-22-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Robert Cooper, special advisor to Baroness Catherine Ashton (High Representative of the European Union for political, foreign affairs and security), despite serious concerns over excessive and indiscriminate use of force expressed by UN Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon, speaking to MEPs in the foreign affairs committee in Brussels, defended Bahrain's protests crackdown: "It's not easy dealing with large demonstrations in which there may be violence. It's a difficult task for policemen. It's not something that we always get right in the best Western countries and. Cooper's endorsement disturbed one MEP at the debate. "'Accidents happen?'... I'm sorry this is a funny picture as you describe it," German Green deputy Franziska Brantner said. "What are you talking about? I find this very scary."

Source citations (as archived): [UN News Centre](<http://www.un.org/apps/news/story.asp?NewsID=37817&amp;Cr=bahrain&amp;Cr1=>); [after visiting Bahrain (Saudi News Today)](<http://www.saudinewstoday.com/article/53138__Bahrain%27s+Interior+Minister+Meets+EU+Official>); [accidents happen" (Guardian)](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/mar/23/bahrain-protest-crackdown-eu-envoy>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2011-03-22-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The former President of Israel, Moshe Katsav, is sentenced to seven years in prison, two years probation and payment of compensation to his victims on charges of rape, indecent assault, sexual harassment and obstruction of justice. Current President Shimon Peres says that "this is a sad day but everyone is equal before the law."

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/news/national/former-president-moshe-katsav-gets-7-years-in-jail-for-rape-sexual-offenses-1.351092>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/ArtsAndCulture/Entertainment/Article.aspx?id=213278>).

### 2011-03-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076415374](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20March%2023&oldid=1076415374>).

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2011-03-23-0-1"></a>

Context: 2011 Syrian protests.

**Archived source account.** Syrian forces kill at least four people at the Omari Mosque in the southern Syrian city of Deraa following days of protest against the Ba'ath Party.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/03/23/us-syria-gunfire-idUSTRE72M04T20110323?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-12827542>).

<a id="event-2011-03-23-0-2"></a>

Context: 2011 Syrian protests.

**Archived source account.** The government fires the governor of Daraa province.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/meast/03/23/syria.protests/index.html?hpt=T2>).

<a id="event-2011-03-23-0-4"></a>

Context: 2011 Libyan civil war.

**Archived source account.** Kuwait and Jordan provide logistics, and Turkey adds five ships and a submarine to the military intervention in Libya.

Source citations (as archived): [(hurrieyet))](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110326031816/http://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/n.php?n=urgent--turkey-offers-warships-for-libya-arms-embargo-nato-2011-03-23>); [DAWN](<http://www.dawn.com/2011/03/23/kuwait-jordan-to-give-logistic-help-to-libya-action-uk.html>); [France24](<http://www.france24.com/en/20110323-gaddafi-keeps-assault-attacks-airstrikes-rain-down>).

<a id="event-2011-03-23-0-5"></a>

Context: 2011 Libyan civil war.

**Archived source account.** Libyan forces loyal to Muammar Gaddafi continue to attack the cities of Ajdabiya, Misrata and Zintan despite the western intervention.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/mar/22/libya-gaddafi-forces-offensive>).

<a id="event-2011-03-23-0-6"></a>

Context: 2011 Libyan civil war.

**Archived source account.** Air Vice Marshal Greg Bagwell of the British Royal Air Force claims that the Libyan Air Force "no longer exists as a fighting force".

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/stories/2011/03/23/eveningnews/main20046431.shtml>).

<a id="event-2011-03-23-0-8"></a>

Context: 2011 Yemeni protests.

**Archived source account.** The President of Yemen Ali Abdullah Saleh offers to stand down by the end of the year and warns of a "civil war" as 2011 Yemeni protests continue.

Source citations (as archived): [Al-Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/03/2011321164113728994.html>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/meast/03/23/yemen.protests/>).

<a id="event-2011-03-23-0-9"></a>

Context: 2011 Yemeni protests.

**Archived source account.** The Parliament of Yemen passes emergency laws giving broader powers of arrest to the Government.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/mar/23/yemen-emergency-laws-protests>).

<a id="event-2011-03-23-0-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Islamic Jihad militants in the Gaza Strip fire ten mortars at the Eshkol, Sha'ar Hanegev region, and Grad rockets at the Israeli cities of Ashkelon and Beersheba; one person is injured in Beersheba.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/news/diplomacy-defense/gaza-militants-fire-grad-rocket-at-be-er-sheva-following-idf-strike-1.351301?localLinksEnabled=false>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Defense/Article.aspx?id=213412>); [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/world/islamic-jihad-hits-beersheba/story-e6frg6so-1226027009316>).

<a id="event-2011-03-23-0-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** An explosive device which was placed in a suitcase on the sidewalk exploded next to bus number 74 near the Jerusalem International Convention Center complex. A woman is killed in the explosion and at least 50 people are injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/news/diplomacy-defense/bomb-explodes-in-central-jerusalem-25-wounded-1.351377>); [Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/ArtsAndCulture/Entertainment/Article.aspx?id=213442>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/03/201132313166975300.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-12836224>); [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/world/bus-bomb-blast-follows-deadly-gaza-bombing-raids/story-e6frg6so-1226027190433>).

<a id="event-2011-03-23-1-0"></a>

<a id="event-2011-03-23-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Prime Minister of Japan Naoto Kan instructs the Governor of Fukushima Prefecture Yūhei Satō to advise residents to avoid eating leafy vegetables, due to the Fukushima I nuclear accidents.

**Archived source account.** The Tokyo Metropolitan Government Bureau of Waterworks says levels of radioactive iodine in city tap water are two times the recommended limit for infants.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2011-03-23-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Roberto Maroni, the Italian Minister of the Interior, flies to Tunis to discuss stopping the flow of Tunisian immigrants to the small island of Lampedusa following the Tunisian Revolution.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-12827118>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2011-03-23-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Egyptian committee set up to investigate violence during demonstrations that ousted former President Hosni Mubarak has charged him and the interior minister with the intentional murder of protesters.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/MiddleEast/Article.aspx?id=213411>).

<a id="event-2011-03-23-5-2"></a>

Context: Moriarty Tribunal:.

**Archived source account.** The Moriarty Tribunal, which yesterday found former government minister Michael Lowry guilty "beyond doubt" of assisting billionaire businessman Denis O'Brien in gaining a mobile phone license for Esat Digifone, in actions judged "disgraceful and insidious" by the tribunal, is referred to the Director of Public Prosecutions (DPP).

Source citations (as archived): [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2011/0323/moriarty.html>).

<a id="event-2011-03-23-5-3"></a>

Context: Moriarty Tribunal:.

**Archived source account.** Fianna Fáil leader Micheál Martin asks that Michael Lowry resign over his part in what he calls "the greatest corporate scandal in the history of the State".

Source citations (as archived): [Inside Ireland](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120313033612/http://insideireland.ie/2011/03/23/martin-calls-for-michael-lowry-to-consider-position-12837/>).

<a id="event-2011-03-23-5-4"></a>

Context: Moriarty Tribunal:.

**Archived source account.** Former Denis O'Brien employee and journalist Sarah Carey's "significant leaking" of tribunal information is judged by the tribunal to have been "irresponsible" and "not remotely justified".

Source citations (as archived): [The Irish Times](<http://www.irishtimes.com/newspaper/ireland/2011/0323/1224292847422.html>).

<a id="event-2011-03-23-5-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit refuses to allow same-sex marriages to resume in the US state of California while it considers the constitutionality of Proposition 8.

Source citations (as archived): [San Francisco Chronicle](<http://www.sfgate.com/cgi-bin/article.cgi?f=/c/a/2011/03/23/BA9G1II16S.DTL>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2011-03-23-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people gather in Canberra, Australia to protest the introduction of a carbon tax, Prime Minister Julia Gillard met the Australian Youth Climate Coalition which is pushing for a price on emissions, while climate change mitigation activists including the Australian Council of Trade Unions delivered a petition to Minister for Climate Change and Energy Efficiency Greg Combet signed by about 10,000 "working Australians" urging the government to take action.

Source citations (as archived): [AAP](<http://www.adelaidenow.com.au/news/breaking-news/anti-carbon-tax-rally-told-prime-minister-julia-gillard-like-pinocchio/story-e6frea73-1226026686775>); [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/national-affairs/climate/carbon-tax-protesters-labelled-extremists-as-they-rally-in-canberra/story-e6frg6xf-1226026565064>); [Sydney Morning Herald](<http://news.smh.com.au/breaking-news-national/tax-climate-protesters-rally-20110323-1c5iy.html>); [Daily Telegraph](<http://www.dailytelegraph.com.au/news/more-than-3000-rally-against-carbon-tax-outside-parliament-house/story-e6freuy9-1226026717154>).

<a id="event-2011-03-23-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Chancellor of the Exchequer George Osborne delivers the 2011 United Kingdom budget.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/finance/budget/8395079/Budget-2011-live.html>).

<a id="event-2011-03-23-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Israeli Knesset passes a new law which requires the state to fine local authorities and other state-funded bodies for denying Israel as Jewish, democratic state or supporting racism, armed resistance against Israel, or desecrating the state flag or national symbols, including holding events marking Nakba Day.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-12837953>); [Ynet](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4046440,00.html>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/DiplomacyAndPolitics/Article.aspx?id=213396>).

<a id="event-2011-03-23-6-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Liberal Party of Canada announces it will introduce a motion to the Canadian House of Commons that calls on MPs to support a committee report finding the Conservative government in contempt of Parliament. The finding was in response to the government allegedly not supplying sufficient information on costs of crime bills, purchasing F-35 fighter jets for the Canadian Forces, and corporate tax cuts.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/story/2011/03/23/pol-leaders-politics.html>).

<a id="event-2011-03-23-6-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Prime Minister of Portugal José Sócrates resigns after the parliament rejects austerity measures.,

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.thestar.com/business/article/959736--opposition-parties-defeat-portugal-s-austerity-measures>); [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/2011/03/24/idINIndia-55834020110324?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=businessNews>).

**Archived source account.** Spain bans the new Basque nationalist political party Sortu.

Source citations (as archived): [Wall Street Journal](<http://online.wsj.com/article/BT-CO-20110323-714658.html>).

### 2011-03-24

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-03-24-0-1"></a>

Context: Arab Spring.

**Archived source account.** Protest in Jordan sees 500 March in Jordan's capital Amman demanding the removal of prime minister Marouf al-Bakhit and other reforms.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://news.yahoo.com/s/ap/20110324/ap_on_re_mi_ea/ml_jordan>).

<a id="event-2011-03-24-0-3"></a>

Context: Arab Spring / 2011 Syrian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Witnesses and rights activists say Syrian government security forces killed at least 15 anti-government protesters in Daraa, bringing the death toll for the week to 21.

Source citations (as archived): [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/world/security-forces-reportedly-open-fire-outside-a-mosque/story-e6frg6so-1226027178517>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-12843905>).

<a id="event-2011-03-24-0-4"></a>

Context: Arab Spring / 2011 Syrian protests:.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian government pledges a series of reforms in response to the unrest, including lifting the state of emergency law and allowing other political parties.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/03/2011324164740741279.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-12853634>).

<a id="event-2011-03-24-0-6"></a>

Context: Moriarty Tribunal in Ireland:.

**Archived source account.** Former government minister Michael Lowry refuses to resign the seat he recently claimed back in Dáil Éireann in the aftermath of the Moriarty Tribunal's findings that he assisted billionaire businessman Denis O'Brien "beyond doubt" in gaining a mobile phone license for Esat Digifone, in actions judged "disgraceful and insidious" by the tribunal. Taoiseach Enda Kenny admits Fine Gael accepted a donation worth thousands of dollars from Esat at the time.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-04-07-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Mexican Drug War-related march inspired by the killing of seven people, one of whom was the son of prominent poet and journalist Javier Sicilia, occur in more than 20 Mexican cities, with marchers chanting "No more blood\!".

Context: Libya:.

**Archived source account.** NATO kills at least 13 Libyan rebels and injures many more in an air raid near Ajdabiya after rebels reportedly fired on NATO planes, though there is speculation that the air-strike may have come from Gaddafi's fighter jets evading the no fly zone.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-12997181>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2011/04/20114711651619495.html>).

### 2011-04-08

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-04-08-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 12 Palestinians, including 3 civilians, are killed by Israeli air strikes in Gaza in response to numerous mortar and rocket attacks.

<a id="event-2011-04-08-0-1"></a>

The capital's shops shut down and traffic is suspended.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-south-asia-13009558>).

<a id="event-2011-04-08-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Today's Friday protests take place in Egypt, Iraq, Syria and Yemen among other places.

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2011-04-24-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A group of 15 Israeli Jewish worshipers entered the Palestinian city of Nablus to pray in the Jewish holy site Joseph's Tomb, without coordinating their visit with the IDF as required by law. After finishing praying, as the Jewish worshipers were leaving Nablus, their cars came under fire from a Palestinian Authority police jeep. Five Israelis were injured in the attack and the nephew of Israeli Culture and Sport Minister Limor Livnat was killed.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Home/Article.aspx?id=217690>); [Ynet](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4060103,00.html>).

<a id="event-2011-04-24-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** After the shooting, Ynet reports "Palestinian sources reported local Palestinian youths gathered around the Joseph Tomb's compound shortly after the incident and set it on fire."

Source citations (as archived): [Ynet](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4060163,00.html>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Home/Article.aspx?id=217690>).

Context: Arab Spring:.

**Archived source account.** Tunisian revolution: Thousands of people demonstrate in Tunis to demand both the resignation of interim prime minister Beji Caid el Sebsi, a link with the old guard brought down in January's popular revolution, and the prosecution of Zine El Abidine Ben Ali, who fled to Saudi Arabia after being ousted, on charges such as murder and drug-trafficking.

Source citations (as archived): [Press TV](<http://www.presstv.ir/detail/176537.html>).

<a id="event-2011-04-24-0-8"></a>

Context: Arab Spring:.

**Archived source account.** 2011 Syrian protests: Police and soldiers open fire from rooftops in Jabla, killing and injuring nearby people; no protest was taking place at the time. An independent investigation is urged into Friday's massacre of close to 100 people as well as Saturday's killings of mourners at the funerals.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-13180847>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/meast/04/24/syria.unrest/index.html>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/04/2011424181530901869.html>).

### 2011-04-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1185383552](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20April%2025&oldid=1185383552>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-04-25-0-1"></a>

Context: Guantanamo Files:.

**Archived source account.** WikiLeaks releases classified cables detailing the interrogations carried out by the United States at the Guantanamo Bay detention camp, as well as the imprisonment in the camp of Afghans and Pakistanis, children, elderly and mentally ill, before later being released without charge.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/apr/25/guantanamo-files-lift-lid-prison>); [The Sydney Morning Herald](<http://www.smh.com.au/world/wikileaks-releases-new-guantanamo-files-20110425-1dtne.html>).

<a id="event-2011-04-25-0-2"></a>

Context: Guantanamo Files:.

**Archived source account.** The cables show the United States relied on the internationally widely available Casio F91W digital watch as "the sign of al-Qaida" and as "evidence" to imprison its captives in the Guantanamo Bay detention camp.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/apr/25/guantanamo-files-casio-wristwatch-alqaida>).

<a id="event-2011-04-25-0-3"></a>

Context: Guantanamo Files:.

**Archived source account.** Staff at Guantánamo Bay were instructed that any Muslim traveling to Afghanistan after 11 September 2001 was likely to have gone there "to support Osama bin Laden through direct hostilities against the US forces", with any other reasons being dismissed as "total fabrications", making it difficult for the interrogated to plead their innocence.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/apr/25/guantanamo-files-interrogation-muslim-travel>).

<a id="event-2011-04-25-0-4"></a>

Context: Guantanamo Files:.

**Archived source account.** Details of U.S. collaboration with at least 10 foreign intelligence agencies emerge, with Chinese, Tunisian, Moroccan, Russian, Saudi, Tajik, Jordanian, Algerian, Yemeni and Kuwaiti delegations assisting the U.S. with interrogations at the Guantanamo Bay detention camp, and China and Russia vowing to prosecute and punish any repatriated Uighurs or Uzbeks.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/apr/25/guantanamo-files-china-interrogated-prisoners>).

<a id="event-2011-04-25-0-5"></a>

Context: Guantanamo Files:.

**Archived source account.** A British resident, an organiser of hunger strikes imprisoned for nine years without trial and whose release has been repeatedly requested by William Hague, remains locked up in the Guantanamo Bay detention camp.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/apr/25/guantanamo-files-shaker-aamer-british>).

<a id="event-2011-04-25-0-6"></a>

Context: Guantanamo Files:.

**Archived source account.** Details of how an al-Qaeda-linked militant duped Canadian intelligence agents also emerge.

Source citations (as archived): [The Globe and Mail](<https://www.theglobeandmail.com/news/world/wikileaks-unearths-case-of-al-qaeda-double-agent-who-duped-canadians/article1997237/>).

<a id="event-2011-04-25-0-7"></a>

Context: Guantanamo Files:.

**Archived source account.** It is disclosed that an Al Jazeera journalist imprisoned by the United States at Guantánamo for six years was interrogated about the news network. He claims to have been beaten and sexually assaulted.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/apr/25/guantanamo-files-sami-al-hajj?intcmp=239>).

<a id="event-2011-04-25-0-8"></a>

Context: Guantanamo Files:.

**Archived source account.** The controversial detention in the Guantanamo Bay detention camp of anti-extremist author Abdul Badr Mannan emerges.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/apr/25/guantanamo-files-framed-author-mannan>).

<a id="event-2011-04-25-0-9"></a>

Context: Guantanamo Files:.

**Archived source account.** It emerges that the U.S. government released dozens of Guantánamo inmates it regarded as "high risk" and that one of the rebels it is backing in the ongoing 2011 Libyan Civil War fought for the Taliban against the Soviet Union and served as Osama bin Laden's driver in Sudan.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110429090643/http://www.straitstimes.com/BreakingNews/World/Story/STIStory_660921.html>).

<a id="event-2011-04-25-0-10"></a>

Context: Guantanamo Files:.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. government "strongly condemns" international media outlets, specifically The New York Times, for publishing the files it had wanted to keep secret.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/International/Article.aspx?id=217764>).

<a id="event-2011-04-25-0-13"></a>

Context: Arab Spring / 2011 Libyan Civil War:.

**Archived source account.** NATO jets fly over Tripoli on their mission to destroy Muammar Gaddafi's forces as loud explosions knock 3 television stations (Libyan Television, Jamahiriya TV and Shababiya) off-the-air.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-13184594>).

<a id="event-2011-04-25-0-14"></a>

Context: Arab Spring / 2011 Libyan Civil War:.

<a id="event-2011-04-25-4-2"></a>

<a id="event-2011-04-25-4-3"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [UN News Centre](<http://www.un.org/apps/news/story.asp?NewsID=38187&amp;Cr=Sri+Lanka&amp;Cr1=>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-south-asia-13190576>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia/2011/04/2011425214422583975.html>); [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/world/un-tells-of-sri-lankan-carnage/story-e6frg6so-1226045228695>).

<a id="event-2011-04-26-0-14"></a>

### 2011-04-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1284008706](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20April%2027&oldid=1284008706>).

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2011-04-27-0-1"></a>

Context: Arab Spring:.

**Archived source account.** 2011 Yemeni protests: Yemeni security forces kill at least 12 people and wound more than 100 others with bullets in Sana'a and elsewhere as protests against the Ali Abdullah Saleh regime continue.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/middleeast/yemen/8478270/Yemen-at-least-12-dead-as-Saleh-clings-to-power.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-13214470>); [Reuters](<http://www.france24.com/en/20110427-deadly-shooting-sanaa-anti-government-demonstration-unrest-saleh-yemen>).

<a id="event-2011-04-27-0-2"></a>

Context: Arab Spring:.

**Archived source account.** 2011 Bahraini protests: Students rally across Iran to protest against the silent response of the United Nations to the crackdown on peaceful demonstrations by the Bahraini government (with the assistance of Saudi Arabia).

Source citations (as archived): [Press TV](<http://www.presstv.ir/detail/177022.html>).

<a id="event-2011-04-27-0-3"></a>

Context: Arab Spring:.

**Archived source account.** 2011 Syrian protests: France, Germany, Italy, Spain and the United Kingdom summon Syrian ambassadors to condemn the government's recent violent crackdown on people protesting against the Bashar al-Assad regime.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-13207309>).

<a id="event-2011-04-27-0-4"></a>

Context: Arab Spring:.

**Archived source account.** 2011 Libyan civil war: A team from the United Nations (UN) arrives in Tripoli to investigate the Libyan government's crackdown on people protesting.

<a id="event-2011-04-27-0-5"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-13204754>); [AP](<http://www.am1150.ca/News/World/Article.aspx?id=277865>); [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/news/international/armed-gang-explodes-egypt-gas-pipeline-to-israel-1.358345?localLinksEnabled=false>).

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Human Rights Council condemns Syria for using deadly force against peaceful protesters and calls for an investigation into the killing of civilians and other alleged crimes; China, Russia and Pakistan vote against measures as "meddling in Syria's internal affairs".

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/International/Article.aspx?id=218484>).

<a id="event-2011-04-29-0-6"></a>

Context: 2011 Yemeni protests:.

**Archived source account.** 100,000 people march through central Sanaa in one of the largest protests yet to have taken place against the Saleh regime, with protesters demanding that he resign immediately rather than wait for the phased handover of power he has orchestrated.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/04/2011429162428965468.html>).

<a id="event-2011-04-29-0-8"></a>

Context: Protests in Bahrain, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia:.

**Archived source account.** Thousands march across Bahrain, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia in defiance of yesterday's death sentences handed down to anti-government protesters by the ruling Bahraini regime, with people in Lahore (Pakistan) carrying symbolic coffins in solidarity.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/04/2011429194938853377.html>).

<a id="event-2011-04-29-0-10"></a>

Context: 2011 Libyan civil war in Tunisia:.

**Archived source account.** Muammar Gaddafi brings the 2011 Libyan civil war over the border into Tunisia, prompting complaints from the Tunisian foreign ministry.

<a id="event-2011-04-29-0-11"></a>

Context: 2011 Libyan civil war in Tunisia:.

**Archived source account.** NATO reports it has intercepted Muammar Gaddafi's forces in the act of laying mines in Misrata as Tunisia successfully captures some of the troops who have brought the Libyan civil war onto its territory.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-13242157>).

<a id="event-2011-04-29-0-13"></a>

Context: 2011 Moroccan protests:.

**Archived source account.** People gather to demonstrate against terrorism in Marrakesh.

Context: Death of Osama bin Laden:.

**Archived source account.** President of the United States Barack Obama announces in a special TV broadcast that Osama bin Laden, the founder and leader of the militant Islamist group Al-Qaeda and the most-wanted fugitive on the FBI's Ten Most Wanted Fugitives, was killed on May 2 (Pakistan Standard Time) during an American military operation in Abbottabad, near Islamabad, Pakistan and that his body is in U.S. custody. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

<a id="event-2011-05-01-0-23"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police use tear gas and batons on people protesting against their government in Maldives.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-south-asia-13252906>).

<a id="event-2011-05-01-0-24"></a>

**Archived source account.** A crowd of hundreds of people attack a Christian seminary, a church and houses of local Christians in Gujranwala, Pakistan, after finding out that two Christians who had been accused of blasphemy have been released from protective custody by the police.

Source citations (as archived): [The Express Tribune](<http://tribune.com.pk/story/160337/blasphemy-allegations-release-of-alleged-blasphemers-sparks-riots-in-gujranwala/>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2011-05-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At memorial services on Holocaust and Heroism Remembrance Day in Israel, thousands of Holocaust survivors and Israelis commemorate the Jews who died during the Holocaust.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2011/05/01/Israel-marks-Holocaust-Day/UPI-79111304249700/#ixzz1L6hRhsGS>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/JewishWorld/JewishNews/Article.aspx?id=218597>).

<a id="event-2011-05-01-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope John Paul II is beatified by Pope Benedict XVI in Saint Peter's Square, Rome.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/may/01/john-paul-ii-beatification-rome>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2011/05/20115151240781723.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-01-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Benedict XVI also removes William Martin Morris as the Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Toowoomba in Australia for allegedly advocating the ordination of women and married priests.

Source citations (as archived): [National Catholic Reporter](<http://ncronline.org/news/women/pope-removes-bishop-who-expressed-openness-ordaining-women>).

<a id="event-2011-05-01-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Australian television personality Karl Stefanovic wins the Gold Logie Award for Most Popular Personality on Australian Television at the Logie Awards of 2011.

Source citations (as archived): [The Sydney Morning Herald](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110505062118/http://www.smh.com.au/entertainment/tv-and-radio/top-logie-ends-nines-gold-drought-20110501-1e3hx.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2011-05-01-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** British head teachers vote 99.6 per cent in favour of staging a ballot on a strike over pension cuts in what would be a first national strike by the National Association of Head Teachers (NAHT).

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/education-13252220>).

<a id="event-2011-05-01-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hong Kong introduces a minimum wage after public pressure to resolve a wealth gap, though business leaders complain about the cost.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-13248027>).

<a id="event-2011-05-01-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of thousands of people attend May Day parades in Cuba.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-13256327>).

#### Disasters

<a id="event-2011-05-01-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The International Atomic Energy Agency is sending a team to Japan this month to inspect the crippled Fukushima nuclear plants and will present its preliminary evaluation of the crisis in June.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<http://search.japantimes.co.jp/cgi-bin/nn20110501a8.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-01-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Memory Unit of the Flight Data Recorder from Air France 447 is recovered from the bottom of the Atlantic Ocean, nearly two years after the jet crashed.

Source citations (as archived): [The Wall Street Journal](<http://online.wsj.com/article/SB10001424052748704569404576297332717532042.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-01-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Indian Air Force searches unsuccessfully for a helicopter containing Dorjee Khandu, the Chief Minister of Arunachal Pradesh state and four others.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/asiapcf/05/01/india.missing.helicopter/index.html?eref=edition>).

<a id="event-2011-05-01-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police investigate a blogger Teacher Wang for fraud after he predicts a magnitude-14 earthquake and 170m (560ft) high tsunami is to strike Taiwan on 11 May, toppling the Taipei 101 skyscraper and Presidential Office building. The prediction is removed from the internet.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-13253512>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2011-05-01-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israel withholds 300 million NIS ($89 million) in tax and customs revenue collected on behalf of the Palestinians to the Palestinian Authority after Fatah and Hamas agree a unity deal intended to lead to a transitional government and fresh elections. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu expresses his disregard for the agreement.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/05/20115182147504313.html>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/MiddleEast/Article.aspx?id=218623>).

<a id="event-2011-05-01-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israel opposes Egypt's plan to open the Rafah Border Crossing with Gaza to two-way traffic due to its fears of "terror operatives".

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2011-05/01/c_13854392.htm>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Defense/Article.aspx?id=218525>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2011-05-01-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** It is reported that the United States has denied the United Nations access to imprisoned serviceman Bradley Manning whom the U.S. accuses of disclosing government information to the general public.

Source citations (as archived): [GLW](<http://www.greenleft.org.au/node/47459>).

<a id="event-2011-05-01-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** German officials say they have foiled a terror plot with the arrest of three suspected al-Qaeda bomb-makers.

Source citations (as archived): [The Denver Post](<http://www.denverpost.com/nationworld/ci_17967448#ixzz1L6fhEFKO>); [The Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/Terror-strike-averted-Germany-arrests-3-suspected-Qaida-men/articleshow/8131430.cms>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2011-05-01-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iranian President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad is to end a boycott of official duties, amid an apparent rift with the Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

### 2011-05-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1349176949](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20May%202&oldid=1349176949>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-05-02-0-1"></a>

Context: Reactions to the killing of Osama bin Laden:.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people gather at Ground Zero of the September 11 attacks in New York to celebrate the news that Osama bin Laden has been killed.

Source citations (as archived): [SKY News](<http://news.sky.com/skynews/Home/World-News/Video-Osama-Bin-Laden-Dead-Crowds-At-White-House-Celebrate-Chanting-USA/Article/201105115983549>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/asiapcf/05/02/bin.laden.color/index.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-02-0-2"></a>

Context: Reactions to the killing of Osama bin Laden:.

**Archived source account.** Bin Laden's body, which was handled in accordance with Islamic practice and tradition, is buried by the U.S. forces at sea less than a day after his death, thus preventing a burial site from becoming a "terrorist shrine".

Source citations (as archived): [abcnews](<https://www.webcitation.org/6I4b3GLVO?url=http://abcnews.go.com/blogs/politics/2011/05/osama-bin-laden-body-headed-for-burial-at-sea-officials-say/>).

<a id="event-2011-05-02-0-3"></a>

Context: Reactions to the killing of Osama bin Laden:.

**Archived source account.** Most international leaders respond positively to the news.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/skynews/Home/World-News/Reaction-To-Bin-Ladens-Death-Condoleeza-Rice-Bill-Clinton-Hamid-Karzi-Nicolas-Sarkozy/Article/201105115983705>).

<a id="event-2011-05-02-0-4"></a>

Context: Reactions to the killing of Osama bin Laden:.

**Archived source account.** US political leaders across the political spectrum welcome the announcement that Osama bin Laden had been killed, congratulating American troops, the intelligence community and the White House for putting an end to the hunt for the mastermind of the September 11 attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/news/washington/2011-05-03-politicians-react-bin-laden-death_n.htm>).

<a id="event-2011-05-02-0-5"></a>

Context: Reactions to the killing of Osama bin Laden:.

**Archived source account.** British Prime Minister David Cameron says bin Laden's death will "bring great relief to people across the world" and that it is a time to remember all those murdered by Osama bin Laden, and all those who lost loved ones.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/skynews/Home/UK-News/Prime-Minister-David-Cameron-Says-Osama-Bin-Ladens-Death-Will-Bring-Great-Relief-Across-World/Article/201002115983561?lpos=UK_News_Carousel_Region_3&amp;lid=ARTICLE_15983561_Prime_Minister_David_Cameron_Says_Osama_Bin_Ladens_Death_Will_Bring_Great_Relief_Across_World>).

<a id="event-2011-05-02-0-6"></a>

Context: Reactions to the killing of Osama bin Laden:.

**Archived source account.** NATO head Anders Fogh Rasmussen says bin Laden's death is a “success” for security and that NATO should continue its mission in Afghanistan to ensure it "never again becomes a safe haven for extremism."

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/International/Article.aspx?id=218812>).

<a id="event-2011-05-02-0-7"></a>

Context: Reactions to the killing of Osama bin Laden:.

**Archived source account.** Leader of Hamas, Ismail Haniyeh, condemns the killing of bin Laden as "the killing of an Arab holy warrior," while Hamas' prospective power-sharing partner Fatah in the Palestinian Authority led by Mahmud Abbas issues a statement welcoming the al Qaida-leader's death.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/MiddleEast/Article.aspx?id=218821>).

<a id="event-2011-05-02-0-8"></a>

Context: Reactions to the killing of Osama bin Laden:.

**Archived source account.** Iraqi Foreign Minister Hoshyar Zebari says that Iraq is "delighted" by the news, noting that thousands of Iraqis had died "because of his ideologies".

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120318105014/http://www.africasia.com/services/news_mideast/article.php?ID=CNG.b74138877e2c6db836a76c96669b7602.781>).

<a id="event-2011-05-02-0-9"></a>

Context: Reactions to the killing of Osama bin Laden:.

**Archived source account.** Newspapers carry it on their front pages.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-13259492>).

<a id="event-2011-05-02-0-11"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of dissidents have been arrested across Syria, including in the town of Daraa and a Damascus suburb, after dozens were killed in weekend protests, activists say.

Source citations (as archived): [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/world/hundreds-arrested-in-syria-sweep/story-e6frg6so-1226048141796>).

<a id="event-2011-05-02-0-12"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** The UN Security Council fails to agree a statement to condemn the killing of Syrian protesters, as Russia and China block a statement proposed by Britain, France, Germany and Portugal that would have condemned the violence, which has led to hundreds of dead, and backed calls for an independent investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [Herald Sun](<http://www.heraldsun.com.au/news/world/russia-china-act-as-roadblocks-to-un-action-against-syria-as-internal-support-for-the-baath-party-crumbles/story-e6frf7lf-1226046248969>).

<a id="event-2011-05-02-0-13"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Al Jazeera demands that Syria provide information on Dorothy Parvaz, a journalist missing since her arrival in Damascus on Friday.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/05/20115211460620208.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-02-0-14"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** The Iranian foreign minister Ali Akbar Salehi, speaking at a news conference in Doha, demands that Syria's government investigates last Friday's disppearance of journalist Dorothy Parvaz.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/05/201152182235900733.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-02-0-15"></a>

**Archived source account.** 2011 Bahraini uprising: Bahrain arrests two senior members of the Opposition Al Wefaq party, Jawad Ferooz and Mattar Ibrahim Mattar.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/05/201152205239385476.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-02-0-17"></a>

Context: Libyan Civil War:.

**Archived source account.** Forces loyal to Muammar Gaddafi continue to attack the city of Misrata.

Source citations (as archived): [News 24](<http://www.news24.com/Africa/News/Gaddafi-tanks-pound-Libya-siege-city-20110502>).

<a id="event-2011-05-02-0-18"></a>

Context: Libyan Civil War:.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations withdraws all of its international staff from the capital Tripoli.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-13253896>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2011/05/201151225143642809.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-02-0-19"></a>

Context: Libyan Civil War:.

**Archived source account.** Almost $1 billion linked to besieged Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi and overthrown Egyptian and Tunisian leaders Hosni Mubarak and Zine El Abidine Ben Ali are found in Switzerland. Mubarak had previously denied having wealth in foreign bank accounts.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2011/05/201152211937541921.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-02-0-20"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Taliban sends a 12-year-old boy as a suicide bomber in a new wave of attacks that kills four civilians, in one of several attacks across Afghanistan that kills at least seven people.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-south-asia-13252786>); [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/world/taliban-use-child-12-in-suicide-mission-as-part-of-new-wave-of-attacks/story-e6frg6so-1226048171603>).

<a id="event-2011-05-02-0-21"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thousands of Sri Lankans protest against a United Nations report calling for both sides involved in the civil war to be investigated for possible war crimes.

Source citations (as archived): [Angola Press](<http://www.portalangop.co.ao/motix/en_us/noticias/internacional/2011/4/18/Thousands-protest-Sri-Lanka-against-report,578e0304-8b03-46bd-9f63-a45c12fac016.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2011-05-02-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Oil prices fall following news that U.S. forces have killed al-Qaeda leader Osama bin Laden.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://money.cnn.com/2011/05/02/markets/oil_prices/?section=money_latest>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Business/BusinessNews/Article.aspx?id=218820>).

**Archived source account.** Asian stocks and U.S. stock index futures rise on initial reports that Osama bin Laden was dead.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/05/02/markets-global-idUSL3E7G205O20110502>).

<a id="event-2011-05-02-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Australian dollar reaches $1.10 in United States dollars, its highest level since the Australian dollar was floated in 1983.

Source citations (as archived): [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/national-affairs/mine-boom-raises-fears-of-inflation/story-fn59niix-1226048231433>).

Source citations (as archived): [Business Insider](<http://www.businessinsider.com/sony-took-another-online-property-down-last-night-2011-5>).

### 2011-05-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1355529643](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20May%203&oldid=1355529643>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-05-03-0-1"></a>

Context: Reaction to the death of Osama bin Laden:.

**Archived source account.** White House Press Secretary Jay Carney reveals that Osama bin Laden was not armed but did put up resistance when U.S. forces entered his compound.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/asiapcf/05/03/bin.laden.dead/index.html?hpt=T1&amp;iref=BN1>).

<a id="event-2011-05-03-0-2"></a>

Context: Reaction to the death of Osama bin Laden:.

**Archived source account.** US officials deliberate releasing “gruesome” photographs of the corpse of Osama bin Laden, to dispel doubt by Islamic militants that U.S. forces really killed him.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/05/03/us-binladen-burial-photos-idUSTRE7426MX20110503?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews>).

<a id="event-2011-05-03-0-3"></a>

Context: Reaction to the death of Osama bin Laden:.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of people in Quetta, Pakistan, join a rally in honour of Osama bin Laden.

Source citations (as archived): [One Pakistan](<http://www.onepakistan.com/news/national/98990-hundreds-join-first-pakistan-rally-to-honour-bin-laden.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-03-0-4"></a>

Context: Reaction to the death of Osama bin Laden:.

**Archived source account.** Pakistani officials criticize the US raid that killed Osama bin Laden, saying that the United States had made “an unauthorized unilateral action” that would be not be tolerated in the future.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2011/05/04/world/asia/04pakistan.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-03-0-5"></a>

Context: Reaction to the death of Osama bin Laden:.

**Archived source account.** US officials caution that bin Laden’s death does not remove the threat of terrorist attacks and say that the battle against al-Qaida and other terrorist groups will continue.

Source citations (as archived): [VOA News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110504035058/http://www.voanews.com/english/news/usa/US-Officials-Warn-Terrorism-Threat-Remains-Post-bin-Laden-121143409.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-03-0-6"></a>

Context: Reaction to the death of Osama bin Laden:.

**Archived source account.** US officials describe remarks by leader of militant Islamic group Hamas, Ismail Haniyeh, condemning the killing of bin Laden as "outrageous", while UK Foreign Secretary William Hague criticizes Hamas for mourning bin Laden's death.

Source citations (as archived): [VOA News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110504042031/http://www.voanews.com/english/news/usa/US-Hamas-Leaders-Bin-Laden-Remarks-Outrageous--121187969.html>); [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5gRf82pxGmOyERHJDMA20GAp5becA?docId=CNG.ff8151f843080218558f596b5569b74a.531>); [JTA](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110505234302/http://www.jta.org/news/article/2011/05/03/3087511/state-slams-hamas-mourning-of-bin-laden>).

<a id="event-2011-05-03-0-7"></a>

Context: Reaction to the death of Osama bin Laden:.

**Archived source account.** UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Navi Pillay says the UN wants more details regarding the death of bin Laden and that all counter-terrorism operations must respect international law, even though bin Laden had committed crimes against humanity and "the most appalling acts of terrorism.”.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/05/03/us-binladen-un-rights-idUSTRE7425PR20110503>); [Huffington Post](<http://www.huffingtonpost.com/huff-wires/20110503/un-un-rights-bin-laden/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-05-04-0-1"></a>

Context: 2011 Syrian uprising.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/meast/05/04/syria.unrest/index.html>); [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/skynews/Home/World-News/Video-SYRIA-Tanks-Sent-To-Homs-As-Government-Continues-Arrests-Of-Opposition-Protesters/Article/201105115985647?lpos=World_News_Top_Stories_Header_3&amp;lid=ARTICLE_15985647_Video_SYRIA%3A_Tanks_Sent_To_Homs_As_Government_Continues_Arrests_Of_Opposition_Protesters>).

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/MiddleEast/Article.aspx?id=219223>); [Channel 6 News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110513020804/http://channel6newsonline.com/2011/05/uns-ban-urges-syrian-president-to-end-violence/>).

#### International Relations

<a id="event-2011-05-04-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Public executions, death by starvation and torture are common in North Korean political prisoner camps, according to testimony given to human rights group Amnesty International, which they say could contain as many as 200,000 prisoners.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/asiapcf/05/04/north.korea.amnesty/index.html>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2011/05/05/world/asia/05korea.html>); [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5jD0jufxBVYczJAwQN0q0CXq90Y0A?docId=CNG.e09e6e09c43cfc58a567b94c3b6f9c67.5e1>).

<a id="event-2011-05-04-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sarah Shourd, an American hiker released last year from an Iranian prison on $500,000 bail because of a medical condition said she will not return to Tehran to face espionage charges in a court hearing scheduled for next week; her fiancé, Shane Bauer, and their friend, Josh Fattal, are still being held in Evin Prison in Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/meast/05/04/iran.hikers.trial/index.html>).

### 2011-05-05

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-05-05-0-1"></a>

Context: 2011 Libyan civil war.

**Archived source account.** Members of the multi-state coalition conducting the military campaign in Libya hold talks in Rome, Italy, and agree to set up a new fund to aid Libyan rebels, with US Secretary of State Hillary Clinton promising to use frozen assets of Muammar Gaddafi's regime.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/rome-meeting-on-libya-to-discuss-how-to-improve-rebels-finances/2011/05/04/AF5njTsF_story.html?wpisrc=al_national>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2011/05/20115504324476248.html>); [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/breaking-news/us-to-tap-gaddafi-billions-to-aid-rebels/story-fn3dxity-1226050770901>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/International/Article.aspx?id=219331>).

<a id="event-2011-05-05-0-2"></a>

Context: 2011 Libyan civil war.

**Archived source account.** Mortar rounds fired from Libya land near the Tunisian border town of Dehiba.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters Alertnet](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120406120059/http://www.trust.org/alertnet/news/libyan-mortar-rounds-land-near-tunisia-border-town>).

<a id="event-2011-05-05-0-4"></a>

Context: 2011 Syrian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Dozens of tanks have been sent to the Syrian city of Homs as the Government continues to crack down on protesters.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/skynews/Article/201009115985647>).

<a id="event-2011-05-05-0-5"></a>

Context: 2011 Syrian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Syrian troops arrest 300 people in a raid on the Damascus suburb of Saqba and tanks and troops are also reported to have been sent to other to quell anti-government demonstrations in Homs and Hama.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-13291358>); [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/middleeast/syria/8494491/Syrian-troops-arrest-300-in-Damascus-suburb.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-05-0-6"></a>

Context: 2011 Syrian protests:.

**Archived source account.** About 100 tanks and troop transports converge on the town of Al-Rastan, after anti-regime protesters toppled a statue of the late Syrian president Hafez al-Assad and pledged to press ahead with their "revolution" despite sweeping arrests by Bashar al-Assad's regime.

Source citations (as archived): [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/world/tensions-rise-in-syria-as-ruling-forces-mass-tanks-in-protest-hotbed/story-e6frg6so-1226050230959>).

<a id="event-2011-05-05-0-7"></a>

Context: 2011 Syrian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Syrian military forces begin withdrawing from the town of Daraa after a mission to "restore security and calm," according to Syrian state TV, after more than 500 people were killed during the clashes and thousands more detained.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/meast/05/05/syria.unrest/index.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-05-0-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** A car bomb explodes in the southern Iraqi city of Hilla, killing at least 21 police officers and injuring 65; in northern Iraq and in Baghdad, four people are killed in other attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://news.yahoo.com/s/nm/20110505/wl_nm/us_iraq_violence_1;_ylt=AsZ2nLyZMjl_AsF4JrC5bVsUewgF;_ylu=X3oDMTE2dW90OTZhBHBvcwMxBHNlYwN5bi1yLWItbGVmdARzbGsDZXYtY2FyYm9tYmV4>); [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2011/05/06/world/middleeast/06hilla.html?_r=1>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/meast/05/05/iraq.violence/index.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-05-0-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** Vietnamese soldiers clash with thousands of Hmong Christians in Dien Bien Province demanding religious freedom and autonomy in the northwest of the country, in the worst ethnic unrest in Vietnam in years. The US-based Center for Public Policy Analysis claims that at least 28 protesters were killed and hundreds more were missing, while 3,000 protesters remained at the site, according to officials. \{\{Dead link\|date=July 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-13284122>); [Straits Times](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110716045537/http://www.straitstimes.com/BreakingNews/SEAsia/Story/STIStory_665607.html>); [Bangkok Post](<http://www.bangkokpost.com/news/asia/235516/vietnam-troops-use-force-at-rare-hmong-protest>).

<a id="event-2011-05-05-0-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** A US drone attack kills two suspected al-Qaeda members in Shabwa province, Yemen.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/al-qaeda/8494943/US-drone-attack-kills-al-Qaeda-members-in-Yemen.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-05-7-0"></a>

<a id="event-2011-05-12-6-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Parliamentary Standards Commissioner has recommended that Liberal Democrat MP and former Chief Secretary to the Treasury David Laws be suspended from the House of Commons for 7 days over wrongly claimed expenses.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-13371746>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2011-05-12-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Anti-retroviral drugs reduce the risk of people spreading HIV to uninfected partners by 96%, according to a new study.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/health-13381292>); [Mail &amp; Guardian](<http://mg.co.za/article/2011-05-12-early-treatment-breakthrough-in-hiv-research>).

### 2011-05-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1342377854](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20May%2013&oldid=1342377854>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-05-13-0-1"></a>

Context: 2011 Bahraini uprising:.

**Archived source account.** The Bahraini government tortures doctors into confessions of "trying to overthrow the monarchy" by aiding wounded civilians who protested during the uprising.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/05/2011512111835943173.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-13-0-3"></a>

Context: 2011 Yemeni uprising:.

**Archived source account.** 3 people are killed and 18 others are wounded as troops shoot at medics, witnesses and people protesting against the Saleh regime in Ibb, Ta'izz and Sana'a, though Saleh remains defiant. Qatar withdraws from mediation efforts, saying Saleh has been full of "indecision and delays".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-13394722>).

<a id="event-2011-05-13-0-5"></a>

Context: 2011 Syrian uprising:.

**Archived source account.** Soldiers are reportedly ordered not to fire on protesters.

Source citations (as archived): [Buenos Aires Herald](<http://www.buenosairesherald.com/article/66907/syrias-assad-reported-to-have-ordered-no-shooting>).

<a id="event-2011-05-13-0-6"></a>

Context: 2011 Syrian uprising:.

**Archived source account.** Authorities close off entire areas in cities across Syria, setting up roadblocks and checkpoints in an attempt to prevent protests after Friday prayers.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5gR_t8lQfdxC9_XuOgNIg5aB8qOxA?docId=b2135663d47c409a8de30ca188294224>).

<a id="event-2011-05-13-0-7"></a>

Context: 2011 Syrian uprising:.

**Archived source account.** At least 3 people are killed in the centre of the city of Homs, with one being seen to be shot in the head after forces loyal to the regime fire into crowds of people. Gunfire erupts in the city of Daraa.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-13391828>).

<a id="event-2011-05-13-0-9"></a>

Context: 2011 Libyan civil war:.

**Archived source account.** A video shows 11 dead imams and 45 wounded Muslim holy men, 5 of whom are in a coma, alleged to have been caused by a NATO airstrike. Those attacked were said to have been at rest and sleeping while participating in a long peace march; Muslims and Christians unite in condemnation of the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/may/13/libya-accuses-nato-bombing-imams>).

<a id="event-2011-05-13-0-10"></a>

Context: 2011 Libyan civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Upon speculation that Gaddafi was injured in a NATO air-strike, Libyan State TV released an audio tape of what it claims to be Gaddafi giving a message saying that he was not hurt and is alive.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2011/05/2011513154514897122.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-13-0-12"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian revolution:.

**Archived source account.** Authorities extend for 15 more days the detention of Hosni Mubarak, whose regime was overthrown by a recent popular revolution.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-13385399>).

<a id="event-2011-05-13-0-13"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian revolution:.

**Archived source account.** Suzanne Mubarak, the wife, is detained for 15 days on allegations of corruption and has a heart attack.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-13392099>).

<a id="event-2011-05-13-0-14"></a>

Context: 2011 Egyptian revolution:.

**Archived source account.** Tens of thousands of people gather in Tahrir Square to display unity against sectarian tension and solidarity with the plight of the Palestinian people and the other popular uprisings against regimes in the region. Cheers erupt as Suzanne Mubarak is incarcerated.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/may/13/tahrir-square-egypt-mubarak-wife>).

<a id="event-2011-05-13-0-15"></a>

**Archived source account.** Dozens of people are injured in a petrol bomb attack on a bank in Gansu, northwest China.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-13385613>); [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/china/2011-05/13/c_13873121.htm>); [Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/china/Blast-at-a-rural-bank-in-China-injures-39/articleshow/8294735.cms>).

<a id="event-2011-05-13-0-16"></a>

**Archived source account.** Catholic priest Father Mussie Zerai alleges that as many as 400 people, mainly Eritreans, are being held for ransom by human traffickers in the Sinai Desert, and that at least one has been killed after experiencing electric shock torture.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-13388039>); [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2011/05/13/Priest-Eritrean-migrants-being-tortured/UPI-94941305293696/>).

<a id="event-2011-05-13-0-17"></a>

**Archived source account.** 2011 Charsadda bombing. 80 people were killed when two suicide bombs exploded in the Frontier Constabulary training center in Charsadda District of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province of Pakistan.

No attached source citation. This assertion is unverified; see its disclosure and research status above.

#### Disasters

<a id="event-2011-05-13-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Japan's government approves a compensation plan to assist with the tens of billions of dollars for those affected by the malfunctions of the country's tsunami-crippled nuclear plant, fearing that Tokyo Electric Power Company (Tepco) could go bankrupt without the money.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-13385512>).

<a id="event-2011-05-13-1-1"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/toronto/story/2011/05/13/ttc-buses-crash312.html>); [Toronto Star](<https://www.thestar.com/news/transportation/article/990962--14-injured-after-ttc-buses-collide?bn=1>); [Inside Toronto](<http://www.insidetoronto.com/news/local/article/1007910--two-ttc-buses-collide-at-station-13-people-sent-to-hospital>).

<a id="event-2011-05-13-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Vietnam unveils a five year plan to tackle widespread prostitution in the country.

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2011-05-13-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Republika Srpska President Milorad Dodik, speaking after meeting Catherine Ashton in Banja Luka, says a referendum "for the time being is not necessary". The referendum would have been a challenge to both Ashton and the courts of Bosnia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-13389051>).

<a id="event-2011-05-13-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Plaid Cymru leader Ieuan Wyn Jones vows to stand down from the role in the first half of the Welsh assembly's five-year term following the party's poor results at the recent election.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-wales-13389407>).

<a id="event-2011-05-13-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** FIFA President Sepp Blatter fears being plunged into "a black hole" if AFC President Mohammed bin Hammam defeats him in next month's leadership election.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/9483666.stm>).

#### Religion

<a id="event-2011-05-13-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Benedict XVI tells Roman Catholic bishops around the world they must obey Summorum Pontificum, a papal order allowing priests to say the old-style Tridentine Mass, regardless of their opinion on it.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/vatican-issues-instructions-for-old-mass-warns-against-questioning-papal-authority/2011/05/13/AFBQSI2G_story.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/05/13/us-pope-latin-idUSTRE74C29120110513>).

<a id="event-2011-05-13-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Following a decision made at its Bishops' Spring Conference, the Catholic Church in England and Wales announces the reinstatement of the rule of abstaining from eating red meat on Fridays. The practice, last observed in 1984, will be reintroduced on 16 September to coincide with the first anniversary of the visit of Pope Benedict XVI.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/religion/8512721/Catholics-told-to-abstain-from-eating-meat-on-Fridays..html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-05-14-0-1"></a>

Context: 2011 Libyan civil war:.

<a id="event-2011-05-14-0-2"></a>
