**Archived source account.** Muammar Gaddafi is among three Libyans facing arrest warrants from the International Criminal Court for alleged crimes against humanity including the killing of unarmed protesters, forced displacement, illegal detentions and airstrikes on civilians.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/africa/05/14/libya.war/index.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-14-0-3"></a>

Context: 2011 Libyan civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Opponents of the Gaddafi regime seek recognition in Europe after the United States stopped short of granting the National Transitional Council full diplomatic recognition, but the White House said it was a "legitimate and credible interlocutor".

Context: 2011 Syrian protests:.

**Archived source account.** Singapore's founding father Lee Kuan Yew resigns from the cabinet after 52 years.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-13400296>); [AP](<http://www.salon.com/wires/allwires/2011/05/14/D9N76V280_as_singapore_politics/index.html>); [China Daily](<http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/world/2011-05/14/content_12511975.htm>).

<a id="event-2011-05-14-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Governor of Arkansas Mike Huckabee announces he will not seek the Republican nomination for the 2012 United States presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/blogs/the-fix/post/mike-huckabee-wont-run-for-president-in-2012/2011/05/14/AFGcpk3G_blog.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2011-05-14-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Badr Hari defeats Gregory Tony via first round technical knockout in his return to kickboxing after a year away from the sport, at It's Showtime 2011 Lyon in Lyon, France.

Source citations (as archived): [Liver Kick](<http://liverkick.com/>).

<a id="event-2011-05-14-7-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Confederation of African Football (CAF) disqualifies reigning African champions and FIFA Club World Cup finalists TP Mazembe of the Democratic Republic of the Congo from the CAF Champions League.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC Sport](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/13400369.stm>).

<a id="event-2011-05-14-7-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thai head of football Worawi Makudi takes legal action against former Football Association chairman David Triesman, Baron Triesman after being implicated in alleged bribery over the FIFA World Cup.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC Sport](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/13398875.stm>).

<a id="event-2011-05-14-7-4"></a>

Context: Manchester:.

**Archived source account.** Manchester City F.C. defeats Stoke City F.C. 1-0 in the 2011 FA Cup Final.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/football/teams/manchester-city/8514258/Manchester-City-have-deserved-FA-Cup-success-which-is-tangible-reward-for-clubs-expensive-vision.html>); [BBC Sport](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/13346941.stm>).

<a id="event-2011-05-14-7-5"></a>

Context: Manchester:.

**Archived source account.** Manchester United F.C. wins the 2010–11 Premier League becoming the most successful team in English league history.,

Source citations (as archived): [BBC Sport](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/eng_prem/9483868.stm>); [Sky Sports](<http://www.skysports.com/story/0,19528,11667_6933324,00.html>).

### 2011-05-15

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1261801437](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20May%2015&oldid=1261801437>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-05-15-0-2"></a>

Context: Arab Spring / 2011 Bahraini uprising:.

**Archived source account.** Saudi armored vehicles roll into the city of Sitra as fresh video footage of atrocities committed by Saudi-backed Bahraini forces surface.

Source citations (as archived): [Press TV](<http://www.presstv.ir/detail/179936.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-0-4"></a>

Context: Arab Spring / 2011 Egyptian revolution:.

**Archived source account.** Muslim mobs attack Christian protesters calling for the Egyptian government to take action to reduce religious tensions in Cairo; 65 people are injured.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.msnbc.msn.com/id/43035836>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-13403504>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-0-5"></a>

Context: Arab Spring / 2011 Egyptian revolution:.

**Archived source account.** Suzanne Mubarak, wife of ousted Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak, is expected to undergo open-heart surgery following a heart attack after being questioned in a corruption investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/africa/05/15/egypt.suzanne.mubarak/index.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-0-6"></a>

Context: Arab Spring / 2011 Egyptian revolution:.

**Archived source account.** An explosion occurs near the tomb of a prominent Muslim Sheikh.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/topNews/idAFJOE74E02G20110515>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-0-8"></a>

Context: Arab Spring / 2011 Libyan civil war:.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations envoy to Libya, Abdul Ilah Khatib, arrives in Tripoli to try to negotiate a cease-fire between Muammar Gaddafi's forces and rebel fighters.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/africa/05/15/libya.war/index.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-0-10"></a>

Context: Arab Spring / 2011 Moroccan protests:.

**Archived source account.** Police use truncheons to break up an opposition protest in the capital Rabat, injuring several people.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/topNews/idAFJOE74E07N20110515>); [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5ijmvh8NR11R4W378hqyiVDrfB_Jg?docId=CNG.dd035276a74a1dfc4910aded0e7a6b3b.5a1>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-0-12"></a>

Context: Arab Spring / Syrian uprising:.

**Archived source account.** Syrian forces shell villages near the Lebanese border, and heavy gunfire is heard in Talkalakh, with reports of 8 people having died, in the latest phase of a crackdown by Syrian forces on protesters demonstrating against the rule of President Bashar al-Assad. Lebanon tries to seal the border after hundreds flee from Syrian troops and a wounded Syrian woman dies of her injuries after entering Lebanon.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/MiddleEast/Article.aspx?id=220652>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/meast/05/15/lebanon.syria.conflict/index.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-0-13"></a>

Context: Arab Spring / Syrian uprising:.

**Archived source account.** Women protesters are targeted as thousands of protesters take to the streets in cities across the country for a "Friday of Free Women" protest, in solidarity with those killed or imprisoned in the eight-week uprising.

Source citations (as archived): [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/world/syria-in-crackdown-on-women/story-e6frg6so-1226056347761>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-0-15"></a>

Context: Arab Spring / 2011 Yemeni protests:.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen open fire on two soldiers in southern Yemen, killing one.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5jqL_NAaPdAJxIo9YjpNdbJitGPaQ?docId=56c0b8a1038e4f609b0d6c44c63f5071>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-0-16"></a>

Context: Arab Spring / 2011 Yemeni protests:.

**Archived source account.** The opposition movement says a deal to end the crisis must not extend President Ali Abdullah Saleh's rule.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/worldNews/idAFTRE74E2MA20110515?sp=true>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-0-18"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** A truck plows through traffic and pedestrians in the Israeli city of Tel Aviv, killing one person and injuring 16 in what is believed to be a terrorist attack, as Palestinians mark Nakba Day.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/NationalNews/Article.aspx?id=220575>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/meast/05/15/israel.truck.attack/index.html>); [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/news/diplomacy-defense/1-killed-16-hurt-as-truck-plows-into-cars-pedestrians-in-suspected-tel-aviv-terror-attack-1.361806>); [San Francisco Chronicle](<http://www.sfgate.com/cgi-bin/article.cgi?f=/g/a/2011/05/15/bloomberg1376-LL87506S972H01-792SF38CHMIRAD6NDU45J09DRA.DTL>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-0-19"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** 10 people are reported shot dead around the Israel-Lebanon border (near Maroun al-Ras in Lebanon), as a crowd try to enter Israel through a border fence. Protesters also pelt Lebanese security forces and Israeli soldiers with stones. Over a hundred enter the Israeli-controlled Golan Heights, with 4 shot dead, after Palestinians and Syrians crossed the de facto Israel-Syria border. Over 45 are injured in total.

Source citations (as archived): [Christian Science Monitor](<http://www.csmonitor.com/World/Middle-East/2011/0515/Nakba-clashes-Iran-Syria-trying-to-turn-Arab-Spring-fury-into-attacks-on-Israel>); [Voice of America](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110515220309/http://www.voanews.com/english/news/Dozens-Shot-Injured-Near-Israel-Gaza-Border--121853324.html>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/NationalNews/Article.aspx?id=220604>); [Nowlebanon](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110517024639/http://www.nowlebanon.com/NewsArticleDetails.aspx?ID=271481>); [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/news/diplomacy-defense/eight-said-killed-as-idf-fires-on-infiltrators-from-syria-and-lebanon-1.361841>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-0-20"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** More than 1,000 Palestinians march on the Erez border crossing between the Gaza Strip and Israel; at least 60 Palestinians are injured after troops open fire to stop them from crossing.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/2011-05-15/israeli-stocks-retreat-most-in-2-months-as-israel-arabs-clash.html>); [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/world/deadly-nakba-clashes-hit-israel-at-three-frontiers/story-e6frg6so-1226056427879>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-0-21"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** Israeli Prime Minister Binyamin Netanyahu responds to the events of Nakba Day, saying that the protesters were denying Israel's right to exist, and that Israel is determined to defend its border against infiltration attempts from Syria, Lebanon and the Gaza Strip.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/DiplomacyAndPolitics/Article.aspx?id=220656>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/meast/05/15/israel.border.violence/index.html?hpt=T1>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-0-22"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** Egyptian police fire teargas at protesters trying to storm the Israeli embassy.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2011/05/2011515131427646668.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-0-23"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** At least 15 people are reportedly killed in the Nakba demonstrations.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/stories/2011/05/15/501364/main20063028.shtml>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-0-24"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ugandan opposition leader Kizza Besigye says the government may fall amid ongoing protests, unless President Yoweri Museveni offers concessions.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/topNews/idAFJOE74E01M20110515?sp=true>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-0-25"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tunisian security forces arrest two suspected members of Al Qaeda in the Islamic Maghreb carrying bombs and explosives near the city of Ramada.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/05/15/libya-tunisia-arrest-idUSLDE74E08120110515?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=hotStocksNews>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-0-26"></a>

**Archived source account.** 29 people are decapitated in a massacre in Caserio La Bomba, Petén, Guatemala, in an atrocity possibly linked to the Los Zetas Cartel.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110608050448/http://www.npr.org/2011/05/16/136340063/massacre-in-northern-guatemala-leaves-27-dead>); [Radio-Canada](<http://www.radio-canada.ca/nouvelles/International/2011/05/16/003-drogue-guatemala-tuerie.shtml>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2011-05-15-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Singer Bob Dylan denies censoring his shows while performing in China.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/arts-entertainment/music/news/bob-dylan-denies-censoring-his-shows-in-china-2284562.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2011-05-15-2-1"></a>

Context: Dominique Strauss-Kahn sex, rape and imprisonment charges:.

**Archived source account.** New York City police question International Monetary Fund head Dominique Strauss-Kahn, arrested yesterday, over allegations that he sexually attacked a hotel maid near Times Square. Strauss-Kahn's schedule is threatened with interruption, with a meeting over the bailouts of Portugal and Greece with European Union finance ministers due in Brussels tomorrow.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-13402845>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-2-2"></a>

Context: Dominique Strauss-Kahn sex, rape and imprisonment charges:.

**Archived source account.** Police announce that Strauss-Kahn is expected to be formally arrested and charged.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/americas/2011/05/2011515045169500.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-2-3"></a>

Context: Dominique Strauss-Kahn sex, rape and imprisonment charges:.

**Archived source account.** Strauss-Kahn is charged with a criminal sexual act, attempted rape and unlawful imprisonment.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/skynews/Home/World-News/IMF-Head-Dominique-Strauss-Kahn-Charged-By-New-York-Police-Over-Alleged-Sexual-Assault/Article/201105315992243?lpos=World_News_Carousel_Region_0&amp;lid=ARTICLE_15992243_IMF_Head_Dominique_Strauss-Kahn_Charged_By_New_York_Police_Over_Alleged_Sexual_Assault>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-2-4"></a>

Context: Dominique Strauss-Kahn sex, rape and imprisonment charges:.

**Archived source account.** The leadership of the IMF, and plans for banking bailouts of European countries, are thrown into disarray.

Source citations (as archived): [The Wall Street Journal](<http://online.wsj.com/article/SB10001424052748703421204576324400801330790.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-2-5"></a>

Context: Dominique Strauss-Kahn sex, rape and imprisonment charges:.

**Archived source account.** Former United States Treasury official John Lipsky is named as the acting Managing Director.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2011/05/16/nyregion/imf-names-replacement-as-chief-awaits-arraignment.html?_r=1>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-2-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sony starts restoring its PlayStation Network following the recent PlayStation Network outage on a country-by-country basis, with all services to be restored by the end of May.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110505081725/http://today.msnbc.msn.com/id/33978506>); [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/australian-it/japan-stalls-sony-playstation-restart/story-e6frgakx-1226056625499>).

#### Disasters

<a id="event-2011-05-15-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three de-miners are killed in an explosion during landmine detection and removal operations in Kampong Speu Province, western Cambodia.

Source citations (as archived): [Straits Times](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110516065050/http://www.straitstimes.com/BreakingNews/SEAsia/Story/STIStory_668917.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-3-2"></a>

Context: Floods in North America:.

**Archived source account.** The Morganza Spillway on the Mississippi River has been opened for the first time in 37 years, deliberately flooding 3,000 square miles of rural Louisiana to save most of Baton Rouge and New Orleans.

Source citations (as archived): [WWL-TV](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110517005747/http://www.wwltv.com/news/Spillway-to-be--121832944.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-3-3"></a>

Context: Floods in North America:.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of residents are ordered to evacuate their homes in Louisiana as the Mississippi River spillway opens

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/US/05/15/flooding/index.html?hpt=T2>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-3-4"></a>

Context: Floods in North America:.

**Archived source account.** Amidst ongoing floods, a controlled breach of the Assiniboine River is carried out southeast of Portage la Prairie, Manitoba, releasing floodwaters over farmland to prevent increased flooding elsewhere.

Source citations (as archived): [CTV](<http://ottawa.ctv.ca/servlet/an/local/CTVNews/20110514/manitoba-deliberate-flood-110514/20110514/?hub=OttawaHome>); [Canoe.ca](<http://cnews.canoe.ca/CNEWS/Canada/2011/05/14/18148596.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-3-5"></a>

Context: Floods in North America:.

**Archived source account.** Severe flooding has continued for weeks along the James River from Canada to South Dakota, as well as in Burlington, Vermont and North Platte, Nebraska.

Source citations (as archived): [National Weather Service](<http://water.weather.gov/ahps/index.php>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-3-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six people are killed in an apartment fire in the city of Aurora in the US state of Illinois.

Source citations (as archived): [Breaking News](<http://www.chicagobreakingnews.com/news/local/chibrknews-6-killed-in-apartment-fire-in-west-suburb-20110515,0,3446407.story>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-3-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** More than a thousand people are evacuated from the Canadian town of Slave Lake, Alberta, due to a wildfire.

Source citations (as archived): [CTV Edmonton](<http://edmonton.ctv.ca/servlet/an/local/CTVNews/20110515/edm_slavelake_110515/20110515/?hub=EdmontonHome>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2011-05-15-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A United Nations report alleges that Iran and North Korea have been secretly exchanging ballistic missile technology.

Source citations (as archived): [Al-Masry Al-Youm](<http://www.almasryalyoum.com/en/node/437472>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The New York Times reports that private military company Xe Services LLC (previously Blackwater Worldwide) is putting together an army of mercenaries in the United Arab Emirates.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2011/05/15/world/middleeast/15prince.html?pagewanted=1&amp;_r=1&amp;hp>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nabil el-Araby is elected as Secretary General of the Arab League, succeeding Amr Moussa, who will run as a candidate in the Egyptian presidential election in September.

Source citations (as archived): [Press TV](<https://web.archive.org/web/20200108011201/https://www.press.tv/>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Fiji declares Lieutenant Colonel Ratu Tevita Uluilakeba Mara a fugitive after he flees the country with the help of the Royal Tongan Navy. He had been charged a week earlier with mutiny and attempting to overthrow the Fijian government.

Source citations (as archived): [The New Zealand Herald](<http://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/news/article.cfm?c_id=2&amp;objectid=10725909>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2011-05-15-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Northern Ireland Police have charged Marian Price with encouraging support for an illegal organisation following a recent dissident republican rally in Derry. Price, who is secretary of the 32 County Sovereignty Movement, was jailed for her part in the bombing of the Old Bailey in the 1970s.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-northern-ireland-13403772>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A man who plunged to his death from a seventh-floor balcony in Brisbane, Australia was participating in the internet craze of "planking", Australian police have said.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-13389207>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** It is reported that Jennifer Mills-Westley, a British woman recently decapitated in a random attack in Tenerife, complained of harassment moments before being attacked in a supermarket.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-13403303>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/may/14/woman-beheaded-tenerife-sought-aid-attack>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/europe/05/15/spain.supermarket.beheading/index.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** US rapper M-Bone, of the hip hop group Cali Swag District, is killed in a drive-by shooting in the Los Angeles suburb of Inglewood.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://latimesblogs.latimes.com/lanow/2011/05/cali-swag-district-rapper-m-bone-shot-to-death-in-inglewood.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2011-05-15-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Iranian Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, publicly accuses President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad of being "under a spell", amid a deepening political crisis in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/middleeast/iran/8514929/Mahmoud-Ahmadinejad-under-a-spell-Ayatollah-Ali-Khamenei-says.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-6-2"></a>

Context: Haitian general election, 2010–2011:.

**Archived source account.** Michel Martelly is sworn in as the democratically-elected President of Haiti.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/americas/05/14/haiti.inauguration/index.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-6-3"></a>

Context: Haitian general election, 2010–2011:.

**Archived source account.** Jean-Max Bellerive resigns as the Prime Minister of Haiti, allowing Martelly to choose his own Prime Minister.

Source citations (as archived): [Miami Herald](<http://www.miamiherald.com/2011/05/15/2218209/haiti-prime-minister-jean-max.html#storylink=twt>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-6-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Switzerland, the people of Zurich vote to reject a ban on assisted suicide in the country, and also reject the restricting of assisted suicide to Zurich residents only. British pro-euthanasia group Dignity in Dying hails the result as a "brave decision".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-13405719>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-6-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Italy tests the popularity of its controversial prime minister Silvio Berlusconi, who is embroiled in several criminal trials and sex scandals; Berlusconi alleges the opposition does not "wash much".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-13403249>).

<a id="event-2011-05-15-6-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** British Prime Minister David Cameron confirms that his government will write into law the principles of the Military Covenant.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-13402762>).

### 2011-05-16

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2011-05-16-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Gunmen fire on a Saudi Arabian consulate car in Karachi, Pakistan, killing the driver.,

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.msnbc.msn.com/id/43043138>); [Pakistan Express-Tribune](<http://tribune.com.pk/story/169692/driver-of-saudi-consulate-car-shot-dead/>).

<a id="event-2011-05-16-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Israeli Navy fires warning shots at a Malaysian ship travelling to the Gaza Strip, forcing it to return to Egypt.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5jMxz7Pz0Q-2aQVPr4GxyI4koZlIg?docId=CNG.9e1e52d9d3d6972fd546da3bb159cbc6.ad1>).

Context: Queen Elizabeth II's visit to the Republic of Ireland:.

**Archived source account.** Queen Elizabeth II starts her first state visit to the Republic of Ireland, the first visit of a British monarch since Ireland's independence from the United Kingdom in 1921. Elizabeth is also the first British monarch to visit Ireland since George V's state visit in 1911.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-northern-ireland-13420053>); [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2011/0517/queen_tracker.html>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/uk/blog/2011/may/17/queen-visit-ireland-live>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-05-18-0-2"></a>

<a id="event-2011-05-18-0-3"></a>

### 2011-05-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1159832383](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20May%2021&oldid=1159832383>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-05-21-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Dawn, Pakistan's largest English-language newspaper, begins publication of thousands of U.S. diplomatic cables it has obtained in a deal with WikiLeaks and Julian Assange. The cables show that the Pakistani military asked the United States to increase its drone attacks against insurgents on Pakistani territory, a request Pakistani authorities have not admitted in public.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia/2011/05/201152175836483568.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-21-0-3"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011–2012 Syrian uprising:.

**Archived source account.** Several people are killed and dozens of others are injured in Homs as Syrian security forces attack the funeral of protesters killed in yesterday's protest events during the country's uprising against the regime.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/05/20115211441542189.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-21-0-4"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011–2012 Syrian uprising:.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian regime attacks women protesters, shooting them dead during all-women marches and arresting the female relatives of male protesters.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/may/21/syria-women-unrest-repression>).

<a id="event-2011-05-21-0-6"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Libyan civil war:.

**Archived source account.** The cities of Yafran and al-Qalaa in the Nafusa Mountains are in critical condition following ongoing attacks by Muammar Gaddafi's forces, with heavy artillery shelling continuing, water supplies shut off, and no food or medical supplies coming into the towns for weeks.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/africa/05/21/libya.small.towns/index.html?eref=edition_africa>).

<a id="event-2011-05-21-0-7"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Libyan civil war:.

**Archived source account.** A bus carrying foreign journalists is attacked by a pro-Muammar Gaddafi crowd; soldiers fire into the air to disperse the crowd.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://ca.reuters.com/article/topNews/idCATRE74K1HX20110521?sp=true>).

<a id="event-2011-05-21-0-8"></a>

Context: Arab Spring:.

**Archived source account.** 2011 Yemeni uprising: The opposition sign a deal that will allow President Ali Abdullah Saleh out of power within a month.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://ca.reuters.com/article/topNews/idCATRE73L1PP20110521>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/05/2011521165814481734.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-21-0-10"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Egyptian revolution:.

**Archived source account.** Scuffles in court (as families reportedly yell "Butcher\! Butcher\!") lead to the postponement of the trial of Hosni Mubarak's former interior minister Habib el-Adly and six others after "three or four minutes". Habib el-Adly is accused of massacring people who demonstrated against the Mubarak regime, prior to its downfall as a result of a popular revolution in February 2011.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/05/20115211816200964.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-21-0-11"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Egyptian revolution:.

**Archived source account.** Egyptian border guards shoot and injure an Eritrean woman as she attempts to cross into Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [Journal of Turkish Weekly](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120919162222/http://www.turkishweekly.net/news/115335/egypt-border-guards-shoot-migrant-at-israel-border.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-21-0-13"></a>

Context: Other anti-government protests:.

**Archived source account.** 2011–2012 Spanish protests: Thousands of people defy a government ban on gatherings to protest across the country against the Spanish government's economic policies.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-13481592>).

<a id="event-2011-05-21-0-15"></a>

Context: Other anti-government protests: / 2011 Georgian protests:.

**Archived source account.** More than 10,000 Georgians protest against the regime of Mikheil Saakashvili. Protests are led by Nino Burjanadze, ex-parliamentary speaker and leader of the Democratic Movement-United Georgia party.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/worldNews/idAFTRE74K1Z620110521?pageNumber=1&amp;virtualBrandChannel=0>); [Civil.ge](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110607120730/http://www.civil.ge/eng/article.php?id=23478>).

Source citations (as archived): [Civil.ge](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110806055906/http://www.civil.ge/eng/article.php?id=23479>).

<a id="event-2011-05-21-0-17"></a>

<a id="event-2011-05-21-0-25"></a>

#### International relations

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2011-05-22-5-0"></a>

<a id="event-2011-05-22-5-1"></a>

<a id="event-2011-05-22-5-2"></a>

<a id="event-2011-05-22-6-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** People continue to peacefully protest against cuts and unemployment in cities across Spain as the country votes in regional elections; the number of participants increases despite a government ban on such occurrences.

### 2011-05-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076411425](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20May%2023&oldid=1076411425>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-05-23-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The death toll from a Pakistani Taliban attack on a Pakistan Navy station in Karachi rises as the attack continues, with several explosions reported.

Source citations (as archived): [NDTV](<http://www.ndtv.com/article/world/terror-attack-on-karachi-naval-station-10-killed-107558>); [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/skynews/Article/201009115997259>); [AFP](<http://www.sbs.com.au/news/article/1543266/Pakistani-Taliban-claim-Karachi-attack-->).

<a id="event-2011-05-23-0-3"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Yemeni uprising:.

**Archived source account.** The Gulf Cooperation Council suspends mediation efforts in Yemen after President Ali Abdullah Saleh refuses to sign a transition agreement for the third time.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/skynews/Home/World-News/Yemen-President-Saleh-Fails-To-Sign-Deal-For-Him-To-Leave-Office-After-33-Years/Article/201105415997388>).

<a id="event-2011-05-23-0-4"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Yemeni uprising:.

**Archived source account.** At least 14 people are killed and 38 others are injured in Sana'a.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2011-05/24/c_13890309.htm>).

<a id="event-2011-05-23-0-5"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Yemeni uprising:.

**Archived source account.** A gunbattle kills a further six in Sana'a.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/05/2011523163134881950.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-23-0-7"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Syrian uprising:.

**Archived source account.** Syria's foreign minister Walid al-Moualem, speaking on television, attacks the European Union for imposing travel bans and asset freezes on officials.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/05/201152319308946820.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-23-0-8"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Syrian uprising:.

**Archived source account.** Veteran British journalist Robert Fisk questions whether the sanctions will affect the Syrian government's crackdown on dissent, as such sanctions have failed to work before.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/video/middleeast/2011/05/2011523153013123678.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-23-0-10"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Libyan civil war:.

**Archived source account.** French officials confirm France and UK are to deploy attack helicopters as part of a boost to NATO's attacks on Muammar Gaddafi.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2011/05/2011523205033961343.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-23-0-12"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Egyptian revolution:.

**Archived source account.** Egyptian pro-democracy groups call for a new round of protests on May 27 due to dissatisfaction at progress in implementing reform.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/2011-05-22/egypt-groups-call-for-second-round-of-rage-on-lack-of-change.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-23-0-13"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Egyptian revolution:.

**Archived source account.** A Cairo court sentences an Egyptian police officer to death in absentia for killing protesters demonstrating during the 2011 Egyptian revolution.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/meast/05/23/egypt.revolution.sentence/>).

<a id="event-2011-05-23-0-14"></a>

**Archived source account.** One Australian Army soldier is killed and five others wounded following two bomb explosions in Afghanistan; the total number of Australian soldiers killed in the Afghan conflict now stands at 24.

Source citations (as archived): [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/national-affairs/defence/another-australian-soldier-has-been-killed-in-afghanistan-the-24th-since-2001/story-e6frg8yo-1226061669649>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2011-05-23-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Church of Scotland votes to allow gay men and lesbians to become ministers.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/uk/2011/may/23/scottish-church-gay-ministers>).

<a id="event-2011-05-23-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Lady Gaga releases her Born This Way album, which is certified platinum in many countries across the world.

No attached source citation. This assertion is unverified; see its disclosure and research status above.

**Archived source account.** The Maritime Union of Australia commences industrial action at cargo terminals at Melbourne, Sydney and Fremantle, affecting half of Australia's maritime trade.

### 2011-05-31

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1342377245](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20May%2031&oldid=1342377245>).

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2011-05-31-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan:.

**Archived source account.** Hamid Karzai, the President of Afghanistan, reacts to the deaths of 9 civilians in a NATO air strike by telling the organization that attacks on insurgents in Afghan homes is "not allowed".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/05/31/us-afghanistan-karzai-casualties-idUSTRE74U0RP20110531>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan:.

**Archived source account.** Two Afghan police officers are injured as their car hits a roadside bomb in northern Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/asiapcf/05/31/afghanistan.attack/index.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-0-4"></a>

Context: 2011 Xilinhot incident:.

**Archived source account.** Dozens of people are arrested in the Inner Mongolia region of northern China, as ethnic protests spread.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/asiapcf/05/31/china.mongolia.protest/>); [Arirang News](<http://www.arirang.co.kr/News/News_View.asp?nseq=116563&amp;code=Ne8&amp;category=1>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-0-5"></a>

Context: 2011 Xilinhot incident:.

**Archived source account.** The Chinese foreign ministry claims foreigners are responsible for the unrest.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-13602589>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-0-6"></a>

Context: 2011 Xilinhot incident:.

**Archived source account.** Chinese state media say the government should meet the "reasonable" demands of ethnic Mongols.

Source citations (as archived): [Straits Times](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110603090208/http://www.straitstimes.com/BreakingNews/Asia/Story/STIStory_674524.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-0-9"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / Yemeni uprising:.

**Archived source account.** A truce between the Yemeni government of President Ali Abdullah Saleh and opposing tribal groups breaks down increasing the chance of a civil war.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/05/31/us-yemen-idUSTRE73L1PP20110531>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-0-10"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / Yemeni uprising:.

**Archived source account.** More than 50 people are killed and hundreds of others are injured by the latest regime forces attacks on civilians in Ta'izz.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-13599828>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/meast/05/31/yemen.unrest/index.html?hpt=hp_t2>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-0-11"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / Yemeni uprising:.

**Archived source account.** Italy temporarily closes its embassy and withdraws its staff, citing threats against Western embassies in the Yemeni capital, Sana'a.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Headlines/Article.aspx?id=223057>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-0-13"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Libyan civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Talks between South African President Jacob Zuma and Muammar Gaddafi end without immediate results, as more than 100 Libyan soldiers, including five generals, two colonels, and one major defect from Gaddafi's forces.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-13597702>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/VideoArticles/Video/Article.aspx?id=222965>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-0-14"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Libyan civil war:.

**Archived source account.** NATO launches fresh air strikes hours after the talks conclude.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/africa/05/30/libya.war/index.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-0-15"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Libyan civil war:.

**Archived source account.** NATO air raids have killed more than 700 civilians and wounded more than 4,000 others across Libya since March, according to reports.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-13611132>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-0-17"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / Syrian uprising:.

**Archived source account.** Residents of the town of Homs fight back against government troops with rifles and Rocket-propelled grenades for the first time, in a clash that kills at least four civilians.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/MiddleEast/Article.aspx?id=222973>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-0-18"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / Syrian uprising:.

**Archived source account.** Syrian President Bashar al-Assad issues an amnesty for all "political crimes" amid continuing protests.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/05/2011531173212337652.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-0-20"></a>

Context: 2011 Spanish protests:.

**Archived source account.** Tens of thousands of "los indignados", young and old, continue to camp against cuts in city center squares as Greeks gather and Parisians protest in solidarity with their Spanish counterparts.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://montrealgazette.com/news/Spaniards+spark+European+protests/4865255/story.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-0-21"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Pakistan Air Force kills seventeen militants in a bombing raid on the upper Orakzai Agency.

Source citations (as archived): [Dawn](<http://www.dawn.com/2011/05/31/seventeen-militants-killed-in-orakzai-agency.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-0-22"></a>

**Archived source account.** British officials confirm the government is working on cyber weapons, the first time it has been officially acknowledged that such a programme exists.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/government-computing-network/2011/may/31/government-plans-cyber-weapons-programme>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-0-23"></a>

**Archived source account.** Families of the victims of the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests say the government is considering compensation for the first time.

Source citations (as archived): [Straits Times](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110603070418/http://www.straitstimes.com/BreakingNews/Asia/Story/STIStory_674520.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-0-24"></a>

**Archived source account.** Riot police in Cameroon arrest and disperse hundreds of farmers protesting in the capital Yaoundé over poor road conditions and low state support for agriculture.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/topNews/idAFJOE74U0TB20110531>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2011-05-31-1-0"></a>

<a id="event-2011-05-31-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Japan's unemployment rate rises to 4.7% and average wages drop for the second consecutive month.

<a id="event-2011-05-31-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** 27 people are killed after their bus plunges into a gorge in Assam, eastern India.

<a id="event-2011-05-31-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** New Zealand government experts predict that there is an almost one in four chance of another powerful earthquake in the Canterbury Region in the next 12 months.

<a id="event-2011-05-31-3-4"></a>

<a id="event-2011-05-31-3-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 20 people die after a bus plunges off a cliff in the Peruvian Andes.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.news.com.au/world/bus-plunges-off-cliff-in-peru-killing-20/story-e6frfkyi-1226067086695>).

#### Health

<a id="event-2011-05-31-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The World Health Organization classifies cell phone radiation as a "carcinogenic hazard" and "possibly carcinogenic to humans." It was classified as such after a team of scientists reviewed peer-review studies on cell phone safety.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/HEALTH/05/31/who.cell.phones/index.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2011-05-31-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iran denies a plane carrying the Chancellor of Germany Angela Merkel access to its airspace for two hours en route to India.

Source citations (as archived): [Der Spiegel](<http://www.spiegel.de/international/world/0,1518,765823,00.html>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/meast/05/31/iran.germany.merkel.flight/index.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** British authorities refuse asylum to 22-year-old Betty Tibikawa, homophobically attacked by three men in Uganda, despite deputy prime minister Nick Clegg's claim that his government would stop its policy of deporting people who are persecuted over their sexual orientation. The British government is currently detaining Ms. Tibikawa at a facility in Bedford.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/uk/2011/may/31/ugandan-branded-iron-deportation-sexuality>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-5-3"></a>

Context: First anniversary of the Gaza flotilla raid:.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people gather in Istanbul's central Taksim Square in memory of 9 activists killed during the Gaza flotilla raid a year ago.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110711072032/http://gamutnews.com/20110531/12387/video-turks-rally-in-memory-of-flotilla-dead.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-5-4"></a>

Context: First anniversary of the Gaza flotilla raid:.

**Archived source account.** A memorial is unveiled at Gaza's harbour, featuring a public park and metal statues shaped as sails.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.forbes.com/feeds/ap/2011/05/31/general-ml-gaza-blockade_8491895.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-5-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Officials from north Sudan and southern Sudan tentatively agree to a demilitarised border following recent tensions over the disputed Abyei border region.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2011/06/01/world/africa/01sudan.html?_r=1>); [Source](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/africa/05/31/sudan.violence/index.html(CNN)>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-5-6"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/2011/06/01/idINIndia-57411820110601>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2011-05-31-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Rustam Makhmudov, suspected of the 2006 shooting of Russian journalist Anna Politkovskaya, is arrested overnight at the home of his parents in Chechnya.,

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-13601260>); [Reuters](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/media/2011/may/31/anna-politkovskaya-murder-suspect-arrested>); [RIA Novosti](<http://en.rian.ru/russia/20110531/164351457.html>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/europe/05/31/russia.journalist.killed.arrest/index.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Serbia's war crimes court rejects an appeal from former Bosnian Serb Colonel General Ratko Mladić against a transfer to a United Nations tribunal in The Hague to face genocide charges.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-13598590>); [AP](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/may/31/ratko-mladic-extradition-appeal-rejected>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Spanish court approves the extradition of former Guatemalan Interior Minister Carlos Vielmann to face murder charges in connection with a 2006 uprising at the Pavon prison in Guatemala where seven inmates were killed.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/americas/05/31/guatemala.former.minister.extradition/index.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-6-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Chechen man is sentenced to 12 years in prison after being convicted of trying to send a letter bomb to the Danish newspaper Jyllands-Posten, which had published drawings of the Muslim prophet Muhammad.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/europe/05/31/denmark.attempted.terror.sentence/index.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-6-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former British Tory peer Lord Taylor of Warwick is jailed for 12 months for falsely claiming £11,277 in parliamentary expenses.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-13599624>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/politics/2011/may/31/mps-expenses-lord-taylor-jailed>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2011-05-31-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Dalai Lama formally relinquishes his political and administrative powers, following the exiled Tibetan parliament's amendment to its charter to relieve him of his political role; the Dalai Lama remains Tibetan Buddhists' spiritual figurehead.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/asiapcf/05/31/india.dalai.lama/index.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-7-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Adil Abdul-Mahdi, First Vice President of Iraq, resigns after Prime Minister Nouri al-Maliki fends off critics who say he has not delivered on power-sharing promises.

Source citations (as archived): [Arabnews](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110813235003/http://arabnews.com/middleeast/article442223.ece>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-7-3"></a>

Context: Ireland cables:.

**Archived source account.** The Irish Independent and the Belfast Telegraph begin a week-long joint publication of the Ireland Cables, the latest batch of U.S. diplomatic cables, in co-operation with WikiLeaks and Julian Assange. The cables, dating back more than 25 years, feature government members, diplomats, alleged terrorists, oil companies and Vatican insiders.

Source citations (as archived): [Irish Independent](<http://www.independent.ie/national-news/wikileaks/wikileaks-the-irish-independent-lifts-the-veil-of-diplomatic-secrecy-via-1903-us-embassy-cables-2661629.html>); [The Belfast Telegraph](<http://www.belfasttelegraph.co.uk/news/local-national/northern-ireland/wikileaks-northern-ireland-secrets-revealed-16006099.html>); [Sociable](<http://sociable.co/2011/05/31/irish-newspaper-begins-publishing-wikileaks-ireland-cables/>); [Irish Central](<http://www.irishcentral.com/news/Wikileaks-reveals-top-level-briefings-by-Irish-govt-for-US-Embassy-122858094.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-7-4"></a>

Context: Ireland cables:.

**Archived source account.** Former government minister Mary Hanafin is outed as one of those who briefed American embassy officials on sensitive government information. Hanafin says she was ordered to do so by U.S. Ambassador Dan Rooney.

Source citations (as archived): [Irish Independent](<http://www.independent.ie/national-news/wikileaks/wikileaks-how-the-usa-got-access-to-irelandrsquos-secrets-2661624.html>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-7-5"></a>

Context: Ireland cables:.

**Archived source account.** Julian Assange gives a series of video interviews to journalists from his base in the English countryside.

Source citations (as archived): [Irish Independent](<http://www.independent.ie/video/video-wikileaks/>).

<a id="event-2011-05-31-8-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Carbon emissions from energy use reached a record level in 2010, up 5% from the previous record in 2008, according to the International Energy Agency, which said it was a "serious setback" to limit global temperature increase to 2 degrees Celsius (3.6 F), set at the U.N. climate change talks in Cancún, Mexico, last year.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/europe/05/31/world.carbon.emissions/index.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-06-13-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** 2011 Jordanian protests: The motorcade of King Abdullah II of Jordan is attacked by bottles and stones thrown by protesters in Tafilah.

<a id="event-2011-06-13-0-1"></a>

<a id="event-2011-06-13-0-2"></a>

<a id="event-2011-06-13-0-4"></a>

Context: 2011 Syrian uprising:.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian regime claims to have retaken Jisr al-Shughour, while residents who fled speak of fighting, divisions and defections among government troops as police and workers arm themselves to defend the town against the army.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/06/2011612101331904689.html>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/jun/13/syrian-troops-target-villagers-turkish-border>).

<a id="event-2011-06-14-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Another land campaigner is shot dead in Brazil's Amazon basin with five activists shot dead in the past month.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-13772238>).

#### Politics

<a id="event-2011-06-14-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** British Prime Minister David Cameron has announced major changes to plans for reforms of the NHS in England saying that the government has made mistakes, but he insists it has not made "a humiliating U-turn".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-13757380>).

<a id="event-2011-06-14-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Members of the United Kingdom's two main teaching unions, the National Union of Teachers and the Association of Teachers and Lecturers have voted to take industrial action over changes to their pensions. They are first expected to walk out on 30 June. Other public sector workers may join them on that day.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/education-13761147>).

### 2011-06-15

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076410054](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20June%2015&oldid=1076410054>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-06-15-0-1"></a>

Context: 2011 Greek uprising:.

**Archived source account.** Greek unions initiate a general strike, with protesters vowing to surround the Hellenic Parliament as it prepares to discuss its plans for financial cuts.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.france24.com/en/20110614-protesters-vow-besiege-parliament-unions-call-general-strike-over-austerity-plan?ns_campaign=nl_quot_en&amp;amp;ns_mchannel=email_marketing&amp;amp;ns_source=NLQ_20110615&amp;amp;f24_member_id=&amp;amp;ns_linkname=node_5209450&amp;amp;ns_fee=0>); [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2011-06/15/c_13931590.htm>); [euronews](<http://www.euronews.net/2011/06/15/greece-braced-for-anti-austerity-protest/>).

<a id="event-2011-06-15-0-2"></a>

Context: 2011 Greek uprising:.

**Archived source account.** Greek and Spanish flags fill parliament square alongside banners reading "Resist" and ¡no pasarán\! (they shall not pass), dating from the Spanish Civil War.

Source citations (as archived): [DAWN](<http://www.dawn.com/2011/06/15/greek-strikers-turn-out-in-thousands.html>).

<a id="event-2011-06-15-0-3"></a>

Context: 2011 Greek uprising:.

**Archived source account.** The protesters call themselves the "indignants" in solidarity with their Spanish counterparts who camped against cuts in Madrid and Barcelona until the Spanish police forced them out.

Source citations (as archived): [Sofia Echo](<http://www.sofiaecho.com/2011/06/15/1106520_athens-protests-turn-violent-outside-parliament-square>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-13773817>).

<a id="event-2011-06-15-0-4"></a>

Context: 2011 Greek uprising:.

**Archived source account.** Police descend in droves on the parliament building, blocking the protesters from forming a human ring around it, firing water cannon at the protesters and barricading their path.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw-world.de/dw/article/0,,15154672,00.html>).

<a id="event-2011-06-15-0-5"></a>

Context: 2011 Greek uprising:.

**Archived source account.** Police fire tear gas on Greek people protesting against cuts being implemented by their government in co-operation with the European Union and International Monetary Fund.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-13773148>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2011/06/201161572136449774.html>); [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/content/greek_workers_strike_austerity_measures/24235735.html>).

<a id="event-2011-06-15-0-6"></a>

Context: 2011 Greek uprising:.

**Archived source account.** Police detain 10 protesters to prevent them disrupting lawmakers as they slip into parliament by car.

Source citations (as archived): [Taiwan News](<http://www.taiwannews.com.tw/etn/news_content.php?id=1626680>).

<a id="event-2011-06-15-0-7"></a>

Context: 2011 Greek uprising:.

**Archived source account.** Some Greek journalists' unions cancel their strike in order to provide coverage of the protests.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/jun/15/greece-general-strike-parliament-clashes>).

<a id="event-2011-06-15-0-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** 2011 Spanish protests: Protesters blockade parliament buildings in Barcelona, in a protest simultaneous with events in Greece, to express their annoyance with government cuts after camping outside overnight. The Presidents of Catalan Government and Parliament avoid the protesters by flying in on helicopters.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-13774761>).

<a id="event-2011-06-15-0-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** Bank of Ireland chairman Pat Molloy and chief executive Richie Boucher, gathered for a meeting at University College Dublin (UCD), are attacked with eggs amid calls to have them all "taken out and bloody shot".

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/business/2011/jun/15/bank-of-ireland-agm-investors-pensioners-anger>); [The Irish Times](<https://web.archive.org/web/20121024030720/http://www.irishtimes.com/newspaper/breaking/2011/0615/breaking26.html>); [The Wall Street Journal](<http://online.wsj.com/article/BT-CO-20110615-705506.html>); [RTÉ](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2011/0615/boi.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-13782172>).

<a id="event-2011-06-15-0-11"></a>

Context: 2011 Libyan civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Rebels make fresh gains against forces of Muammar Gaddafi in the east and west of the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2011/06/2011614133151319133.html>).

<a id="event-2011-06-15-0-12"></a>

Context: 2011 Libyan civil war:.

**Archived source account.** French newspaper Le Figaro reports that Hezbollah has transferred hundreds of missiles from Syria to Lebanon, fearing the fall of the Syrian government in the ongoing Syrian uprising.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/news/diplomacy-defense/report-hezbollah-moves-missiles-from-syria-to-lebanon-fearing-fall-of-assad-regime-1.369586>).

<a id="event-2011-06-26-0-5"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Libyan civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Rebels and regime forces clash about 80 km (50 miles) south-west of the capital, Tripoli as rebels make a push towards the capital.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-13921665>).

<a id="event-2011-06-26-0-7"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** Following accusations by the Foreign Press Association that Israel is intimidating journalists on the 10-ship flotilla due to sail to the Gaza Strip, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu says that the journalists will not to be sanctioned.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/jun/26/israel-accused-gaza-flotilla-journalists>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/DiplomacyAndPolitics/Article.aspx?id=226816>).

<a id="event-2011-06-26-0-8"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** Israeli troops begin to dismantle part of the controversial West Bank barrier near the Palestinian village of Bilin, four years after a court ordered it to be re-routed.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-13920483>).

<a id="event-2011-06-26-0-9"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** A bomb causes a large explosion near the United Nations compound in Gaza City on the Gaza Strip.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-13918202>).

<a id="event-2011-06-26-0-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Vietnamese protesters march in the capital Hanoi for the fourth successive week calling on the People's Republic of China to stop entering Vietnamese territorial waters on the South China Sea.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.msnbc.msn.com/id/43538759>).

<a id="event-2011-06-26-0-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 25 people are killed and many others are wounded after a bomb explodes in Maiduguri.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-13920980>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/jun/27/nigeria-bombings-terrorist-killings-islamist>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2011-06-26-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** More than one million people participate in São Paulo's 15th Gay Pride March following the recent improvement in the legal rights afforded to the country's gay community.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-13890258>).

<a id="event-2011-06-26-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** It is confirmed that Daniel Craig, the current James Bond, has married the Academy Award-winning actress Rachel Weisz at a private ceremony in the U.S. state of New York.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/entertainment-arts-13918943>).

<a id="event-2011-06-26-1-3"></a>

Context: Glastonbury Festival 2011 in Pilton, Somerset:.

**Archived source account.** Beyoncé makes her debut at the Glastonbury Festival, becoming one of only a small number of women to have headlined.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/entertainment-arts-13919280>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/music/2011/jun/27/beyonce-glastonbury-2011-review>).

<a id="event-2011-06-26-1-4"></a>

Context: Glastonbury Festival 2011 in Pilton, Somerset:.

**Archived source account.** Christopher Shale, a senior member of British Prime Minister David Cameron's Conservative constituency association, is found dead in a portaloo; Shale died hours after a critical strategy document credited to him was published in a Sunday newspaper.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-somerset-13918856>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/music/2011/jun/26/senior-tory-glastonbury-christopher-shale>).

#### Disasters

<a id="event-2011-06-26-2-1"></a>

Context: Eruption of Puyehue-Cordón Caulle in Chile:.

**Archived source account.** Ash cloud from the 2011 Puyehue-Cordón Caulle eruption continues to disrupt flights between Australia and New Zealand.

Source citations (as archived): [The Sydney Morning Herald](<http://www.smh.com.au/travel/travel-news/ash-cloud-prevents-nz-flights-20110626-1gl9m.html>).

<a id="event-2011-06-26-2-2"></a>

Context: Eruption of Puyehue-Cordón Caulle in Chile:.

**Archived source account.** The Chilean airline LAN cancels 39 flights in Chile and Argentina due to ash cloud from the 2011 Puyehue-Cordón Caulle eruption.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.am1150.ca/News/World/Article.aspx?id=291451>).

<a id="event-2011-06-26-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The bodies of six mountaineers are found on Neige Cordier in the French Alps after apparently having been killed by an avalanche.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-13919018>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/jun/26/alps-climbers-died-falling-mountainside>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/europe/06/26/france.alps.bodies/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2011-06-26-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The so-called "LulzSec" hackers have reportedly disbanded after a final data dump including information from AOL Inc. and AT&amp;T.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/06/26/us-cybersecurity-lulzsec-idUSTRE75P05I20110626>).

<a id="event-2011-06-26-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The sentence for a drug possession conviction of the nephew of deposed Tunisian President, Zine el Abidine Ben Ali, is increased after he appeals it.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/africa/06/26/tunisia.ben.ali.nephew/index.html>).

#### Politics

<a id="event-2011-06-26-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Senate of Canada passes a back-to-work bill imposing a labour contract for 48,000 Canada Post employees resulting in a return-to-work by Tuesday.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/story/2011/06/26/canada-post.html>).

#### Science

<a id="event-2011-06-26-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The strain of E. coli blamed for 46 deaths in Germany appears to have resurfaced in France, sickening eight people, who have been hospitalized in Bordeaux.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/europe/06/26/france.e.coli/index.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2011-06-26-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In association football, Club Atlético River Plate of Argentina are relegated for the first time in their 110-year history. The result enrages River Plate hooligans, who riot inside and outside the stadium; at least 35 police and 55 civilians are reported to be injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<https://www.usatoday.com/sports/soccer/2011-06-26-1279044786_x.htm>).

<a id="event-2011-06-26-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** In car racing, Sebastian Vettel of Red Bull wins the European Grand Prix in Valencia. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [BBC Sport](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/motorsport/formula_one/9522979.stm>); [The Sunday Business Post](<http://www.thepost.ie/breakingnews/sport/ojkfauojauey/>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/sport/2011/jun/26/sebastian-vettel-european-grand-prix>).

<a id="event-2011-06-26-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A former goalkeeper for the South Korea national football team turns himself in for involvement in a match fixing scheme for K-League matches.

Source citations (as archived): [Yonhap News](<http://english.yonhapnews.co.kr/news/2011/06/27/91/0200000000AEN20110627000700315F.HTML>).

### 2011-06-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076409436](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20June%2027&oldid=1076409436>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-06-27-0-2"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Syrian uprising:.

**Archived source account.** Dozens of dissidents, some of whom were previously imprisoned by the regime, attend a conference in Damascus. It is the first such conference.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-13924828>).

<a id="event-2011-06-27-0-3"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Syrian uprising:.

**Archived source account.** Syrian President Bashar al-Assad announces that his government will invite opposition figures to talks to be held in July to set the framework for a national dialogue that he has promised, and that constitutional changes would be on the agenda.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/VideoArticles/Video/Article.aspx?id=226824>).

<a id="event-2011-06-27-0-5"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Libyan civil war:.

**Archived source account.** The International Criminal Court at The Hague issues an arrest warrant for Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi, and two of his relatives, his son Saif al-Islam Gaddafi and intelligence chief Abdullah Senussi for alleged "crimes against humanity".

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.france24.com/en/20110627-international-criminal-court-rule-icc-hague-gaddafi-arrest-warrant-senussi-al-islam?ns_campaign=nl_obs_en&amp;ns_mchannel=email_marketing&amp;ns_source=BOWE_26_20110627&amp;ns_linkname=20110627_international_criminal_court_rule_icc_hague&amp;ns_fee=0&amp;f24_member_id=1043505976770>); [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/8301-503543_162-20074583-503543.html?tag=stack>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/africa/06/27/libya.war/index.html?hpt=wo_c2>).

<a id="event-2011-06-27-0-7"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / Bahraini uprising:.

**Archived source account.** The trial of 47 medical personnel, accused of working against the government during large protests in Bahrain earlier this year resumes and is immediately adjourned; human rights groups say Bahrain is targeting medical professionals for treating protesters.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/meast/06/27/bahrain.medics/index.html>).

<a id="event-2011-06-27-0-9"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan:.

**Archived source account.** Seven civilians, including children, are killed by two separate roadside mines in Afghanistan's eastern Ghazni Province; an 8-year-old girl was killed when militants gave her a remote-controlled explosive in a bag and told her to give it to police officers in Oruzgan Province.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/asiapcf/06/27/afghanistan.violence/index.html>).

<a id="event-2011-06-27-0-10"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan:.

**Archived source account.** Afghanistan says the Pakistani military is behind recent deadly rocket attacks in Kunar Province that killed at least 20 civilians; Pakistan says it is not responsible.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/asiapcf/06/27/afghanistan.pakistan.rockets/index.html>).

<a id="event-2011-06-27-0-12"></a>

Context: Conflicts in Pakistan:.

**Archived source account.** The Pakistani Taliban said two of the three suicide bombers who killed 10 police officers Saturday in northwestern Pakistan were a married couple; 15 policemen were taken hostage by other miltants before security forces killed six of them.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/asiapcf/06/27/pakistan.suicide.couple/index.html?hpt=wo_c2>).

<a id="event-2011-06-27-0-13"></a>

Context: Conflicts in Pakistan:.

**Archived source account.** A suspected U.S. drone attack in the South Waziristan, Pakistan, bordering on Afghanistan, kills six militants.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/asiapcf/06/27/pakistan.drone.strike/index.html>).

<a id="event-2011-06-27-0-14"></a>

**Archived source account.** One person is killed during an attack on a train in Sudan.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-13925407>).

<a id="event-2011-06-27-0-15"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iran announces plans to conduct a military exercise and test the Sajjil long-range missile, which is reportedly capable of striking Israel or southeastern Europe.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/IranianThreat/News/Article.aspx?ID=226711&amp;R=R1>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2011-06-27-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Overseas artists are "poorly treated" by the UK's "absurd visa bureaucracy" according to a letter signed by dozens of prominent artists, including David Hare, Tom Stoppard, Salman Rushdie, Hanif Kureishi, Philip Pullman, Antonia Fraser, Michael Morpurgo and Sarah Waters. The letter suggests Abbas Kiarostami and Grigory Sokolov have already been "dissuaded from future visits".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/entertainment-arts-13927454>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/commentisfree/2011/jun/27/britain-persecutes-visiting-artists-visa>); [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/uknews/immigration/8599638/World-class-artists-put-off-coming-to-Britain-by-intrusive-points-based-immigration-system.html>); [The Economic Times](<http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/nri/visa-and-immigration/salman-rushdie-others-protest-uk-immigration-rules/articleshow/9013399.cms>).

<a id="event-2011-06-27-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The University of York purchases a tonne of material relating to Alan Ayckbourn for £240,000 and plans to make it available to the general public and online.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/stage/2011/jun/27/alan-ayckbourn-archive-available-public>).

<a id="event-2011-06-27-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Old people are using Facebook in the United Kingdom more and more according to Nielsen.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-13925893>).

<a id="event-2011-06-27-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A leak is detected in a PTT Public Company Limited pipeline in the Gulf of Thailand; the leak will cut natural gas supplies in Thailand and affect power generation. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Bangkok Post](<http://www.bangkokpost.com/news/local/244122/pipeline-leak-will-drive-up-power-bills-says-egat>).

<a id="event-2011-06-27-3-1"></a>

Context: Fukushima Daiichi nuclear disaster:.

**Archived source account.** Tests conducted last month show radioactive cesium has been found in small quantities in residents in the towns of Iitate and Kawamata, Fukushima, located about 25 miles (40 kilometers) from the crippled Fukushima Daiichi nuclear power plant.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/asiapcf/06/27/japan.radiation/index.html>).

<a id="event-2011-06-27-3-3"></a>

Context: Fukushima Daiichi nuclear disaster:.

**Archived source account.** Nicolas Sarkozy of France plans to invest €1 billion in nuclear power despite the devastation caused by the ongoing Fukushima Daiichi nuclear disaster in Japan.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2011-06-27-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Government publishes the Trafficking In Persons report, naming those countries that are not meeting minimum standards against human trafficking and slavery, and which may be subject to US sanctions as a result.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://thecnnfreedomproject.blogs.cnn.com/2011/06/27/slavery-report-names-weak-link-nations/?hpt=wo_c1>).

<a id="event-2011-06-27-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sudanese president Omar al-Bashir, the subject of an International Criminal Court arrest warrant for genocide, war crimes and crimes against humanity in the region of Darfur, unexpectedly delays his visit to China without official explanation, after he had already departed for an anti-terrorism conference hosted by Iran.

<a id="event-2011-06-27-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Philip Morris International, the world's largest tobacco corporation, threatens to sue the Australian government in relation to its introduction of plain, brandless cigarette packing.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-13923095>).

<a id="event-2011-06-27-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pakistan expels British military advisers following the United States Navy Seals raid that resulted in the death of Osama bin Laden.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/asia/pakistan/8600104/British-military-advisers-expelled-from-Pakistan.html>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/asiapcf/06/27/pakistan.uk.military/index.html>).

Context: Gaza Flotilla II:.

**Archived source account.** Israel denies pressuring Greece to stop the ships participating in the flotilla from departing; Prime Minister of Israel Benjamin Netanyahu's inner cabinet instructs the Israel Defense Forces to stop it.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/meast/06/26/israel.gaza.flotilla/index.html>); [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/news/diplomacy-defense/gaza-flotilla-organizers-israel-is-pressuring-greece-to-halt-ships-departure-1.369851>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Defense/Article.aspx?id=226736>).

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2011-06/27/c_13952661.htm>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2011-06-27-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Brown v. Entertainment Merchants Association: In a 7-2 decision, the Supreme Court of the United States strikes down a 2005 California law prohibiting minors' access to violent or offensive video games, citing them as protected speech under the First Amendment.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110709205144/http://www.suntimes.com/business/6197260-420/supreme-court-government-cant-ban-violent-video-game-sales-to-kids.html>).

<a id="event-2011-06-27-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A United Nations-backed tribunal in Cambodia holds its first hearings in the trial of four former senior Khmer Rouge officials, including former head of state Khieu Samphan and Pol Pot's deputy Nuon Chea. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-13922564>); [AFP](<http://www.france24.com/en/20110627-khmer-rouge-genocide-trial-opens-cambodia-0#>).

<a id="event-2011-06-27-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police clash with local residents who object to Italian government plans to build a European Union-funded rail link with France near their homes in the Italian Alps. The police intervention follows a peaceful candlelight nighttime prayer vigil featuring thousands of people.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-13923741>).

<a id="event-2011-06-27-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A jury convicts former Governor of the US state of Illinois Rod Blagojevich on seventeen charges of corruption.

Source citations (as archived): [Chicago Tribune](<http://www.chicagotribune.com/news/local/breaking/chi-blagojevich-jurors-going-into-their-10th-day-20110627,0,620170.story>).

<a id="event-2011-06-27-5-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Justin Cannon, a former Blackwater Worldwide (now called Xe Services LLC) employee, is sentenced to thirty months in jail for involuntary manslaughter of an Afghan civilian in a shooting in 2009.

Source citations (as archived): [Virginian Pilot](<http://hamptonroads.com/2011/06/2nd-exblackwater-worker-gets-30-months-manslaughter>).

#### Politics

<a id="event-2011-06-27-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Up to 750,000 teachers and civil servants in the United Kingdom are set to strike on Thursday after talks aimed at averting the action failed to broker an agreement.
