### 2011-06-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1185383579](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20June%2030&oldid=1185383579>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-06-30-0-2"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Syrian uprising:.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian army kills a man and his 1 year old infant son after they attack his house in the village of al-Bara.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/WORLD/meast/06/30/syria.unrest/index.html>).

<a id="event-2011-06-30-0-3"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Syrian uprising:.

**Archived source account.** Al Jazeera reports that there have been many arrests in the southern town of Deraa with people fleeing to either Damascus or Jordan.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://blogs.aljazeera.net/liveblog/syria-jun-30-2011-0358>).

<a id="event-2011-06-30-0-5"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Libyan civil war:.

**Archived source account.** France's dropping of arms for tribal fighters in Libya is a "crude violation" of United Nations Security Council Resolution 1970 according to Russian foreign minister Sergey Lavrov, echoing African Union concerns that it risks "a Somalia-sation" of Libya".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-13979632>).

<a id="event-2011-06-30-0-6"></a>

Context: Arab Spring: / 2011 Libyan civil war:.

**Archived source account.** The UK Secretary of State for Foreign and Commonwealth Affairs William Hague announces that Britain would supply body armour, police uniforms and communications equipment to Libyan National Transitional Council police forces. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.mercurynews.com/news/ci_18383338?nclick_check=1>).

<a id="event-2011-06-30-0-7"></a>

Context: Arab Spring:.

**Archived source account.** 2011 Egyptian revolution: A court says that it will issue a ruling on the murder case of two policeman allegedly involved in the death of Khaled Mohamed Saeed on August 24, rather than today as was expected, in a case that helped spark the revolution.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110701171138/http://www.trust.org/alertnet/news/egypt-court-to-rule-on-activist-death-sept-24>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/middleeast/2011/06/20116306330136695.html>).

<a id="event-2011-06-30-0-9"></a>

Context: Afghanistan:.

**Archived source account.** Two freed French journalists, Herve Ghesquiere and Stephane Taponier, return to France after being held captive in Afghanistan by the Taliban for 18 months.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.france24.com/en/20110630-journalists-france-hostages-afghanistan-paris-sarkozy-ghesquiere-taponier>).

<a id="event-2011-06-30-0-10"></a>

Context: Afghanistan:.

**Archived source account.** The International Security Assistance Force blames the Pakistani Haqqani network for a recent attack on the Kabul Inter-Continental and claims to have killed the organiser of the attack in a targeted strike on Wednesday.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/stories/2011/06/29/501364/main20075653.shtml?tag=cbsContent;cbsCarousel>).

<a id="event-2011-06-30-0-11"></a>

Context: Afghanistan:.

**Archived source account.** At least five private security contractors are killed and nine others are injured in a U.S. airstrike in Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Press TV](<http://www.presstv.com/detail/186933.html>).

<a id="event-2011-06-30-0-12"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Pakistani media reports Defence Minister Ahmad Mukhtar as claiming that the United States will no longer be able to use the Shamsi Airfield to launch drone attacks on militants.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/06/30/us-pakistan-usa-base-idUSTRE75T0IU20110630>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia/2011/06/20116304212789309.html>).

<a id="event-2011-06-30-0-13"></a>

**Archived source account.** Official records on the 2002 Gujarat violence, which killed more than 1,000 people, are reported to have been destroyed in line with regulations.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-south-asia-13970748>).

<a id="event-2011-06-30-0-14"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Nations extends MONUSCO, its mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, for a thirteenth year, with 5 million people dead so far.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/video/africa/2011/06/201163065513179256.html>).

<a id="event-2011-06-30-0-15"></a>

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2011-06-30-6-1"></a>

Context: Protests against austerity in Greece:.

**Archived source account.** The Greek parliament in Athens holds a second vote on cuts, this one to put in place pay cuts, tax increases, privatisations and redundancies.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-13970916>).

<a id="event-2011-06-30-6-2"></a>

Context: Protests against austerity in Greece:.

**Archived source account.** Protests continue outside parliament as MPs consider this the second part of their austerity package.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2011/06/201163015159581624.html>).

<a id="event-2011-06-30-6-3"></a>

Context: Protests against austerity in Greece:.

**Archived source account.** Greece's rulers pass the second austerity bill asked for by the European Union (EU) and the International Monetary Fund (IMF) by a margin of 155 in favour of it, 136 against it and 5 abstaining.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2011/06/2011630144310840607.html>).

<a id="event-2011-06-30-6-5"></a>

Context: Protests against austerity in the UK:.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of thousands of people go on strike across the United Kingdom in relation to worsening pension conditions being discussed by the government and opposition, while MPs from both the government and opposition condemn them for going on strike.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-13967580>); [Press TV](<http://www.presstv.com/detail/186936.html>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/video/europe/2011/06/201163092012758854.html>).

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2011-07-04-0-1"></a>

Context: Arab Spring:.

**Archived source account.** 2011 Moroccan protests: Democracy campaigners dismiss as "unbelievable" government figures showing that 98 per cent of voters backed Morocco's constitutional referendum amid allegations of multiple voting, with people marching through Rabat, Casablanca and Tangier chanting "The interior minister is a liar".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-14011212>).

<a id="event-2011-07-04-0-2"></a>

Context: Arab Spring:.

**Archived source account.** 2011 Syrian uprising: Government troops arrive in Hama in buses to raid houses and arrest civilians following the mass popular anti-government protests there on Friday. Tanks laying siege to the city move north to other villages.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-14011188>).

<a id="event-2011-07-04-0-3"></a>

Context: Arab Spring:.

**Archived source account.** 2011 Yemeni uprising: Thousands of people rally against authority in Sana'a, marching towards the residence of Vice-President Abd al-Rab Mansur al-Hadi since Ali Abdullah Saleh, who has ruled the country for 33 years, remains in Saudi Arabia receiving treatment for his wounds.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-14017949>).

<a id="event-2011-07-04-0-4"></a>

Context: Arab Spring:.

**Archived source account.** 2011 Libyan civil war: NATO chief Anders Fogh Rasmussen defends the group's presence in Libya during a meeting of the NATO-Russia Council in Sochi, claiming that its mission is in "strict conformity" with United Nations Security Council Resolution 1973.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-14010305>).

<a id="event-2011-07-04-0-5"></a>

Context: Arab Spring:.

**Archived source account.** 2011 Egyptian revolution: Clashes break out at a courthouse as 7 police officers, suspected of killing protesters in Suez during the popular revolution that ousted Hosni Mubarak from power, are released on bail by a judge in Cairo.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-14023293>); [The Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/middle-east/Riots-erupt-in-Egypt-after-court-releases-police/articleshow/9106161.cms>); [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle-east/riots-erupt-after-court-releases-egyptian-police-charged-with-killing-protesters-in-uprising/2011/07/04/gHQAp5ipxH_story.html>).

<a id="event-2011-07-04-0-6"></a>

Context: Arab Spring:.

**Archived source account.** Tunisian revolution: Zine El Abidine Ben Ali, who fled to Saudi Arabia as his regime was ousted from power in a popular revolution, is convicted in absentia on charges of possessing illegal drugs and weapons and sentenced to 15 years in jail at a court in Tunis.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-14014757>); [AP](<https://www.nytimes.com/2011/07/05/world/africa/05briefs-Tunisia.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2011-07-05-4-1"></a>

Context: News of the World phone hacking affair:.

**Archived source account.** British tabloid the News of the World faces fresh allegations linking it to hacking activities, this time after it emerges that the mobile phone of murdered 13-year-old schoolgirl Milly Dowler was interfered with and messages left by relatives were deleted. This gave relatives the false impression that Milly Dowler was still alive when she was not.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-14024668>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/video/europe/2011/07/201175155513420452.html>).

<a id="event-2011-07-05-4-2"></a>

Context: News of the World phone hacking affair:.

**Archived source account.** Colin Stagg, the man who was falsely accused of Rachel Nickell's 1992 murder on Wimbledon Common, is informed that he too had his phone hacked by the News of the World, as many as six years after he was acquitted. Robert Napper later admitted responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/media/2011/jul/05/phone-hacking-colin-stagg-news-of-the-world?intcmp=239>).

<a id="event-2011-07-05-4-3"></a>

Context: News of the World phone hacking affair:.

**Archived source account.** It is revealed that police have contacted the parents of murdered schoolgirls Holly Wells and Jessica Chapman amid concerns that the News of the World tabloid also hacked them.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/media/2011/jul/05/phone-hacking-soham-families-police>); [Channel 4 News](<http://www.channel4.com/news/brooks-appalled-by-milly-phone-hack-claims>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-14035270>); [The Belfast Telegraph](<http://www.belfasttelegraph.co.uk/news/local-national/uk/soham-parents-contacted-on-hacking-16019809.html>).

<a id="event-2011-07-05-4-4"></a>

Context: News of the World phone hacking affair:.

**Archived source account.** Peta Buscombe, Baroness Buscombe states in an interview on the BBC that the News of the World tabloid told lies to the Press Complaints Commission (PCC), an alteration in opinion.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/media/2011/jul/05/phone-hacking-lie-pcc-buscombe>).

<a id="event-2011-07-05-4-5"></a>

Context: News of the World phone hacking affair:.

**Archived source account.** David Cameron and Ed Miliband condemn the continuing revelations concerning the News of the World's alleged hacking activities.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/uk/2011/jul/05/milly-dowler-phone-hacking-cameron>); [Channel 4 News](<http://www.channel4.com/news/dowler-phone-hack-truly-dreadful-says-pm>).

<a id="event-2011-07-05-4-6"></a>

Context: News of the World phone hacking affair:.

**Archived source account.** In an unusual move, House of Commons Speaker John Bercow allows an emergency debate to discuss the possibilities of a public inquiry and of a cover-up, occurring in the House of Commons tomorrow.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/uk/2011/jul/05/milly-dowler-phone-hacking-emergency-debate>).

<a id="event-2011-07-05-4-7"></a>

Context: News of the World phone hacking affair:.

**Archived source account.** Ford Motor Company announces it is pulling all advertising from the News of the World tabloid following reports that it allegedly hacked the voicemail of murdered 13-year-old schoolgirl Milly Dowler; mobile communications company T-Mobile, Currys and PC World all consider joining Ford.

Source citations (as archived): [The Financial Times](<http://online.wsj.com/article/BT-CO-20110705-708601.html>); [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/finance/newsbysector/mediatechnologyandtelecoms/8618647/T-Mobile-reviews-News-of-the-World-advertising-over-Milly-Dowler-phone-hacking-claims.html>).

<a id="event-2011-07-05-4-8"></a>

Context: News of the World phone hacking affair:.

**Archived source account.** Glenn Mulcaire, the private investigator at the centre of the allegations, apologises for any hurt he has caused.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/finance/newsbysector/mediatechnologyandtelecoms/8619065/Private-investigator-at-centre-of-phone-hacking-row-apologies.html>).

<a id="event-2011-07-05-4-9"></a>

Context: News of the World phone hacking affair:.

**Archived source account.** The family of a victim of the 7 July 2005 London bombings allegedly had their phones hacked.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/skynews/Article/201009116025018>).

<a id="event-2011-07-05-4-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Both The Sun and Daily Mirror tabloid newspapers are accused of being in contempt of court for publishing articles about the arrest of Christopher Jefferies in relation to the murder of Joanna Yeates; Jefferies was later released without charge. British Attorney General Dominic Grieve is seeking to bring charges against the newspapers. Judges will make a decision on the case at a later date.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-14024079>); [The Belfast Telegraph](<http://www.belfasttelegraph.co.uk/news/local-national/uk/tabloid-jo-reports-in-contempt-16019664.html>).

<a id="event-2011-07-05-4-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** 13 UK Uncut activists appear in court on charges of aggravated trespass after peacefully occupying the luxury London food retailer Fortnum &amp; Mason during a protest against tax avoidance in March. More than 100 other activists are also expected to be put on trial later, with Labour MP John McDonnell claiming such a trial would be "outrageous" and "fly in the face of public opinion".

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/uk/2011/jul/05/uk-uncut-protesters-court>).

<a id="event-2011-07-05-4-12"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Netherlands is held responsible for the deaths of three Bosniaks during the Srebrenica massacre in Bosnia, according to a court ruling in The Hague.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-14026218>); [Al Jazeera](<http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2011/07/20117585931325737.html>); [Reuters](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/jul/05/dutch-state-responsible-srebrenica-deaths>).

<a id="event-2011-07-05-4-13"></a>

**Archived source account.** 25-year-old navy medic Michael Lyons is found guilty in Plymouth of refusing to attend rifle training; Lyons says he developed a moral objection to the war in Afghanistan due to revelations made public by WikiLeaks.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/uk/2011/jul/05/navy-medic-afghanistan-rifle-training>).

<a id="event-2011-07-05-4-14"></a>

**Archived source account.** New South Wales police are given more powers to remove burqas as anyone refusing to do so faces fines of thousands of dollars or months behind bars. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-pacific-14025386>); [AFP](<http://www.france24.com/en/20110705-australia-police-get-power-demand-burqa-removal-0>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/jul/05/australia-new-south-wales-police-burqa-removal>).

<a id="event-2011-07-05-4-15"></a>

**Archived source account.** Up to 7,000 police march on Yonge Street in Newmarket, Ontario, including some Royal Canadian Mounted Police and American officers, accompanied by thousands of spectators for the funeral procession for Canadian YRP police Constable Garrett Styles, killed when a 15-year-old underage driver accelerated during a traffic stop.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/toronto/story/2011/06/29/styles-officer-tributes548.html>); [The Toronto Star](<http://livenews.thestar.com/Event/Funeral_for_Const_Garrett_Styles>); [The Hamilton Spectator](<https://web.archive.org/web/20110709074615/http://www.thespec.com/news/article/558183--thousands-gather-for-police-funeral>).

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of England and Wales dismisses an attempt by police to suspend a legal ruling limiting the powers of police bail.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-14032706>).

<a id="event-2011-07-05-4-17"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Somali man, Ahmed Abdulkadir Warsame, is charged in the US city of New York with assisting the terrorist groups Al Shaabab and Al Qaeda in the Arabian Peninsula.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2011/07/06/world/africa/06detain.html?_r=1&amp;hp>).

#### Science

<a id="event-2011-07-28-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Astronomers using the Wide-field Infrared Survey Explorer telescope identify a Trojan asteroid, calling it 2010 TK7, orbiting on the same path as the Earth around the Sun. The rock poses no danger to the Earth since it sits in a what is termed a gravitational "sweet spot".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-14307987>); [Nature](<http://www.nature.com/nature/journal/v475/n7357/full/nature10233.html>).

Lochte becomes the first person to set a long-course world record since FINA banned rubberized swimsuits in 2010.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<http://content.usatoday.com/communities/gameon/post/2011/07/lochte-beats-phelps-with-world-record-time/1>).

<a id="event-2011-07-29-4-9"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2011/09/13/nyregion/david-weprin-and-bob-turner-campaign-on-eve-of-house-election.html>); [The Atlantic Monthly](<https://www.theatlantic.com/politics/archive/2011/09/bob-turner-leads-in-new-york-special-election/244961/>); [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/files/elections/2011/by_county/NY_US_House_0913.html?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=POLITICS>).

<a id="event-2011-09-13-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Voters in Nevada's 2nd congressional district go to the polls for a special election to replace former member of the United States House of Representatives, Senator Dean Heller, with Republican Mark Amodei defeating Democrat Kate Marshall.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2011/09/13/nyregion/david-weprin-and-bob-turner-campaign-on-eve-of-house-election.html>); [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/files/elections/2011/by_county/NV_US_House_0913.html?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=POLITICS>).

<a id="event-2011-09-13-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The date of the Venezuelan presidential election is set for 7 October, 2012.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-14908556>).

<a id="event-2011-09-13-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The British House of Commons Culture, Media and Sport Committee announces its intention to recall James Murdoch as its probe into the News International phone hacking scandal continues.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-14899265>).

<a id="event-2011-09-13-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom Boundaries Commission publishes proposals to redraw constituency boundaries in England and Northern Ireland to reduce the number of MPs in the House of Commons from 650 to 600 at the next general election. Proposals for Scotland and Wales will be announced later.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-14882741>).

<a id="event-2011-09-13-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Unions in the United Kingdom call on members to stage a nationwide "day of action" on 30 November in protest at changes to public sector pensions.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-14907909>).

### 2011-09-14

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076403819](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20September%2014&oldid=1076403819>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-09-14-0-1"></a>

Context: Taliban attack on Kabul:.

**Archived source account.** A Taliban attack on the centre of the Afghan capital Kabul ends with 11 people dead.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/asia/afghanistan/8761456/Deadly-Kabul-siege-finally-ends.html>).

<a id="event-2011-09-14-0-2"></a>

Context: Taliban attack on Kabul:.

**Archived source account.** The United States Secretary of Defense Leon Panetta warned that the United States would retaliate against the Pakistan-based Haqqani network of terrorists that it believes was responsible.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5ii2hPUpbeyq306Jv6sgdwpsDCNWw?docId=CNG.e16db70adb3c742a3386ea10319a7112.4f1>).

<a id="event-2011-09-14-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** More than twenty people are killed and scores injured in attacks in Iraq, including 16 people killed in a car bombing in Babil Province.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/13-killed-in-iraq-restaurant-bombing/2011/09/14/gIQAfvUWRK_story.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2011-09-14-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Archaeologists in the US state of Maryland claim to have found a fort in the Zekiah Swamp in Charles County built to protect the "friendly" Piscataway Indians in 1680.

Source citations (as archived): [Baltimore Sun](<http://www.baltimoresun.com/news/maryland/bs-md-zekiah-fort-found-20110914,0,2231736.story>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2011-09-14-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Robert Zoellick, the President of the World Bank, claims that the world economy has entered the "danger zone", with the United States, European Union and Japan having to make tough decisions.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/09/14/worldbank-zoellick-idUSS1E78D0XK20110914>).

#### Disasters

<a id="event-2011-09-14-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tropical Storm Maria is strengthening in the Atlantic Ocean with a hurricane watch issued in Bermuda for when it arrives either late tonight or tomorrow.

Source citations (as archived): [National Hurricane Centre](<https://web.archive.org/web/20111118093231/http://www.nola.com/hurricane/index.ssf/2011/09/tropical_storm_maria_could_bec.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2011-09-14-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The acquittals of former Premier of Western Australia Brian Burke, former Cabinet Minister Julian Grill and former public servant Nathan Hondros on corruption charges are overturned by the Court of Appeal in Perth, with the three set to face a retrial.

Source citations (as archived): [AAP](<http://news.smh.com.au/breaking-news-national/former-wa-premier-to-face-new-trial-20110914-1k8pl.html>).

<a id="event-2011-09-14-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A French Appeals Court clears former Prime Minister Dominique de Villepin of charges of involvement in a smear campaign against current President Nicolas Sarkozy.

Source citations (as archived): [Irish Times](<http://www.irishtimes.com/newspaper/world/2011/0915/1224304142392.html>).

<a id="event-2011-09-14-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Paul Tiensten, a former Minister in Papua New Guinea, flees to Australia after being summonsed in East New Britain Province to face charges of fraud and corruption.

Source citations (as archived): [AAP](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/nation/papua-new-guinea-minister-flees-to-australia-over-corruption-allegations/story-e6frg6nf-1226137899684>).

<a id="event-2011-09-14-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two days after his release from prison, British Conservative peer Lord Hanningfield is arrested on suspicion of fraudulently claiming expenses during his time as leader of Essex County Council.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-essex-14922211>).

<a id="event-2011-09-14-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** In a court case concerning the theft of Kevlar-related trade secrets, DuPont is awarded US$920 million in damages.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-14925058>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2011-09-14-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Australian government's Minister for Broadband, Communications and the Digital Economy, Stephen Conroy, announces an inquiry into the national media.

Source citations (as archived): [SBS](<http://www.sbs.com.au/news/article/1588039/Conroy-releases-media-inquiry-details>).

#### Science

<a id="event-2011-09-14-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** NASA announces plans for a Space Launch System to replace the Space Shuttle program with the first flight tentatively scheduled for 2017.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2011/09/15/science/space/15nasa.html>).

### 2011-09-15

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1161214244](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20September%2015&oldid=1161214244>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2011-09-15-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Japanese automaker Toyota resumes full production at its North American plants, having finally overcome parts shortages caused by the March 2011 Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<http://search.japantimes.co.jp/cgi-bin/nb20110915n1.html>).

<a id="event-2011-09-15-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A contract between the North American automaker Chrysler and the United Auto Workers expires at midnight while negotiations continue between the union and General Motors.

Source citations (as archived): [Detroit Free Press](<https://web.archive.org/web/20121009095325/http://www.freep.com/article/20110914/BUSINESS0104/110914015/Chrysler-offers-contract-extension-UAW-GM-still-negotiating>).

<a id="event-2011-09-15-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Switzerland's UBS reports that it has lost US$2 billion on unauthorised deals by Kweku Adoboli, one of its London-based traders.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/09/15/us-ubs-idUSTRE78E15I20110915>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/business/2011/sep/15/ubs-rogue-trader-man-arrested>).

<a id="event-2011-09-15-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Stock markets in the United States and Europe rally after major banks, including the European Central Bank and the United States Federal Reserve, initiate a plan to help end the European sovereign debt crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://money.cnn.com/2011/09/15/markets/markets_newyork/index.htm?hpt=hp_t1>).

#### Disasters

<a id="event-2011-09-15-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** International aid group Oxfam sets up an emergency appeal for victims of the 2011 Sindh floods in Pakistan, which have so far killed more than 200 people.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2011-09-15/oxfam-launches-pakistan-flood-appeal/2899800?section=world>).

<a id="event-2011-09-15-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Rescue efforts continue to release four miners trapped 90m (295ft) underground following an explosion at Gleision Colliery near Cilybebyll, Pontardawe in the Swansea Valley, Wales, on Thursday morning.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-wales-14938837>); [AP](<http://www.smh.com.au/world/four-coalminers-trapped-in-south-wales-20110916-1kccw.html>).

<a id="event-2011-09-15-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Earthquakes hit off the coasts of Vancouver Island, Cuba, Japan, and New Zealand's north island.

Source citations (as archived): [MSNBC](<http://www.msnbc.msn.com/id/44536889>).

<a id="event-2011-09-15-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hurricane Maria passes Bermuda on its way to Newfoundland off the coast of Canada.

Source citations (as archived): [National Hurricane Centre](<http://www.nhc.noaa.gov/text/refresh/MIATCPAT4+shtml/152355.shtml>).

<a id="event-2011-09-15-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Norwegian cruise ship \{\{MS\|Nordlys\|1993\|2\}\} catches fire off Ålesund. Two people are killed and twelve are injured.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-14935597>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2011-09-15-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Prime Minister of Thailand Yingluck Shinawatra visits Cambodia in an effort to improve relations after the border clashes near the Preah Vihear Temple earlier this year which led to the deaths of twenty people.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/2011-09-15/yingluck-visits-cambodia-as-thailand-seeks-to-mend-links-hurt-by-clashes.html>).

<a id="event-2011-09-15-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israel withdraws its ambassador to Jordan due to fears of a violent protest in Amman.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/egyptNews/idAFL5E7KF02C20110915>).

<a id="event-2011-09-15-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Senior NATO leaders including the President of France Nicolas Sarkozy fly to Libya to meet with Mustafa Abdul Jalil, the leader of the National Transitional Council, and other leaders.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-14926308>).

<a id="event-2011-09-15-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** UNICEF releases a child mortality report indicating that the number of children dying under the age of five has fallen from more than 12 million in 1990 to 7.6 million in 2010.

Source citations (as archived): [UNICEF](<http://www.unicef.org/media/files/Child_Mortality_Report_2011_Final.pdf>).

<a id="event-2011-09-15-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States designates the Indian Mujahideen as a terrorist organisation.

Source citations (as archived): [Indian Express](<http://www.indianexpress.com/news/Briefly-Nation/847436/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2011-09-15-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The People's Republic of China sentences four people to death in the Xinjiang region following threats to crack down on terrorism in the far-western region.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5hejQtvnZJWwZzkv4YzDOI8E9uElg?docId=CNG.84013840d691548b4d501bfc5f665885.371>).

<a id="event-2011-09-15-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Figures from the United Kingdom's Ministry of Justice indicate that three quarters of those charged with offences relating to the riots which occurred in August had previous criminal convictions. One quarter had committed more than ten previous offences.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-14926322>).

<a id="event-2011-09-15-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The UK's Metropolitan Police arrest trader Kweku Adoboli after Swiss bank UBS says it lost $2bn (£1.3bn) as a result of unauthorised trading by a member of staff.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-14927432>).

<a id="event-2011-09-15-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of the United States halts the execution of Duane Buck for double murder in Texas while it reviews his case that the sentence was unfair because of a question asked about race during his trial.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/U/US_TEXAS_EXECUTION?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2011-09-15-4-1"></a>

Context: Danish election:.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Denmark go to the polls for parliamentary elections with a left-wing Coalition led by the Social Democrats winning enough seats to form Government.

Source citations (as archived): [Christian Science Monitor](<http://www.csmonitor.com/World/Europe/2011/0914/Denmark-s-election-a-litmus-test-for-Europe-s-far-right-politics>); [Wall Street Journal](<http://online.wsj.com/article/BT-CO-20110915-711622.html>).

<a id="event-2011-09-15-4-2"></a>

Context: Danish election:.

**Archived source account.** Helle Thorning-Schmidt, the leader of the Social Democrats, looks set to become the first female Prime Minister of Denmark.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/blogs/thetwo-way/2011/09/15/140517030/helle-thorning-schmidt-to-become-denmarks-first-female-prime-minister>).

<a id="event-2011-09-15-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Australians will now be able to choose "indeterminate" as a gender on their passports together with male and female. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.mercurynews.com/breaking-news/ci_18897011>).

<a id="event-2011-09-15-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eight Flemish and Francophone parties represented in the Belgian Chamber of Representatives reach a breakthrough on the Bruxelles-Halle-Vilvorde which had been one of the issues holding up formation of a new government since an election in 2010.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2011-09/16/c_131141208.htm>).

#### Science

<a id="event-2011-09-15-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Researchers at Australia's Monash University have identified a previously unknown species of bottlenose dolphin living in waters in and around Southeastern Australia, which they have named Tursiops australis.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-14921665>).

**Archived source account.** Areas in Delhi, India, are flooded by heavy rain, with record rainfall recorded at Indira Gandhi International Airport.

**Archived source account.** Kosovo Serbs block off two border crossings with Serbia as the Kosovo government seeks to take them over.

<a id="event-2011-09-16-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Health Services Union disaffiliates from the Australian Labor Party in the states of New South Wales and Victoria and the Australian Capital Territory, following the commencement of a New South Wales Police Force investigation into alleged "inappropriate practices" by current and former union officials, including Craig Thomson, a member of the House of Representatives.

### 2011-09-17

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.news.com.au/world/dead-after-trains-collide/story-fn6sb9br-1226140051491>).

**Archived source account.** The United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees opens a new refugee camp in western Ethiopia for refugees from Sudan and South Sudan.

#### Law and crime

#### Sport

<a id="event-2011-10-08-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In horse racing, the Australian mare Black Caviar ties the record set by Phar Lap for consecutive victories, with an unbeaten run of 14 wins.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2011-10-08/black-caviar-returns-in-winning-style/3383950>).

<a id="event-2011-10-08-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** In rugby league, Leeds Rhinos win the European Super League Grand Final at Old Trafford by defeating St Helens 32-16.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport1/hi/rugby_league/9606230.stm>).

#### Transportation

<a id="event-2011-10-08-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Stages 4 and 5 of Circle MRT line began operations, with all 12 stations along the Stage 4 and 5 of the MRT line from Caldecott to HarbourFront (except Bukit Brown) being opened at the same time operated by SMRT Trains Ltd.

No attached source citation. This assertion is unverified; see its disclosure and research status above.

### 2011-10-09

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1186071820](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20October%209&oldid=1186071820>).

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2011-10-09-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** 2011 Libyan civil war: ousted Libyan dictator Muammar Gaddafi's stronghold of Sirte is reportedly close to being conquered by the forces of the National Transitional Council, who have captured the city's airport, hospital, university and conference centre.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-15232870>).

<a id="event-2011-10-09-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 25 people are killed and many more injured after protesters and security forces clash in the Egyptian capital of Cairo, during a protest in response to an attack on a Coptic church.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-15235212>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/10/10/us-egypt-copts-clashes-idUSTRE7981Q220111010>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2011-10-09-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Beatle Sir Paul McCartney marries American heiress Nancy Shevell at a ceremony in London.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-15230730>).

#### Disasters

<a id="event-2011-10-09-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A magnitude 4.3 earthquake hits the southern coast of El Hierro in the southwestern Canary Islands of Spain, the strongest such earthquake to occur in an earthquake swarm on the island. The quake is believed to have been caused by rising magma, which has forced evacuations amid fears of an impending volcanic eruption, which last occurred on El Hierro in 1793. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Irish Weather Online](<https://web.archive.org/web/20111010021700/http://www.irishweatheronline.com/news/earth-science/geology/volcanic-alert-in-effect-on-el-hierro-as-4-3-magnitude-earthquake-hits/41200.html>); [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-2042873/Earthquake-swarm-Canary-Island-El-Hierro-sparks-fears-volcanic-eruption.html?ito=feeds-newsxml>); [Philippine Star](<http://www.philstar.com/Article.aspx?articleId=731865&amp;publicationSubCategoryId=200>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2011-10-09-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Voters in Cameroon go to the polls for a presidential election, with incumbent President Paul Biya likely to be re-elected.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.focus-fen.net/index.php?id=n261270>).

<a id="event-2011-10-09-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Voters in Poland go to the polls for a parliamentary election, with Prime Minister Donald Tusk's Civic Platform – Polish People's Party coalition becoming the first government to be reelected since Poland transitioned to democracy in 1989.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5jIp4PfsW5FPzgyx7m2ewWbRGpmGQ?docId=CNG.342b2fda95ff676d661cfb8393d151f9.31>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/10/10/us-poland-election-idUSTRE79806920111010>).

<a id="event-2011-10-09-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The French Socialist Party holds a nationwide primary election to choose its candidate for the 2012 presidential election, with over 1 million voters participating and François Hollande and Martine Aubry entering a run-off election.

Source citations (as archived): [France24](<http://www.france24.com/en/20111009-ps-socialist-party-france-primaries-presidential-election>); [Bloomberg](<http://www.businessweek.com/news/2011-10-10/aubry-hollande-to-run-for-french-socialists-nomination.html>).

<a id="event-2011-10-09-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Having spread across the United States, anti-corruption Occupy Wall Street protests reach Canada, London, and The Hague.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Netherlands](<https://web.archive.org/web/20111012185728/http://www.rnw.nl/english/article/occupy-wall-street-reaches-hague>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2011-10-09-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In motorsports, Sebastian Vettel of Germany wins the Formula One World Championship, becoming the youngest driver to win the Drivers' Championship twice.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/sport/blog/2011/oct/09/sebastian-vettel-f1-world-title?newsfeed=true>).

### 2011-10-10

#### Arts and culture

**Archived source account.** France and Belgium agree to break up and partially nationalize Dexia, Belgium's largest bank.

**Archived source account.** American economists Thomas J. Sargent and Christopher A. Sims win the 2011 Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences.

<a id="event-2011-10-10-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Governor Rick Scott of Florida signs the death warrant for Oba Chandler, convicted of the murder of three women in 1989, with the execution set for November 15. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

### 2011-10-11

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1306147494](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20October%2011&oldid=1306147494>).

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2011-10-11-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** China follows Russian admonishment of the Syrian government while the opposition Syrian National Council gains support in Egypt and is recognized by Libya.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2011/10/11/world/meast/syria-unrest/index.html?hpt=hp_t2>).

<a id="event-2011-10-11-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The EU imposes further sanctions on Belarus, Iran, and Syria, expresses support for Libya's National Transitional Council, and reiterates call for Syria's President Bashar al-Assad to step down.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2011/10/10/world/europe/luxembourg-eu-foreign-ministers/index.html?hpt=hp_t2>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2011-10-11-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Senate of the United States passes the Currency Exchange Rate Oversight Reform Act of 2011 designed to press the People's Republic of China to raise the value of the Renminbi.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/10/11/usa-china-idUSWEN925020111011>).

<a id="event-2011-10-11-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A measure to support expansion of the eurozone bailout fund is halted due to its failure to pass in the Parliament of Slovakia.

Source citations (as archived): [Market Watch](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/business/world/domestic-politics-in-slovakia-representing-02-per-cent-of-europe-has-interfered-with-a-eurozone-bailout/story-e6frg90o-1226164549887>).

<a id="event-2011-10-11-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Jaguar Financial Corp. claims that it has the support of 8% of the shareholders of Research in Motion in its campaign for corporate-governance changes at the Canada-based manufacturer of the BlackBerry.

Source citations (as archived): [Press Release](<http://www.jaguarfinancial.ca/press_releases/JFC%20PR%20Oct%2011-11.pdf>).

#### Disasters

<a id="event-2011-10-11-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hurricane Jova crosses the western coast of Mexico northwest of the port of Manzanillo, Colima, at Category 2 strength.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/10/10/us-storm-jova-idUSTRE79964O20111010>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/2011-10-11/hurricane-jova-nearing-landfall-on-mexico-with-category-2-force.html>).

<a id="event-2011-10-11-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** An oil spill from the ship MV Rena off the coast of Tauranga in New Zealand becomes the country's worst environmental disaster.

Source citations (as archived): [New Zealand Herald](<http://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/news/article.cfm?c_id=1&amp;objectid=10758195>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2011-10-11-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Cabinet of Israel approves a prisoner swap deal with Hamas for the release of the Israeli Army soldier Gilad Shalit, who had been held in captivity for five years. In exchange, Israel agrees to release a thousand Palestinian prisoners held in Israel, among them hundreds of prisoners serving multiple life sentences for planning and perpetrating murderous attacks against Israeli civilians.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhuanet](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2011-10/12/c_131185670.htm>); [Ynet](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4134416,00.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2011-10-11-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Yulia Tymoshenko, the former Prime Minister of Ukraine, is jailed for seven years for exceeding her powers by entering a gas deal with Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-15250742>).

<a id="event-2011-10-11-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The bodies of 12 Chinese sailors have been found and one remains missing in Mekong river, where Thailand, Laos and Myanmar meet, after the incident last week in which two Chinese cargo vessels were hijacked by suspected drug smugglers in the Golden Triangle, and later captured by Thai river police.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/china/2011-10/11/c_131185545.htm>); [The Wall Street Journal](<http://online.wsj.com/article/SB10001424052970204450804576622800519874000.html>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2011/10/11/world/asia/china-suspends-boat-traffic-on-mekong.html>).

<a id="event-2011-10-11-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The US Federal Bureau of Investigation and Drug Enforcement Administration claim to have disrupted an alleged terrorist plot to assassinate the Saudi Arabian ambassador and bombings of the Saudi and Israeli embassies in Washington DC with possible links to Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/Blotter/us-iran-tied-terror-plot-washington-dc-disrupted/story?id=14711933>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-15266992>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2011-10-11-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Voters in Liberia go to the polls for a general election with current President and recent Nobel Peace Prize laureate Ellen Johnson-Sirleaf facing a tight race.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/10/10/liberia-election-idUSL5E7LA41320111010>).

<a id="event-2011-10-11-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Myanmar's tightly controlled state newspapers call for a political amnesty indicating that reforms may soon be announced by President Thein Sein with the National Human Rights Commission recommending the pardon of some 6000 plus "prisoners of conscience".

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2011/10/11/world/asia/myanmar-prisoner-release/index.html?hpt=hp_t2>); [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5hEyZu6QPrbGRIqZeAeZcpL3mwUdA?docId=3352857c907740a0833ee00b3c886823>).

<a id="event-2011-10-11-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Voters in the Canadian province of Newfoundland and Labrador go to the polls for general election with the Progressive Conservative Party winning its third straight majority and its leader Kathy Dunderdale becoming the first woman elected as Premier of the province.

Source citations (as archived): [CTV](<http://montreal.ctv.ca/servlet/an/local/CTVNews/20111011/newfoundland-labrador-provincial-election-voting-day-111011/20111011/?hub=MontrealHome>).

<a id="event-2011-10-11-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the Yukon Territory voters re-elect the Yukon Party under Premier Darrell Pasloski, with an NDP official opposition.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/yukonvotes2011/>).

<a id="event-2011-10-11-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** President of the United States Barack Obama's "jobs bill" stalls in the Senate.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<http://www.politico.com/news/stories/1011/65630.html>).

#### Arts and culture

#### Science

<a id="event-2011-10-13-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Researchers at the Universities of Texas, Wollongong, British Columbia and Hanyang announce that they have collaboratively developed carbon nanotube-based artificial muscle fibers with over 1,000 times the rotational power of previous designs. **Archived source account.** Activists affiliated with the Occupy Wall Street movement, which opposes economic inequality and corporate greed, take to the streets in numerous cities worldwide, including Sydney, Rome, Bucharest, Taipei, Tokyo, Toronto, Berlin, and Madrid, in a day of coordinated mass protests.

<a id="event-2011-10-16-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Indycar, fifteen cars were involved in a wreck at Las Vegas Motor Speedway in the final race of the season. The wreck happened on lap 11, and the remaining 188 laps were not raced.

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2011-10-25-4-0"></a>

<a id="event-2011-10-25-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Space telescope observations indicate that the supernova RCW 86, first seen by Chinese astronomers in 185 AD, expanded at an unprecedented rate due to the formation of a vacuum-like "cavity" around it in the early stages of the death of its star. The supernova's rapid expansion had previously been one of astronomy's most enduring mysteries.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-15445688>).

#### Emergency Alerts

<a id="event-2011-11-09-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The first ever national test of the Emergency Alert System occurred on this date, at 2:00 p.m. EST. This test was transmitted with the Emergency Action Notification code, and was testing the ability to transmit a national-level emergency alert, such as a nuclear attack. This test failed, with 2 other Primary Entry Point (PEP) radio stations relaying the alert over the original alert itself, creating an echo effect. One of the overlaying PEP stations were WCCO (AM), and the other one cannot be determined. However, the issues in this alert have (mostly) been fixed.

No attached source citation. This assertion is unverified; see its disclosure and research status above.

### 2011-11-12

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1223193045](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20November%2012&oldid=1223193045>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-11-12-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian uprising:.

**Archived source account.** The Arab League votes to suspend Syria over its violent suppression of the Syrian uprising, pledging new sanctions and urging member states to withdraw ambassadors from Damascus.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.ndtv.com/article/world/arab-league-suspends-syria-calls-on-army-to-stop-killings-149299>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/syria-suspended-from-arab-league/2011/11/12/gIQAvqGxEN_story.html>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/MiddleEast/Article.aspx?id=245351>).

<a id="event-2011-11-12-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian uprising:.

**Archived source account.** Reuters reports that crowds have attacked the Saudi Arabian embassy in Damascus and the French and Turkish consulates in Latakia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://af.reuters.com/article/commoditiesNews/idAFL5E7MC16S20111112>).

<a id="event-2011-11-12-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nine civilians are killed by a bomb explosion on a bus in Laghman province in eastern Afghanistan in a suspected Taliban attack.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/11/12/world/afghanistan-deadly-explosion/index.html?hpt=wo_c2>).

<a id="event-2011-11-12-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two massive explosions occur at a Revolutionary Guard ammunition depot western of the Iranian capital, Tehran; at least 17 people, including a senior commander, are killed according to Iranian state media. Mossad assumed responsible.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/news/diplomacy-defense/western-official-israel-is-behind-recent-iran-explosion-1.395512>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/11/12/world/meast/iran-blast/>); [PressTV](<http://www.presstv.ir/detail/209665.html>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/courts-law/iran-exile-group-claims-blast-near-tehran-hit-closely-guarded-missile-base/2011/11/12/gIQArKv4FN_story.html>).

<a id="event-2011-11-12-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A suspected Islamist attacker kills seven people in the southern Kazakh city of Taraz before blowing himself up.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5gNJ8nqT-QIKBny45hZlR3VtdcU9Q?docId=CNG.5bd87fe4dd7ef5a736775fcc25089802.171>); [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2011/11/12/reports-7-killed-in-kazakhstan-terror-attack/>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2011/11/13/world/asia/gunman-goes-on-fatal-rampage-in-kazakhstan.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2011-11-12-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** APEC United States 2011: The Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation summit gets underway in the US city of Honolulu.

Source citations (as archived): [Wall Street Journal](<http://online.wsj.com/article/SB10001424052970204358004577031852970881074.html?mod=googlenews_wsj>).

<a id="event-2011-11-12-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Democratic Republic of Congo and South Africa sign an accord to develop a mega-hydroelectric plant on the Congo River to address their nations' growing energy needs.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5gI2JeQExbuhSFAF3RGdU2BXbJtgQ?docId=CNG.cbc3ed79698bb9cab8ad6a92169ceb0c.321>).

<a id="event-2011-11-12-1-3"></a>

Context: Response to IAEA report on Iran's nuclear program:.

**Archived source account.** United States Secretary of State Hillary Clinton demands that Iran respond soon to the "serious concerns" raised by the International Atomic Energy Agency report that Iran appeared to be working on nuclear bomb technology.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/VideoArticles/Video/Article.aspx?id=245278>).

<a id="event-2011-11-12-1-4"></a>

Context: Response to IAEA report on Iran's nuclear program:.

**Archived source account.** German Chancellor Angela Merkel criticizes Russia and China's opposition to further sanctions against Iran over its nuclear program following an International Atomic Energy Agency report that Iran had worked on an atomic weapon design.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/IranianThreat/News/Article.aspx?id=245304>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2011-11-12-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Prosecutors at the U.N.-backed Special Tribunal for Lebanon set up to prosecute the killers of former Lebanese Prime Minister Rafik Hariri ask judges to defer a decision to hold a trial in absentia for four Hezbollah members indicted in Hariri's assassination.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Star](<http://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/Politics/2011/Nov-12/153845-rival-counsels-trade-blows-over-in-absentia-trials.ashx#axzz1dXvg4bJc>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle-east/prosecutors-tell-court-to-hold-off-on-trial-in-absentia-for-hariri-slaying-suspects/2011/11/11/gIQABWqPBN_story.html>).

#### Politics

<a id="event-2011-11-12-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Silvio Berlusconi resigns as Prime Minister of Italy to make way for an emergency government to address the country's economic crisis; thousands of Italians celebrate his departure in street demonstrations.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-15708729>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/11/12/us-italy-idUSTRE7AA2GC20111112?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews>); [The Independent](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/nov/12/silvio-berlusconi-resign-italy-eurozone>).

<a id="event-2011-11-12-3-1"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/8301-503544_162-57323686-503544/romney-gingrich-at-gop-debate-wed-go-to-war-to-keep-iran-from-getting-nuclear-weapons/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

#### International relations

<a id="event-2011-11-13-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Undercover British police officer Mark Kennedy admits that, in the guise of an environmental activist, he was used by the police forces of 22 countries, was responsible for the closing down of the Youth House community centre in Copenhagen, and committed two crimes on behalf of German police between 2004 and 2009, one of which was arson.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/environment/2011/nov/13/undercover-policeman-admits-spying-danish-activists>).

<a id="event-2011-11-13-1-2"></a>

Context: Frisking of A. P. J. Abdul Kalam by the United States:.

**Archived source account.** Former President of India A. P. J. Abdul Kalam is frisked and has his clothes inspected for explosives by officials in New York, with the United States apologising for its breach of protocol.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-15711135>); [Wall Street Journal](<http://blogs.wsj.com/indiarealtime/2011/11/13/u-s-apologizes-to-india-for-%E2%80%98frisking%E2%80%99-former-president/?mod=google_news_blog>); [Straits Times](<https://web.archive.org/web/20111113192352/http://www.straitstimes.com/BreakingNews/Asia/Story/STIStory_733554.html>).

<a id="event-2011-11-13-1-3"></a>

Context: Frisking of A. P. J. Abdul Kalam by the United States:.

**Archived source account.** India threatens retaliatory action against the United States and the Congress utters its condemnation.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/US-apologises-to-APJ-Abdul-Kalam-for-frisking-incident/articleshow/10715988.cms>); [Hindustan Times](<http://www.hindustantimes.com/India-news/NewDelhi/BJP-Congress-Left-parties-deplore-Kalam-frisking-in-US/Article1-768774.aspx>); [NDTV](<http://www.ndtv.com/article/india/indian-governments-statement-on-kalams-screening-149429>).

#### Armed conflict and attacks

**Archived source account.** A suspected drone attack in Pakistan's North Waziristan province kills six militants.

**Archived source account.** After a meeting with Russian officials in Moscow, the opposition Syrian National Council calls for UN peacekeepers to be introduced into Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Morningstar](<http://news.morningstar.com/all/dow-jones/us-markets/201111161510/000531/countrywide-report-to-have-significant-new-details-rep-issa.aspx>).

<a id="event-2011-11-16-3-2"></a>

### 2011-11-26

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-11-26-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** 26 Pakistani soldiers are killed after a NATO helicopter opens fire on a Pakistani checkpoint, sparking outrage from the Pakistani government.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2011/11/26/world/meast/pakistan-attack/index.html?hpt=hp_t1>).

<a id="event-2011-11-26-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Colombian military forces raid a FARC rebel hideout in the province of Caquetá, freeing police sergeant Luis Alberto Erazu, who had been held hostage by FARC for 12 years. Four other hostages are killed by the rebels during the raid.

Source citations (as archived): [Miami Herald](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120203200240/http://www.miamiherald.com/2011/11/28/2522439/colombian-farc-hostage-describes.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2011-11-26-1-1"></a>

Context: New Zealand general election and voting method referendum:.

**Archived source account.** Voters in New Zealand go to the polls for a general election and voting method referendum.

Source citations (as archived): [NZ Stuff](<http://www.stuff.co.nz/national/6039845/Election-2011-Kiwis-have-their-say>).

<a id="event-2011-11-26-1-2"></a>

Context: New Zealand general election and voting method referendum:.

**Archived source account.** The New Zealand National Party, led by incumbent Prime Minister John Key, wins 60 seats, one short of the 61 required for a majority. ACT New Zealand and United Future New Zealand indicate that they will work with the National Party to form a coalition government.

Source citations (as archived): [Television New Zealand](<http://tvnz.co.nz/election-2011/awesome-win-national-john-key-4573748>).

<a id="event-2011-11-26-1-3"></a>

Context: New Zealand general election and voting method referendum:.

**Archived source account.** The Mixed Member Proportional voting system, on early votes only, wins a majority of the vote in the referendum and will be kept. Full results will be released on 10 December 2011.

Source citations (as archived): [The Dominion Post](<http://www.stuff.co.nz/dominion-post/news/politics/election-2011/6041261/MMP-holds-on-after-200-000-votes-counted>).

#### Science

<a id="event-2011-11-26-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** NASA launches the robotic Mars Science Laboratory, the largest rover yet sent to Mars, with the aim of finding evidence for past or present life on Mars.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-15904408>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2011-11-26-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** NBA team owners and players reach an agreement to end the 149-day NBA lockout and to begin the current NBA season on Christmas Day.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://espn.go.com/nba/story/_/id/7281052/nba-owners-players-get-tentative-agreement>).

<a id="event-2011-11-27-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Canada, Chinook windstorms tear through Alberta and Saskatchewan, producing a dust storm in downtown Calgary and causing millions of dollars in damage. The windstorms fuel a grass fire that grows to two kilometres wide near Lethbridge, Alberta, before being contained, and gusts reach a maximum speed of 149 km/h. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [National Post](<http://news.nationalpost.com/2011/11/28/lufthansa-flight-makes-dramatic-landing-in-149kmh-calgary-windstorm/>); [Calgary Herald](<https://web.archive.org/web/20120101230628/http://www.calgaryherald.com/going+unpredictable+winter+Calgary+weather/5781620/story.html>); [Montreal Gazette](<https://montrealgazette.com/news/calgary/Monitoring+system+predicted+storm+mobilized+emergency+crews/5780260/story.html>); [Medicine Hat News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20111202004851/http://www.medicinehatnews.com/front-page-news/battling-a-30-foot-wall-of-flame-11292011.html>); [Metro News](<http://www.metronews.ca/calgary/local/article/1035649--wind-swept-residents-report-near-misses>).

#### Politics

<a id="event-2011-12-10-3-1"></a>

Context: New Zealand general election and voting system referendum:.

**Archived source account.** Official results for the 26 November general election confirm John Key's National Party holding a plurality of the votes and seats. With confidence and supply agreements with ACT New Zealand and United Future confirmed, National forms a minority government with a one-seat majority, returning the Fifth National Government to a second term in office.

Source citations (as archived): [TVNZ](<http://tvnz.co.nz/politics-news/paula-bennett-loses-waitakere-electorate-4623009>).

<a id="event-2011-12-10-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Full results of the referendum on the voting system confirm that the mixed member proportional voting system, with a majority of the vote, will be kept but will be reviewed. The first past the post voting system gains the most votes for the preferred alternative system of voting.

Source citations (as archived): [TVNZ](<http://tvnz.co.nz/election-2011/overwhelming-support-keep-mmp-4625676>).

**Archived source account.** Former Daily Mirror editor Piers Morgan appears before the Leveson Inquiry via videolink from the United States to deny knowledge of hacking at the paper.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-16259941>).

#### Politics

<a id="event-2011-12-20-5-1"></a>

Context: Death of Kim Jong-il:.

**Archived source account.** The body of Kim Jong-il lies in state at the Kumsusan Memorial Palace in Pyongyang.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/asia-pacific/2011/12/2011122042235923301.html>).

<a id="event-2011-12-20-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Villagers rebelling in village of Wukan in southern China, say they will hold talks with the government and demand concessions in return for calling off a march.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2011/12/20/us-china-unrest-village-idUSTRE7BJ0I320111220>).

<a id="event-2011-12-20-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Joseph Kabila is sworn in as President of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, despite the presidency being contested by opposition leader Etienne Tshisekedi.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC](<https://web.archive.org/web/20111220193603/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/congo-inauguration-ahead-disputed-vote-15195308#.TvB_kdXepyE>).

<a id="event-2011-12-20-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thousands of Egyptian women demonstrate against abuses by military police.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2011/12/21/world/middleeast/violence-enters-5th-day-as-egyptian-general-blames-protesters.html>).

#### Science

<a id="event-2011-12-20-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Worldwide controversy erupts over a plan by Dutch scientists to publish findings relating to the development of a mutated strain of H5N1, that could potentially cause a worldwide pandemic that could kill millions. Bioterrorism watchdogs also express immense concern over the development of the virus (which is presently stored in Erasmus MC, Rotterdam).

Source citations (as archived): [Russia Today](<http://rt.com/news/super-flu-terrorist-threat-251/>); [FOX News](<http://www.foxnews.com/health/2011/12/20/scientists-spark-fears-by-creating-highly-contagious-airborne-strain-bird-flu/>).

<a id="event-2011-12-20-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two Earth-sized planets, Kepler-20e and Kepler-20d, are found orbiting a star 950 light-years away from Earth.

Source citations (as archived): [Wall Street Journal](<http://online.wsj.com/article/SB10001424052970204791104577110562687967308.html?mod=googlenews_wsj>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2011-12-20-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The National Collegiate Athletic Association announces that it is penalizing the Ohio State Buckeyes football program with a one-year bowl game ban, among other penalties, as a result of a scandal at the program. Former head coach Jim Tressel is given a 5-year show-cause penalty as well.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://espn.go.com/college-football/story/_/id/7372757/ohio-state-buckeyes-football-penalties-include-bowl-ban>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-12-21-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** 2011 Syrian uprising: Syria's opposition urge the United Nations and Arab League to hold emergency meetings after an alleged massacre took place in the northwest of the country, before Arab League monitors enter the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Khaleej Times](<http://www.khaleejtimes.com/displayarticle.asp?xfile=data/middleeast/2011/December/middleeast_December581.xml&amp;section=middleeast&amp;col=>).

<a id="event-2011-12-21-0-2"></a>

<a id="event-2011-12-21-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Health authorities in Hong Kong start slaughtering 17,000 chickens after a carcass infected with bird flu H5N1 is found at a poultry market.

<a id="event-2011-12-21-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Indonesian ferry sinks off the coast of the Maluku Islands with 60 people missing.

**Archived source account.** North Korea closes its border with China ahead of the funeral of former leader Kim Jong-il.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2011/12/21/North-Korea-closes-border-with-China/UPI-18701324456200/>).

<a id="event-2011-12-21-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Russian blogger Alexei Navalny and opposition leader Ilya Yashin are released.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-16279939>); [RIA Novosti](<http://en.ria.ru/russia/20111221/170398178.html>).

<a id="event-2011-12-21-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Daily Mirror journalist James Hipwell tells the Leveson Inquiry that phone hacking was a "bog standard journalistic tool" at the paper.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-16283935>).

<a id="event-2011-12-21-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** John Terry, the captain of the England football team is to face criminal charges over allegations he used racist language towards a black player during a Premier League game.

#### Science

<a id="event-2011-12-21-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Soyuz TMA-03M, launched from Baikonur, carries a crew of three men to the International Space Station.

Source citations (as archived): [ESA](<http://www.esa.int/esaCP/SEMWT8BX9WG_index_0.html>).

#### Politics

<a id="event-2011-12-21-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A rebellion by villagers in Wukan, southern China, ends after authorities say they will release three protesters detained and agree to other demands.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/asia/china/8969702/Wukan-forces-Chinese-officials-to-release-three-villagers.html>).

### 2011-12-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076396585](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20December%2022&oldid=1076396585>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-12-22-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 72 people are killed and 169 wounded in a series of 16 bombing attacks in the Iraqi capital Baghdad, shortly after the final withdrawal of American forces from Iraq.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-16297707>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2011/12/22/world/meast/iraq-violence/index.html?hpt=imi_c1>).

<a id="event-2011-12-22-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States admits it was significantly responsible for an airstrike last month that killed 24 Pakistani soldiers.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-16302197>).

<a id="event-2011-12-22-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Killings and coverups are reported to be occurring in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-16297258>).

<a id="event-2011-12-22-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Human Rights Watch alleges that security forces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have been responsible for the deaths of 24 people since the re-election of Joseph Kabila as President.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/africa/2011/12/2011122241113903851.html>).

<a id="event-2011-12-22-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The first monitors from the Arab League arrive in Syria to assess the government's crack-down on anti-government demonstrations across the country.

<a id="event-2011-12-22-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Egypt's military-appointed Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri calls for national dialogue after weeks of deadly protests against the military regime.

Source citations (as archived): [Al-Masry Al-Youm](<http://www.almasryalyoum.com/en/node/562861>).

#### Disasters

<a id="event-2011-12-22-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Floods hit the city of Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, killing at least 13 people in the nation's worst floods since its independence in 1961.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-16299734>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2011-12-22-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police in Brazil seek to press charges for environmental crimes committed by the United States oil company Chevron and drilling firm Transocean in relation to last month's Campos Basin oil spill.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-16298344>).

<a id="event-2011-12-22-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Australian teenager is jailed for 13 years for the killing of Nitin Garg in Melbourne, a case that led to a diplomatic row and fury over racism.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-16297316>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2011-12-22-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Teargas is fired and protesters arrested in Haimen, southern China, in a demonstration against the construction of a power plant.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2011/dec/22/chinese-police-teargas-power-plant-protest>); [RTHK](<http://rthk.hk/rthk/news/englishnews/news.htm?hightlight&amp;20111223&amp;56&amp;806944>).

<a id="event-2011-12-22-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Russian President Dmitry Medvedev proposes political reforms at his final state-of-the-nation address.

Source citations (as archived): [Russia Today](<http://rt.com/news/medvedev-russia-political-system-411/>); [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2011/12/23/world/europe/dmitri-medvedev-urges-reforms-for-russia-in-address.html>).

<a id="event-2011-12-22-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Italy's senate debates the proposed economic austerity measures of Prime Minister Mario Monti.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-16301956>).

<a id="event-2011-12-22-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** France's National Assembly votes in favour of a bill criminalising any denial that the mass killing of Armenians by the Ottoman Empire in the 1910s was genocide.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-16297414>).

#### Science

<a id="event-2011-12-22-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Large Hadron Collider makes its first clear observation of a new particle since opening in 2009, the boson Chib 3P.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-16301908>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2011-12-22-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A KNVB Cup game between AFC Ajax and AZ is abandoned after the AZ manager leads his team off the pitch in protest at the sending-off of his goalkeeper, Esteban Alvarado, who kicked an Ajax fan who attacked him.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC Sport](<http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/16296118.stm>); [ESPN](<http://soccernet.espn.go.com/news/story/_/id/999837/knvb-beker:-ajax-vs-az-abandoned-after-fan-attack?cc=5739>); [Sky Sports](<http://www1.skysports.com/football/news/11913/7391572/Ajax-sorry-over-abandoned-game>).

### 2011-12-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076396549](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2011%20December%2023&oldid=1076396549>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2011-12-23-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** 2011 Syrian uprising: Syrian state media report the deaths of at least 40 people in two car bombings in the capital Damascus.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-16313879>).

<a id="event-2011-12-23-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** 2011 Egyptian revolution: Activists gather in the Egyptian capital Cairo, calling for the end of the post-Hosni Mubarak military regime.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/middleeast/2011/12/2011122374830994443.html>).

<a id="event-2011-12-23-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three Somali aid workers are killed in central Somalia.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5hJ-cfRI4aPjWYi9iywRazTScY_Vw?docId=997d4a6891304de89867e9a6d40ed7ea>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2011-12-23-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** China Three Gorges Corp. wins a bid for its 21% stake in EDP-Energias de Portugal SA with an offer of €2.69 billion ($3.51 billion), in the first of a series of sales of state-owned assets under Portugal's austerity program. This is the first time a mainland Chinese firm has acquired a significant stake in a southern European company.

#### Disasters

**Archived source account.** North Korea says it will accept all South Korean delegations wishing to pay respects to the late leader Kim Jong-il.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-16312157>).

<a id="event-2011-12-23-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** World leaders attend the funeral of former Czech President and dissident Václav Havel.

**Archived source account.** A Chinese court sentences dissident Chen Wei to nine years imprisonment for "inciting subversion of state power", after he published essays online calling for multiparty democracy.

<a id="event-2011-12-23-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police fire teargas in the southern Chinese town of Haimen, and state media air confessions from two detained activists amid a protest against a proposed new power plant.

#### Politics and elections

**Archived source account.** Burmese opposition leader Aung San Suu Kyi registers her National League for Democracy party, and visits Burma's parliament for the first time.
